AgenticRoboRL: Bringing Coding-Agent Post-Training to Agentic Robotics

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能

首发 2026-10-20，arXiv:2610.28589 v1  ·  收录于 2026-10-22 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗GitHub ↗项目主页 ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

大系统 + 核心训练方法｜Agent/agentic coding + VLA｜规划、技能调用与代码生成｜桌面操作仿真

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Agentic robotics systems combine planners with robot harnesses to perform complex manipulation tasks. Recent work improves these systems through better harnesses and external memory, but relies on powerful closed-source models as planners and does not improve the planners' own capabilities. In contrast, coding agents have improved substantially by post-training the model itself. We therefore investigate whether post-training can also improve robot planners. However, applying it across robot harnesses requires accommodating different execution mechanisms, including VLA skill invocation and control-code generation. To this end, we introduce AgenticRoboRL, a framework for post-training robot planners across different harnesses. The training recipe combines supervised fine-tuning with multi-turn reinforcement learning. To accommodate different execution mechanisms, harness-specific adapters connect recorded planner interactions with task outcomes, enabling a common RL training pipeline while keeping execution components fixed. On LIBERO-PRO, AgenticRoboRL raises the success rate of a 9B-parameter planner from 18.1% to 71.0% without external memory, approaching the 72.1% achieved by Codex (GPT-5.5) with external memory. These results demonstrate post-training as an effective approach for improving robot planners. We will release the framework and trained planner checkpoints.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 实验

全部是仿真，执行 VLA 保持冻结；RPent 的 SFT 监督来自可访问外部记忆的 27B teacher，RL 又使用 2304 个训练回合。CaP-X 实验使用 privileged state，且 Goal/Spatial 的绝对成功率仍低。它证明的是 planner 后训练，不是低层控制改进。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Evaluating and post-training robot policies through physical interaction is costly and difficult to scale, motivating action-conditioned world models as interactive simulators. However, visually plausible predictions can misrepresent contact dynamics, providing unreliable feedback for policy evaluation and learning. We introduce PhysCanvas, a state-consistent visuo-tactile world model for contact-rich robot manipulation. PhysCanvas unifies multi-view RGB, tactile images, marker displacement, task state, and actions within a unified vision space. All modalities share a video VAE and pretrained generative backbone, allowing optical touch to reuse visual and temporal priors. Motion images derived through forward kinematics and camera projection provide spatially aligned action conditioning, while an initial RGB anchor and updated reference observations guide sequential generation. Our consistency-aware post-training uses the frozen Scene Reward Model, Modality Reward Model, and State Reward Model to supervise scene preservation, visual-tactile compatibility, and agreement with real task outcomes. The resulting world model supports closed-loop policy rollouts for evaluation and provides imagined interactions and rewards for GRPO policy updates. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, when policies are rolled out in the world model, State Reward Model supervision increases the arithmetic mean of task-wise Pearson correlations between world-model and real-world success rates from 0.602 to 0.885. Policy post-training in the reward-guided world model further increases $π_{0.5}$'s mean real-world success rate from a 59.1% SFT baseline to 70.8%. These results demonstrate the value of unified multimodal modeling and consistency-aware post-training for robot policy evaluation and learning. Project page: https://zebinx.github.io/PhysCanvas_HomePage/.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: PhysCanvas 的统一视觉画布、奖励模型训练与一致性约束后训练。图源：作者论文 · Figure 3 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 推荐
docs.text: 把多视角 RGB、触觉图像、marker displacement、任务状态和动作统一渲染到视觉 canvas，由共享视频 VAE/生成骨干预测，并用场景、跨模态和结果一致性 reward model 约束世界模型。

docs.title: 实验
docs.text: 四项真实任务为试管放置、瓶盖旋拧、积木搬运和魔方操作。加入状态监督后，世界模型预测成功率与真实成功率的任务内 Pearson 相关均值从 0.602 提升到 0.885；在该世界模型中做 GRPO，π0.5 的真实平均成功率从 SFT 的 59.1% 提升至 70.8%。每个任务—策略对使用 3 批×20 个场景，并由多人判断真实成功。

docs.text:
reward model 本身使用真实轨迹训练，不能视为无实物数据的纯 imagination learning；四项任务与触觉配置较固定。FM 策略即使想象训练后，在试管和魔方任务仍为 0%，且瓶盖任务的 π0.5 从普通 WM 的 90.0% 降至完整模型的 86.6%。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Motivated by the human ability to integrate experience across language, perception, and action, we introduce UniWALM, a unified world-action-language model that learns video, action, and language in a single shared representation, where each modality is both a conditioning signal and a supervision target. We ask: can jointly generating language enrich this shared representation, improving manipulation and supporting memory-dependent behavior? Unlike prior approaches that attach a reasoning or vision-language model to a video-action backbone and run them as distinct stages, UniWALM unifies all three modalities inside a single mixture-of-transformers backbone whose per-modality diffusion heads co-denoise synchronously, decoding subtask and textual memory in the same pass as action with no separate planning stage; the generated language is re-consumed on the next step, closing a language-as-memory loop without an external planner or memory bank. To keep the action stream reliable under this richer objective, we further introduce Flow Matching with Correction (FMC), a training objective that teaches recovery from perturbed action trajectories at no inference-time cost. UniWALM consistently improves over same-backbone baselines (e.g., FastWAM) on compositional pick-and-place (MolmoSpaces) and across the memory-dependent subset of RMBench, where it reaches 34.5% without any pretrained language or reasoning model and exceeds Mem-0's keyframe-equipped setup (28.5%) using only a single anchor frame. On a real-world Find-the-Item task, generating textual memory lifts success from 11.1% to 61.1%, while state-of-the-art VLAs stay at or below chance (<=33.3%).

Training in Deployment: Human-in-the-loop Online Post-Training for Robot Manipulation（TIDE）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Large pretrained robot foundation models provide strong priors for manipulation, yet adapting them to target tasks with offline teleoperated demonstrations often fails to cover the contact-rich, recovery, and precision-critical states encountered during deployment. Existing methods mitigate this issue by augmenting offline demonstrations with human-in-the-loop data or online reinforcement learning. Despite this, offline post-training adapts slowly because it cannot immediately absorb deployment experience, while online RL typically relies on value functions or auxiliary actor-critic models, increasing both training complexity and instability. We present TIDE (Training In DEployment), a human-in-the-loop online post-training system. TIDE introduces a provenance-conditioned supervised learning framework that updates the policy online from human interventions and policy-generated rollouts collected during deployment, without a learned critic, reward model, or action scorer. Across four real-world bimanual manipulation tasks, TIDE improves milestone-normalized task progress and binary full-task completion over the warm-start policy and matched additional offline demonstrations, and performs comparably to the fixed-policy collection baseline while making updated checkpoints available during deployment. Each task-specific online post-training session, from the start of deployment rollouts until the final checkpoint is available, completes in less than one hour while learning and checkpoint handling run asynchronously.

docs.title: PAL
docs.text:
Plan First, Act Later: Streaming Reasoning for Executable Memory in Robot Control（PAL）

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能

首发 2026-10-21，arXiv:2610.29329 v1  ·  收录于 2026-10-23 日报

作者项目主页已核验；Code 按钮指向的 PAL_official 仓库仍返回 HTTP 404，暂不列为可用代码入口。 （2026-10-26 核查）

核心方法＋系统｜VLA＋Agent｜规划/观测/记忆｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Long-horizon robot manipulation requires a robot to remember task-relevant information beyond its short observation window. Existing memory-augmented policies typically retrieve relevant information from history and reason over it at execution time, placing a heavy reasoning burden on the high-level model. To address this challenge, we propose PAL (\textbf{P}lan first, \textbf{A}ct \textbf{L}ater), a hierarchical memory framework for vision-language robot manipulation. It maintains a short-term visual buffer, a semantic-event memory, and an executable \texttt{subtask\_list}. A high-level vision-language model (VLM) converts streaming visual observations into the \texttt{subtask\_list}. At execution time, the VLM selects the currently relevant subtask from the \texttt{subtask\_list} and passes it to a low-level vision-language-action (VLA) policy. To teach the model what to write to memory and when to update it, we introduce a two-stage data generation procedure that first expands sparse update supervision and then uses self-labeling with task-grounded verification to generate training data that better match the state distribution encountered during execution. We evaluate our approach on memory-dependent benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks. On RoboMME, PAL achieves a \textbf{56.05\%} success rate, outperforming the strongest baseline, FrameSamp-Modul, at 44.51\%. In real-world experiments across four manipulation tasks, \pal{} reaches \textbf{60.83\%} overall success, surpassing MemER (45.00\%) and FrameSamp-Modul (28.33\%). These results show that proactively writing future-relevant subtasks into hierarchical memory improves long-horizon visual reasoning and robot control. Code and videos can be found on our website: https://qinghangliu.github.io/pal-webpage/

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: PAL 将流式视觉观察组织为分层记忆和可执行子任务列表，再交给低层 VLA。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话
docs.text: 把长历史先写成语义事件和可执行 subtask_list，执行时只选择当前项交给低层 VLA；以稠密更新监督和验证式自标注解决“何时写记忆”。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: RoboMME 平均成功率 56.05±1.38%，FrameSamp-Modul 44.51%，MemER 42.38%；Franka 四个真实记忆任务、每任务 30 次，整体 60.83±3.82%，MemER 45.00%，FrameSamp 28.33%。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: subtask_list 是线性序列，不能表达条件分支；模拟数据用 oracle event 仅决定事件/更新时间；部分真机任务样本方差大，插孔等接触任务仍很弱。

大系统/上层 harness｜Agent＋VLA｜规划/记忆/验证｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-language-action (VLA) models achieve strong performance across embodied manipulation tasks by unifying visual understanding, language conditioning, and action generation. However, long-horizon tasks can involve non-Markovian dependencies: successful decisions may require retaining task progress and past interaction outcomes, while partial observability and execution errors compound over time. Existing work has begun to address these challenges by augmenting foundation-model policies with memory and by introducing hierarchical architectures that separate high-level planning from low-level execution. We organize the high-level VLM as a robotic agent through an editable harness to maintain task context and improve planning through execution experience. We instantiate this approach as SERA (Self-Evolving Robotic Agent), with a fixed VLA executor providing low-level control. The harness maintains and updates task context using observations and execution feedback to guide subsequent planning. Self-evolution uses environment rollouts to propose and evaluate harness revisions, with the selected configuration fixed before held-out testing. On RoboMME, SERA achieves 51.38% overall success with autonomous selection, compared with 44.38% without self-evolution. Our exploration suggests that agentic planning is a promising direction for history-dependent robotic manipulation.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

During steady pouring, images and robot pose may remain nearly unchanged while transferred mass accumulates, making the return decision ambiguous for a whole-task vision-language-action (VLA) policy. We present FlowVLA, which separates motor generation from physical-completion estimation. A shared $π_{0.5}$ action expert learns approach, pour, and return with boundary-aware supervision. A target-independent estimator fuses visual, joint, wrist-wrench, and recurrent force-belief histories to maintain an estimate of transferred mass. The controller initiates return when this estimate plus predicted residual outflow reaches the requested mass. In coffee-pot/water experiments, FlowVLA achieves 13.1 g goal-balanced mean absolute error (MacroMAE), lower than all tested VLA baselines. Across all attempts, 53.7% both complete the task and finish within +/-10% of the requested mass. The same model interpolates to held-out 150/250-g targets without retraining. Independently trained models further evaluate the formulation in three additional container-fluid settings.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: FlowVLA 的物理完成度估计模块与融合视觉、关节、腕力和递归 belief 的动作架构。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话
docs.text: 不让 whole-task VLA 隐式猜“何时倒够”，而是把动作生成与物理完成度估计拆开，用视觉、关节、腕力和递归 belief 估质量及残余流量来触发 return。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 咖啡壶/水主域中 MacroMAE 13.1 g，整体任务完成且质量在目标 ±10% 内的比例 53.7%；Belief-VLA 为 26.5 g/31.0%。对未训练的 150/250 g 目标仅改提示和阈值即可取得 7.6% 相对 MAE、54.8% 定量成功；另测三种容器—流体组合。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 53.7% 说明抓取、倒出和定量联合可靠性仍有限；主系统使用 4 个独立 completion heads 的集成；方法针对可测质量累积的连续介质，泛化到其他物理完成条件尚未验证。

docs.text:

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

We present SpatialDex, a framework that learns 3D-grounded bimanual dexterity from RGB-only human videos through reconstruction-augmented visuomotor pre-training. The central idea is to learn human behavior together with its spatial context. From each video, we reconstruct the scene geometry and estimate the hand motion, align them at a shared video-level scale using the hand-size prior of 3D hand estimates. We retain the reconstructed geometry as both a policy input and a prediction target. The policy grounds the token grid of a pre-trained vision-language model in this geometry through gated residual fusion, is trained to predict future scene geometry alongside wrist and finger actions, and generates finger motion conditioned on the predicted trajectories of both wrists. Pre-trained on 1M human-video clips and fine-tuned with a small number of robot demonstrations, SpatialDex outperforms the state-of-the-art methods by 16.5 points on nine simulated dexterous tasks across two embodiments and by 38.3 points on six real-world bimanual dexterous tasks. Under a matched comparison, pre-training with reconstructed geometry improves success by 14.2 points over pre-training on hand motion alone.

VLA 与策略学习

首发 2026-10-21，arXiv:2610.29730 v1  ·  收录于 2026-10-23 日报

模块/trick＋诊断｜VLA｜观测/验证/接管｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-language-action (VLA) policies need to recognize gaps in their training knowledge to request useful demonstrations or assistance in new situations, especially when failures are costly. Disagreement within an ensemble of independently trained policies can guide these decisions, but requires training and running multiple policies. We propose post-hoc kernel-variance heads that estimate epistemic uncertainty from the embeddings of a single policy. Each head computes the conditional variance of a Gaussian process conditioned on embeddings from the training demonstrations. Fitting requires no regression targets or gradient updates and leaves the policy unchanged. In experiments with SmolVLA on LIBERO-10, the kernel variance heads perform competitively with two-policy ensemble scores in task-level correlation with task success, in demonstration acquisition during active learning, and in referral to a stronger supervisor policy as a proxy for human assistance. For SmolVLA, the head on the vision-language backbone reduces uncertainty-scoring time by up to approximately a factor of 50 compared with ensemble scores, while also substantially reducing setup costs. We also show that the established evaluation protocol on LIBERO-10 primarily rewards recognition of coverage differences between tasks, while execution variability weakens assessment of within-task rankings. Thus, controlled perturbations provide a complementary evaluation: modality-specific heads identify unfamiliar camera, instruction, or state inputs, while fused heads can detect unfamiliar combinations of individually familiar inputs. With a supervisor proxy trained on the evaluated perturbation families, the decoder head improves within-task referral over ensemble disagreement. These findings show that useful uncertainty estimates for adaptive robot learning can be obtained from a single policy.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 不确定性估计结构
docs.text: 冻结 SmolVLA 的中间表示，以及读取这些表示的整体和上下文不确定性估计头。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话

docs.text: LIBERO-10、三随机种子：KV-Ctx 的任务成功负相关 Spearman/Pearson 为 0.77/0.82，双策略 VFD 为 0.75/0.64；12 类执行中扰动的平均 AUROC 为 0.80，VFD 为 0.76；打分速度最高约快 50×。

docs.text: 仅一架构、一个仿真基准；每扰动条件执行次数很少；分数衡量表示空间覆盖度，不是校准后的失败概率，feature collapse 或无害新颖性都会误导。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown promise in robotic manipulation, but imitation learning (IL) alone often struggles to master complex long-horizon skills. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers an effective avenue for further improving VLA policies. However, existing VLA-RL methods typically suffer from delayed and biased credit assignment due to trajectory-level sparse rewards, while imbalanced subtask mastery creates bottlenecks that limit overall performance. To address these challenges, we propose AtomicRL, an RL post-training framework that leverages atomic task structures for reliable credit assignment and adaptive exploration. AtomicRL introduces Semantic-Aware Policy Optimization (SAPO), which uses semantic-aware gating to constrain TD residuals from failed atomic subtasks from propagating across task boundaries, mitigating credit contamination while preserving intra-subtask credit assignment and value bootstrapping. In addition, Bottleneck-Adaptive Target Exploration (BATE) dynamically coordinates task sampling and local exploration incentives based on the mastery of individual atomic subtasks, directing learning toward the remaining bottlenecks. Finally, we develop a Real2Sim2Real pipeline that bridges online RL in simulation with real-world deployment, facilitating practical transfer to physical robots. On LIBERO-LONG, AtomicRL achieves absolute performance gains of 3.6% and 4.0% over PPO across two VLA architectures. On CALVIN ABC-D, it improves full-task performance by up to 9.5% over PPO. Combined with the Real2Sim2Real pipeline, AtomicRL further improves real-world task performance by an average of 21.3%. These results demonstrate that AtomicRL effectively improves the learning efficiency and manipulation performance of VLA policies on long-horizon tasks.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

核心方法｜WM/WAM｜低层控制｜桌面单臂、接触操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Force-sensitive manipulation requires contact and load information that is not provided explicitly by visual observations. We present CW-WAM, a world action model that jointly predicts video, motion, and contact wrench. Inspired by hybrid motion-force control, it contains a unified interaction module that treats both motion and contact wrench as modeling targets and predicts time-aligned motion-wrench chunks as control references. A pair-causal attention mechanism structures the motion-wrench dependencies, while a long fixed-length wrench memory retains past interaction information. The predicted wrench chunk acts as a force reference for a 20-Hz outer-loop admittance controller within a slow-fast control system that maintains force feedback and smooth motion between model queries. CW-WAM improves contact prediction and increases the insertion success rate from 25% to 70% for square pegs with 1-mm clearance per side and from 40% to 95% for power adapters, compared with WAM without wrench input. It also improves lifting-height accuracy across different loads. Our framework with an admittance controller reduces force-reference RMSE from 4.8 to 2.7 N for peg insertion and from 2.0 to 1.3 N for wiping, respectively, with smaller force fluctuations during successful execution. Project website: https://cw-wam-project.github.io/

docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 10

docs.title: CADRE
docs.text:
Rethinking Video Autoencoders for Interactive World Models（CADRE）

世界模型与 WAM

首发 2026-10-21，arXiv:2610.30129 v1  ·  收录于 2026-10-23 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

原邮件中的 kyutai-labs/cadre 链接返回 HTTP 404；此处展示原论文链接重定向后的官方仓库。配图从原论文 PDF 第 4 页 Figure 3 提取。 （2026-10-23 核查）

核心方法＋基准/诊断｜WM/WAM｜世界预测/表征｜桌面操作＋导航（非策略执行）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Video world models predict future frames from past frames and actions. They serve as simulators in which agents train, plan or are evaluated, and that humans can control interactively. They generate in the latent space of a video autoencoder, whose compression sets their cost per frame and how long each action waits to take effect. Yet world models often reuse the autoencoders of text-to-video generators, built for offline generation with no agent waiting and, without their training data and code, not retrainable at another compression. We therefore ask how, where and how much a world model should compress. We build CADRE, an open family of causal diffusion representation autoencoders spanning multiple spatio-temporal compressions. Its members differ only in a small bottleneck on frozen features and share a diffusion decoder self-distilled to one or a few steps. We train the same world model on each autoencoder in two domains, manipulation and navigation, with two environments each. CADRE forms most of the latency-quality frontier, especially with a moving camera. Our study also leads to four findings. At strong compression, a diffusion decoder is sharper than perceptual regression. In robot manipulation, temporal compression is more effective in the autoencoder than in the world model. Manipulation and navigation call for opposite compressions: temporal compression costs little when the camera is still, and spatial compression when it moves. Surprisingly, with a still camera, coarser spatial tokens hurt motion far more than image quality. Code, models and a live demo are at https://kyutai.org/blog/2026-10-21-cadre

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 自编码器架构
docs.text: CADRE 的冻结特征提取器、可训练瓶颈与因果扩散解码器。图源：作者论文 · Figure 3 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话
docs.text: 系统拆解交互式世界模型的时空压缩位置，发布 7 种压缩率的因果扩散自编码器 CADRE，并证明 manipulation 与 navigation 的最优压缩方向相反。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 四环境、每种设置 2,048 个 held-out clips，1.2B world model 生成 4.8 秒；42/48 个与 MIRA/Wan/Cosmos/LTX-2 的比较中，CADRE 在相近延迟下指标优于 2% 以上。固定相机机器人操作中，将空间压缩从 16 增至 32 使 FVD 约 2.4×、action recoverability 0.73→0.45；64 秒 rollout 中 CADRE 的 FVD 漂移 0.8–1.8/s，而其他多数为 2.0–2.7/s、Wan 14.5/s。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 每个环境、每个 autoencoder 单独训练 world model；只测生成、动作跟随/可恢复性，没有用规划或策略成功率闭环验证；腕相机移动时未覆盖其预测结论。

docs.text:
它解释了 WAM 的“token 压缩—延迟—动作可辨识性”三者关系，是今天最有基础设施价值的一篇。

docs.title: AW-0
docs.text:
Agentic World Action Models（AW-0）

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM智能体与程序学习记忆与技能

首发 2026-10-21，arXiv:2610.30136 v1  ·  收录于 2026-10-23 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

大系统＋核心方法｜VLA＋WM/WAM＋Agentic coding｜技能/阶段＋低层控制｜桌面双臂

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Recent world action models provide visual foresight and future prediction for robot manipulation, but lack explicit mechanisms for compositional skill reuse. Agentic robotics combines code-based planning and reasoning with reusable skills, but often lacks predictive grounding in physical dynamics. We introduce AW-0, an agentic world action model framework that integrates code-based planning with joint video and action prediction. We jointly model code, future video, and robot actions as three coupled generative streams within a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture. Within this architecture a code expert generates parameterized skill routines and control logic while video and action experts generate future visual states and low-level motor commands. Code serves two complementary roles: it structures multi-step prediction and control within the world model and represents skills as reusable programs for subsequent agentic execution. We further introduce an automated curation pipeline that labels robot and human video trajectories with aligned programs and consolidates recurring routines into reusable skill libraries. Evaluations on RoboTwin 2.0 and physical bimanual manipulation tasks show improved task performance over VLA and WAM baselines, alongside gains in language following, semantic reasoning and robustness, demonstrating that agentic code enables connection between planning, prediction and execution within WAMs.

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: AW-0 的代码、视频与动作三流联合去噪及技能程序执行框架。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话
docs.text: 把代码、未来视频和连续动作做成同一 Mixture-of-Transformers 内的三条耦合生成流，使代码既作为分步计划条件动作预测，也能在通过有效性/进度检查后直接调用技能。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: RoboTwin 2.0 的 50 个任务、每任务 50 次 rollout：AW-0 clean/random 为 80.8%/20.6%，平均 50.7%，高于 π0.5 的 41.3% 与 DreamZero 的 25.6%；hybrid 在 random 达 29.2%，但 clean 降为 63.1%。8 个真实双臂任务、每任务 3×16 次，平均 rubric score 71.1%，最佳基线 DreamZero 为 46.0%。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 真实实验报的是分阶段 rubric score，不等同整任务成功率；随机视觉下默认模式明显退化；预训练约 3,000 小时且自动标注依赖 Gemini/Claude，成本和可复现性较高。

docs.text:

docs.title: FRED
docs.text:
Self-Distilling Future Video Representations for World Action Models（FRED）

世界模型与 WAM

首发 2026-10-21，arXiv:2610.30320 v1；本期因索引延迟补收  ·  收录于 2026-10-24 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

核心方法｜WM/WAM｜低层策略/未来表征｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising approach to learning generalist robot policies using rich spatiotemporal priors from pre-trained video diffusion models. A recent line of WAMs improves inference efficiency by conditioning a separate action decoder on intermediate future video representations extracted from a single denoising step, avoiding costly iterative denoising required for video generation. This design makes action prediction depend directly on the quality of these future representations. In this paper, we introduce Future REpresentation learning via self-Distillation with temporal context (FRED), a framework that trains WAMs to improve the quality of future video representations from noise in a single denoising step. Specifically, FRED uses self-distillation to predict future representations from noise, using representations extracted from ground-truth future observations as targets. We further condition the video model on historical observations, providing temporal context for predicting future representations better. Across diverse real-world manipulation scenarios, FRED consistently outperforms competing WAMs. It achieves particularly large gains on long-horizon and out-of-domain tasks under zero-shot environment generalization, and substantially improves human-to-robot skill transfer, reaching 50.0% task success on tasks absent from robot training data and demonstrated only in human videos, compared with 19.4% for the best competing WAM.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: FRED 利用短历史上下文与动量教师自蒸馏，训练单步未来表征供动作解码器使用。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 不用把视频完整去噪出来，而是让单步噪声预测得到的中间未来表征自蒸馏到真实未来观测表征，并加入短历史上下文，使 action decoder 获得更有控制价值的未来特征。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: DROID 训练后零样本迁移至新真实环境：5B FRED 的长任务进度 46.7%、OOD 成功率 37.5%，最强同规模 WAM 分别为 31.7% 和 10.4%；14B FRED 达 81.7%/52.1%，DreamZero 为 61.7%/10.4%。推理延迟 5B 为 0.136 s、14B 为 0.406 s，后者 DreamZero 为 3.255 s。人类视频联合训练后，新技能任务成功率达到 50.0%，指令跟随 97.2%。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 长任务指标是阶段进度，不是整任务成功率；结果依赖 5B/14B 视频扩散 backbone；没有人类视频联合训练时，人类技能迁移的指令跟随为 0%。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
它把 WAM 的重点从“生成视频”转成“训练单步未来特征服务动作”，比单纯提高视频质量更贴近控制。

基准/诊断＋部署 trick｜VLA/Flow Matching｜低层策略/推理效率｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Flow matching is now the dominant approach for vision-language action (VLA) robot policies, thanks to its expressiveness and simple training objective. However, inference for standard flow matching requires iteratively solving an ODE, limiting the control frequency at deployment. While several works have proposed novel methods to allow for single-shot action generation, we ask whether such additional objectives are actually necessary. We find that across six flow matching VLAs, one-step action generation largely matches multi-step sampling at scale: multi-step integration confers little to no consistent advantage at inference. We empirically find that this holds as long as models are sufficiently trained and have enough capacity. Practically, the implication is that for large VLAs, the single-step policy comes essentially for free from the multi-step model, enabling low-latency deployment without retraining, distillation, or auxiliary objectives.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 单步推理诊断
docs.text: 不同模型与基准上的单步和参考步数成功率对比；对角线附近表示两种推理设置差异较小。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 用配对初始条件和等效性检验系统比较六类 flow-matching VLA 的单步与多步 Euler 推理，发现充分训练的较大模型通常无需专门蒸馏即可单步执行。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 覆盖 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、CALVIN、RoboTwin 和真实 Franka。π0.5 在 LIBERO SGO/10 上单步与十步分别为 98.9% vs 98.5%、94.4% vs 94.4%；动作生成延迟 80→50 ms。真实四任务每模型每设置各 400 次：π0.5 pooled 78.5% vs 79.0%，FLOWER 为 63.2% vs 59.8%。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 结论具有模型规模、预训练和训练充分度条件；小于 1B 或长时分布偏移任务更容易受损；单个真机任务差异最高达 13 点；单步推理会减少有效行为模式多样性，例如 π0.5 在 D3IL 中从 19 种策略降到 8 种。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Humanoid robots must coordinate locomotion and manipulation in everyday environments, yet progress is difficult to assess across differing policies, controllers, and task settings. LocoManiLab provides an integrated testbed spanning data collection and generation, policy training, evaluation, and physical deployment. Its task suite covers 234 atomic and compositional tasks across five household scene categories, supported by 51.5 hours of simulated teleoperation. The evaluation covers twelve policies with a shared controller across task and scene splits and perturbation levels, two policies across five controllers, and studies of demonstration scale and data-source mixtures. Success rates fall on unseen tasks and scenes and generally decline as visual perturbations increase, with differences in generalization and robustness across policies. For data generation, a humanoid motion generation model is fine-tuned for loco-manipulation to study the alignment of its outputs with task execution requirements and its integration into the data generation pipeline. Three simulated loco-manipulation tasks closely match real-world setups, enabling evaluation of three policies in both domains. Similar policy rankings support the reliability of simulation-based evaluation.

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Robust manipulation of soft objects, such as garments, is a critical skill for service and household robots to adopt, but remains challenging due to its high-dimensional state space, and material-dependent deformations. Humans address this challenge by using mental world models that "imagine" the shape and material properties from partial observations, which enables them to predict how actions affect future states. As such, embedding such world models in robots allows for better generalization in manipulating a wide variety of garments in the real world. However, learned world models typically require large amounts of real world data that is strenuous to collect, and a mechanism to infer latent properties that govern dynamics. We present a Soft-Object World Model that performs generative full-state estimation and action-conditioned dynamics prediction using a transformer backbone trained on large-scale simulated soft object interactions, with measures to mitigate the sim-to-real gap. By learning to infer latent shape and material cues through in-context learning over a variable-length partial point-cloud history, the model generalizes across robot embodiments, material parameters, garment types and shapes, and manipulation coordination modes without weight updates. The world model is then integrated with a Goal-Conditioned action planner for motion synthesis. We validate the approach in simulation and real world for bimanual garment folding, reporting improvements in reconstruction fidelity, prediction accuracy, and task success.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

核心方法｜WM/WAM｜低层策略/世界表征｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Robot demonstrations record what the robot saw and what it did. They do not specify how the 3D world changed in between. Scene-level 3D flow describes it by tracking 3D scene points, providing the world representation with 4D geometry. Prior work has used flow to improve robot policies. Flow served as an intermediate prediction that a separate model converts into actions, as a prior injected at inference time, or as an extra output learned together with the action. In all of these designs, flow stays outside the policy, as a separate module or as an extra prediction head. We introduce UniFlowWAM, a Unified World-Action Model that makes 3D scene flow a third modality on par with vision and action. Its world representation therefore covers both visual semantics, through future visual features, and 4D geometry, through 3D flow, and flow receives its own supervision. UniFlowWAM is a diffusion transformer with one expert per modality, and the three experts exchange information through joint attention. We train UniFlowWAM under a ten-objective role grid, where each objective assigns every modality exactly one of three roles, namely target, condition, or absent. The same model thus serves as a policy, as forward and inverse dynamics, and as a predictor of future visual features or 3D flow. We evaluate UniFlowWAM on RoboCasa-GR1, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus in simulation, and on four real-world bimanual manipulation tasks. On RoboCasa-GR1, UniFlowWAM raises the success rate of its base model without flow from 52.1% to 56.4%. It preserves in-distribution success on LIBERO at 98.1% and reaches 87.7% zero-shot on LIBERO-Plus. On the real robot, it achieves 87.0% average success, compared with 68.5% for the strongest baseline.

docs.text: UniFlowWAM 通过三个专家联合建模未来视觉、场景级三维流与动作。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 将未来视觉、连续动作和 3D scene flow 作为同级模态放入统一 flow-matching 模型，通过十种条件—目标组合训练；部署时不需要 flow 输入。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: RoboCasa-GR1、11 个共享种子、每任务每种子 50 次，带 flow mid-training 的平均成功率为 56.38±1.47%，released LDA 为 52.11±2.24%。真实 ALOHA 三任务中，full objectives 达 94%/90%/84%，policy-only 为 76%/76%/72%；每任务主结果 50 次。LIBERO-Plus 延长训练后达到 87.0%。

docs.title: 局限

docs.text:

核心方法＋基准｜VLA＋Agent memory｜规划/观测/低层策略｜移动操作（Unitree G1）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Humanoid loco-manipulation in dynamic scenes is non-Markovian: cues vanish as objects change or are hidden, or leave the view as the robot turns and walks, yet whole-body vision-language-action (VLA) policies see only the present. We present WholeBodyMem, an object-guided perceptual memory that keeps the pre-history of object events seen before the robot acts on its goal. SAM3 tracks the task objects, and their events causally select key frames within an adaptive budget, which the action expert reads by cross-attention together with object tokens encoding appearance, geometry and time. We also contribute HuMeGo, a humanoid memory benchmark with six simulated and six real-world Unitree G1 tasks. Keeping the right frames rather than more frames, WholeBodyMem surpasses memoryless and uniform-memory baselines, raising its base policy's success from 29.1% to 72.6% in simulation and from 36.7% to 88.3% on the real robot, while also improving the standard SIMPLE tasks (70.2% to 86.9%).

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: WholeBodyMem 通过 SAM3 选择历史物体事件，并把物体记忆注入全身 VLA 的动作专家。图源：作者论文 · Figure 3 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: WholeBodyMem 用冻结 SAM3 检测物体出现、消失、移动和形变事件，以因果方式选择关键历史帧，并通过 action-side cross-attention 把原生视觉 token 与物体的外观、几何和时间信息送入全身 VLA。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 新建 HuMeGo：6 个仿真和 6 个真实 G1 记忆型移动操作任务。仿真成功率由无记忆的 29.1% 提升到 72.6%；真实任务每项 10 次，总计由 22/60 提升到 53/60（88.3%）；在标准 SIMPLE 14 任务上也从 70.2% 提升到 86.9%。消融显示相对均匀记忆的 28.2 点增益中，关键帧选择贡献 16.0 点。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 记忆选择依赖 SAM3 和预先给出的任务物体；仿真演示由脚本、cuRobo 与 AMO 控制器生成；真实任务每项仅 10 次，仍属于固定任务集。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
这是今天与 mobile manipulation 最直接的一篇：它不只存机器人执行历史，而是处理机器人转身、行走后已经离开视野的短暂环境线索。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-language-action (VLA) models have become an important paradigm for robotic manipulation by unifying visual perception, language understanding, and action generation. Since reliable manipulation requires sufficient observation of objects, end-effectors, and their spatial relationships, multi-view inputs are widely used to provide complementary spatial information. However, our experiments show that existing VLA models do not fully exploit such multi-view complementarity. The policy tends to persistently rely on the wrist view, lacking the ability to dynamically adjust global-local view dependency across manipulation stages, which limits stage adaptability and robustness. To address this issue, we propose FocusVLA, a stage-aware multi-view routing framework. FocusVLA predicts future interaction intent from historical actions and uses it to guide dynamic view routing during action generation. By adaptively coordinating global and local observations across different task stages, FocusVLA improves multi-view utilization. On RoboTwin 2.0, FocusVLA improves the average success rate over the strongest baseline $π_{0.5}$ by 10.10 pp. In real-world evaluation, FocusVLA improves the success rate from 71.7\% to 85.0\%, achieving a 13.3\% gain over $π_{0.5}$. Moreover, the intent prediction and dynamic routing modules of FocusVLA can be integrated into existing VLA frameworks without modifying their core architectures.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: FocusVLA 利用历史动作预测未来意图，再动态路由全局与腕部视角特征。图源：作者论文 · Figure 4 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 从历史动作预测未来交互意图，再按未来 action step 动态调节全局相机与腕部相机的使用比例，避免多视角 VLA 始终依赖同一视角。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: RoboTwin 2.0 全 50 任务、每任务 100 次，平均成功率 76.92%，π0.5 为 66.82%；Piper 六个真实任务、每任务 30 次，85.0%，π0.5 为 71.7%。消融中动态 intent routing 为 73.7%，静态融合 67.5%，无显式 intent 监督仅 55.7%。

docs.title: 局限

docs.text:

大系统/系统集成｜Agent＋VLA｜规划/验证/恢复｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Agentic robot systems combine language-model reasoning with robot policies to monitor execution and recover from failures. However, reviewing every action chunk incurs substantial overhead, even in familiar situations. We introduce FastHarness, an experience-driven execution harness that adaptively schedules GPT-6 Astra supervision of a π0.5 policy. A fast path uses stage memory and reviewed outcomes to reduce review frequency as experience accumulates, while a complementary recovery path focuses supervision on correcting errors. Once recovery is verified, routine execution resumes, with failure experience retained to guide future interventions. The policy remains frozen and generates fresh actions from current observations. Across four simulated manipulation tasks, reviewer token use decreases by an average of 57.2% per task from the first evaluated episode to the mean of the final five episodes. Mean episode time decreases from 85.5 to 52.0 minutes over the same interval. On the same tasks, mean success increases from 80% for GPT-as-Policy (π0.5 + GPT-6 Astra) to 97.19% with FastHarness. These results highlight adaptive supervision as a practical route to more efficient agentic robotics without additional model training.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: FastHarness 的经验驱动快速路径、原始逐段审核路径与错误恢复路径。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 让 GPT-6 Astra 不再审核每一个 π0.5 action chunk，而是根据阶段记忆、已验证结果和失败经验决定何时进入 fast path、何时持续接管恢复。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 四个 RoboDojo 仿真任务中，从首个 episode 到最后五次平均，reviewer token 使用量下降 57.2%，均值从 1.83M 降至 0.93M；episode 时间从 85.5 分钟降至 52.0 分钟；平均成功率 97.19%，论文引用的 GPT-as-Policy 基线为 80%。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 仅有四个仿真任务；绝对运行时间仍非常高；成功率基线来自外部 GPT-as-Policy 报告，不是所有因素都严格匹配；依赖特定云端 reviewer 和硬件延迟。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
这是典型 agentic 系统问题：真正的瓶颈未必是 reviewer 能不能发现错误，而是怎样减少无必要审核又保留恢复能力。

核心方法｜VLA｜低层控制＋观测/验证/恢复｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Recognizing task completion and failure enables robots to stop upon success and initiate recovery or replanning after failure. Existing methods augment Vision Language Action (VLA) policies with task status signal prediction to support these execution decisions. However, learning and integrating these signals can require fine-grained supervision, external monitoring models, or complex architectural designs. Moreover, the potential of task status signals to directly guide action generation remains underexplored. We present Echo, a framework that combines task status signal learning without frame-level progress annotations with a compact design for status prediction and action generation within a single VLA. Specifically, Echo represents task status with stop and failure signals, added as two dimensions of each action chunk and denoised together with robot actions. Their combination distinguishes ongoing execution, successful completion, and failure. To learn these signals without fine-grained progress annotations, Echo constructs successful, failed, and recovery trajectories with complementary supervision properties. To enable status signal-guided action generation, Echo controls interactions between the signals and actions and denoises the signals faster than the actions. These allow later action denoising steps to condition on cleaner status estimates while preserving accurate signal prediction. Extensive real-world manipulation experiments show that Echo accurately predicts task status and consistently improves policy performance.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: Echo 的四类训练数据、停止/失败信号构造、注意力掩码与异步联合去噪。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 把 stop 和 failure 两个状态信号直接追加到 action chunk 中联合去噪，并让状态信号先于动作变干净，从而同时支持终止判断、故障识别和恢复动作生成。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 五个真实任务、每模型每任务 30 次；任务完成得分（0–10）在 Insert Flower 上由 5.67 提升到 8.33，Insert Pen 6.87→8.60，Open Drawer 5.40→7.90；对应的轨迹级状态 Macro-F1 为 90.0%–100%。LIBERO-Recovery 4,500 次仿真中，整任务成功率由 32.67% 小幅升至 34.76%，帧级状态准确率 89.97%。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 真实实验主要报告 0–10 阶段完成得分，而非二元整任务成功；训练需额外的失败轨迹、介入前片段和恢复示范；增加终止失败数据会改善识别，但并未明显继续提高执行分数。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
相较外挂 verifier，Echo 把“现在是否失败/该不该停”变成动作生成本身可读取和干预的变量。

模块/trick＋诊断｜VLA｜观测/验证｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can perform diverse manipulation tasks directly from visual observations and natural language instructions, but they remain prone to mistakes and unpredictable failures. Deploying these policies without continuous human supervision will require robust runtime monitors that detect when the policy has gone off-course. Existing monitors use external foundation models, such as vision-language models (VLMs) to supervise the policy, introducing significant complexity and computational cost for monitoring at runtime. In this work, we investigate an alternate approach: \textit{can a VLA's own internal activations provide the information needed to monitor its execution?} Our method trains linear probes on policy activations from demonstrations to estimate progress, then flags executions that deviate from expected progress. In experiments with the open-source VLA $π_{0.5}$ and across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, this approach is competitive with or outperforms VLM-based monitors in task failure detection, as well as methods which require failure data for training. These findings suggest that simple probes of VLA internals can be used to develop reliable runtime monitors, opening a path toward building policies that can act reliably and monitor their execution without external foundation models.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: Progress Probes 从 VLA 内部激活线性解码进度，并用正常进度轨迹监测运行时偏离。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 只用成功示范，在 VLA 内部激活上训练线性进度 probe；运行时把预测进度与正常进度轨迹比较，以检测策略是否偏离。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 仿真 VLABench 中 episode/state AUROC 为 0.909/0.788，未见任务为 0.900/0.794；单次监控延迟约 0.026 ms。Franka 六项真实任务、共 120 个平衡成功/失败 rollout，平均 state AUROC 为 0.81，高于各基线的 0.46–0.69；20 种三任务留出组合上仍为 0.81。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 只验证 π0.5，主要 probe VLM backbone 而非 action expert；真实评测的成功/失败比例被人为平衡，失败起点需要人工标注；它只检测，不负责恢复。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
这是很干净、成本极低的运行时 monitor，说明 VLA 内部已编码相当可用的任务进度信号。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

The life-cycle of robotics foundation models crucially depends on data labels. Outcome reward labels are needed for monitoring real-world deployments. Process reward labels are needed during RL post-training. Timestamped captions are needed for filtering and balancing pretraining data. We present Flora, an industrial-quality data engine used for training GR00T models, that simultaneously covers these capabilities. Flora achieves SOTA scores on the captioning benchmark WGO-Bench and reward benchmarks RoboReward and Robometer. On internal benchmarks it is competitive with GPT-6 Astra while beating other frontier models. The model is substantially cheaper than API-based alternatives, roughly 125 times cheaper than GPT-6 Astra. Florais battle tested at scale, labeling 200,000 hours of data per day across 512 GB300s. By open-sourcing our data engine, we enable researchers to scale custom robotics datasets and explore emerging applications such as physical auto-research and human-to-robot transfer.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 数据引擎能力
docs.text: FLORA 将视频分段并生成带时间戳的描述，同时支持结果奖励、过程奖励与测试时指定的评分规则。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 提供一套开源机器人数据引擎，用三个模型统一生成时间戳动作描述、过程奖励、结果奖励和可配置 rubric 分数。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: WGO-Bench 的 segmentation/joint/caption 分别为 50.3/34.5/64.7；DenseCaptionBench Robot200 joint F1 为 51.0%，Astra 为 57.9%，下一基线为 33.6%。8×GB300 估算每小时视频成本 0.72 美元、质量 57.1%，Astra 为 88.49 美元/53.7%；实际规模达 512×GB300、每天标注约 20 万小时。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 这是标注/奖励模型而非控制策略，未隔离证明其标签对下游成功率的提升；不同系统视觉输入与推理预算不完全等价；工业吞吐依赖极大算力。

docs.text:

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Coding agents can translate language instructions into robot programs. For contact-rich manipulation, a key challenge is to generate and refine control logic that responds to physical interaction. We present FORCA, a coding agent that takes visual observations and wrist force/torque (F/T) measurements as input to write Python programs for contact probing and force-responsive motion. Between executions, the agent inspects force records alongside visual outcomes to diagnose failures and revise both motion and force-feedback control logic. FORCA requires no demonstrations, task-specific training, or simulation. Across five real-robot tasks, we demonstrate its effectiveness in three forms of contact-rich manipulation: improving manipulation accuracy, adapting to changes in object or surface properties, and regulating contact under surface variation and object motion. Compared with a vision-only variant of the same agent, FORCA improves grasp accuracy and task success and reduces contact loss in wiping and peeling.

EgoForesight: Effectively Scaling Policy Learning with Noisy Egocentric Actions

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Scaling policy learning requires broad experience and reliable supervision. Robot demonstrations provide high-quality trajectory supervision but are costly to collect. Egocentric videos broaden task and environment coverage, yet motion reconstruction and retargeting introduce noisy action labels. To address this challenge, we introduce EgoForesight, a vision-language-action framework that learns jointly from both sources by reducing the influence of unreliable action labels and exploiting demonstrated outcomes as complementary supervision. A joint vision-action flow couples future visual representation prediction with action generation, unifying reliability-aware action learning with outcome-informed representation transfer. Specifically, reliability-conditioned corruption allocates action supervision across noise levels according to source reliability, while reliability-weighted regression regulates each source's contribution. Complementing this treatment of noisy labels, privileged-future representation distillation draws supervision from demonstrated outcomes. An exponential-moving-average teacher observes the current scene and clean future to encode action-relevant structure from the resulting scene change. Its deeper representations supervise an earlier student layer receiving a corrupted future, providing outcome-informed structure beyond noisy action annotations. Together, these mechanisms support effective scaling with noisy egocentric actions. Over the tested range, EgoForesight exhibits steeper scaling slopes than the baseline, reducing real-world open-loop action MSE by 20.5% and improving RoboCasa few-shot success by 8.1 percentage points at 30,000 hours of pretraining data. After post-training, it also achieves strong absolute performance in both simulated and real-world dexterous manipulation.

基准/诊断＋工程 trick｜VLA｜训练稳定性｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

When a vision-language-action (VLA) model is fine-tuned with its trainable weights in bfloat16 (bf16) and no fp32 master copy, AdamW writes each update straight into bf16, silently rounding away any update smaller than 1/512 of a weight. In 9 of 12 open VLA codebases a default or documented recipe trains this way, 4 on full weight matrices, including LeRobot's SmolVLA default and its $π_0$/$π_{0.5}$ guides. In our LIBERO runs without the copy, a probe every 100 steps finds at least 79% of updates to bf16 weights erased. On the Hugging Face Hub, 99% of sampled full-weight SmolVLA fine-tunes store the action expert in bf16, and 84% of recent $π_{0.5}$ fine-tunes with a training configuration set the bf16 flag. On LIBERO-Object, with rules fixed in advance, an fp32 copy raises success over LeRobot's storage from 4.3% to 49.3% for SmolVLA and from 5.1% to 80.9% for $π_{0.5}$ at a ten-times lower learning rate, where both models are undertrained, and from 89.0% to 97.7% for $π_{0.5}$ at its default rate. For SmolVLA at its default rate it adds 10.2 points with open-loop 50-action chunks but only 4.2 when re-planning every 10 actions. In these five comparisons and two more against SmolVLA with every trainable weight in bf16, every run with the copy beats every run without it (p < 0.05); all gaps but the 8.7- and 4.2-point ones clear our 10-point threshold. The fix is to keep the trainable weights in fp32 during training, a one-line change for SmolVLA in LeRobot.

docs.text: 12 个开源 VLA codebase 中 9 个存在相关默认/文档设置；LIBERO probe 显示至少 79% 更新被擦除。LIBERO-Object 上，fp32 copy 在低学习率时把 SmolVLA 从 4.3% 提至 49.3%、π0.5 从 5.1% 提至 80.9%；π0.5 默认学习率从 89.0% 提至 97.7%。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 仅两个模型、一个 suite；SmolVLA 每设置 3 seeds、π0.5 仅 2 seeds，训练日程缩短；没有分离 bf16 moments 与 bf16 weights 的各自影响。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Flow-matching Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models generate expressive continuous trajectories for robotic manipulation, yet balancing real-time responsiveness with execution stability remains a persistent challenge. Standard deployment workflows typically treat numerical solver depth and execution horizon as decoupled choices. The horizon amortizes inference latency, while solver depth is kept high to preserve integration fidelity. In this paper, we reveal a fundamental compute-execution coupling in flow-matching VLAs governed by a systematic sign reversal. While coarse numerical integration degrades precision under rapid replanning, it markedly improves task performance under extended open-loop commitment. Geometrically, numerical truncation contracts lateral action dispersion around an invariant trajectory centroid, serving as an implicit regularizer that suppresses compounding open-loop drift. Across LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world Franka manipulation on representative VLA backbones including $π_0$, $π_{0.5}$, and GR00T, exploiting this joint coupling consistently achieves superior task success while drastically lowering inference latency, entirely training-free and without architectural modifications. These findings establish numerical sampling depth as an operational variance regulator, shifting its role from a static precision budget to an active deployment knob in robot learning. Project page: https://jiabingyang01.github.io/Horizon-Depth-VLA/

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.text: 流匹配策略的求解步数与动作执行前缀共同决定采样分散程度、重规划频率与漂移累积。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 指出 flow solver 深度与 action execution horizon 不能独立调：浅采样会压缩动作横向方差，长 open-loop 时反而抑制漂移，但短闭环时会损失反应性。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 与 Franka 五任务；真机每任务 50 demos，四配置×三模型×40 matched trials，共 2400 rollouts。全 chunk 执行下，N=2 相对深 solver 的绝对增益为 π0 +10.0、π0.5 +6.9、GR00T N1.7 +11.3 个百分点；π0 的 (s=50,N=2) 把 NFE/step 从 1.0 降至 0.04。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 动态转盘任务中 open-loop 无论采样深度都灾难性失败；结论依赖任务几何，窄插入仍需要短 horizon＋深积分；它是部署配置规律，不是新的策略学习方法。

大系统＋诊断｜VLA｜低层联合控制/部署｜移动操作（腿式底座＋机械臂）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-language-action (VLA) models are typically pretrained on broad, diverse datasets and subsequently fine-tuned on a comparatively small dataset tailored to a specific target robot. Such adaptation recipe is now widely established, achieving its most mature results on fixed-base arms due to their static base dynamics and consistent reference frame. Mounting the same arm on a quadruped extends the workspace to the entire floor, but fundamentally changes the embodiment: rather than controlling the arm in isolation, the policy must jointly coordinate base navigation, body posture, and end-effector motion. In this work, we study the practical demands of this embodiment change across data collection, model adaptation, and inference design to achieve closed-loop loco-manipulation on a Unitree Go2 with an AgileX Piper arm. We report the choices that made this real-robot deployment feasible, namely model variant, action horizon, and demonstration conventions, together with a study tailored to a pick-and-place task, separating data coverage from model capacity. We show that expanding demonstration coverage reduces held-out end-effector error by 30%, and incorporating secondary skills (such as pushing rather than grasping) introduces new behavioral modes without degrading baseline performance. Finally, closed-loop real-world experiments show how dataset composition shapes success and failure, validating the pipeline for more complex loco-manipulation.

DynaSlots: Slot-Centric 3D Dynamics Pretraining for Robot Manipulation

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Robot manipulation involves localized changes: picking up a cup moves the cup while leaving the surrounding scene largely unchanged. Yet existing 3D visual pretraining methods, including recent dynamics-aware variants, model state transitions at the scene level, compressing the motion of everything in a scene into a single global latent action. This conflates semantically distinct transitions in scenes with multiple moving parts, obscures dependencies between changing regions, and leaves the learned representation vulnerable to task-irrelevant scene content. We introduce DynaSlots, an action-free, label-free pretraining framework that decomposes each point cloud frame into a small set of temporally consistent slots and models dynamics at this per-slot level rather than the scene level. A temporal slot propagation module promotes consistent slot assignments across frames; an inverse dynamics model then extracts one latent action per slot from feature differences, and a diffusion-based forward dynamics model, paired with a self-supervised interaction head, predicts each slot's future state while learning pairwise proximity-and-motion relations. Experiments on Meta-World, Adroit, and a RealMan RM65-B robot demonstrate that DynaSlots outperforms prior scene-level baselines. It achieves superior success rates in simulation and exhibits strong robustness to scene clutter and unseen objects in real-world manipulation. Code is available at \href{https://zhucezhanghao12345-source.github.io/DynaSlots-Anonymous/}{https://zhucezhanghao12345-source.github.io/DynaSlots-Anonymous/}.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Many manipulation tasks require a robot to remember what it has done and what it has seen. Frontier vision-language models can plan such tasks without task-specific training, but how such a planner should remember an episode is an open question. We argue that its memory must keep track of what the planner has done and learned, and must let the planner choose what to look at, since every frame costs tokens; a note rewritten at every step meets both poorly. We propose LogLook, whose execution-grounded memory lets the system keep the record, an execution log and the model's earlier notes, while the model decides where to look: frames are returned only where it expects a change, and demonstrations are skimmed before it inspects the parts it chooses. Measured with the benchmark's motion planner, LogLook matches the success of a note-only memory with 43% fewer tokens and less than half the images, and fails far fewer episodes through what it remembered or saw. With direct control, LogLook solves 93.5% of the RoboMME test set.

docs.text: RoboMME 中，motion-planner 执行时为 237/256（92.6%），note-only 为 234/256（91.4%），但每回合 token 从 71.3k 降至 40.5k、图像从 114 降至 46；使用同一 π0.5 executor 时双方均为 104/128（81.2%），说明低层执行器成为瓶颈。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 仅仿真、单一 frontier model；直接控制使用 depth、camera calibration 和源自 benchmark success code 的 task notes，信息条件优于 learned-memory baselines；配置仅每 episode 跑一次。

docs.title: If at First You Don’t Succeed, Backtrack
docs.text:
If at First You Don’t Succeed, Backtrack: Lightweight Recovery for Frozen VLAs

VLA 与策略学习

首发 2026-10-23，v1  ·  收录于 2026-10-27 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

本次未在已核验的原论文与摘要中找到作者项目主页或代码入口。配图由原论文 SVG 渲染为 PNG。 （2026-10-29 核查）

模块/trick＋诊断｜VLA｜验证/恢复｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models perform well on robotic manipulation, yet remain brittle once their own actions carry them into states their training data barely covers. Recovering from such failures usually requires recovery demonstrations, policy retraining, or a separate model at inference time. We introduce Backtrack, a lightweight failure detection and recovery mechanism for frozen VLAs that needs none of these. A small failure prediction head, trained only on outcome-labeled rollouts of the frozen policy, reads the VLA's existing internal representations to estimate whether the current episode will fail. When the predicted failure probability exceeds a threshold, a controller pauses the policy, retraces the arm's recently achieved motion, and hands control back to the unchanged policy so it can retry from an earlier configuration. The head adds only 0.48-0.88% to the policy's parameter count. We evaluate Backtrack on LIBERO with three VLAs spanning two action-generation families: SmolVLA and $π$0.5, which use flow-matching action experts, and the autoregressive $π$0-FAST. On LIBERO-Long, the suite of long-horizon multi-step tasks and the one on which all three policies fail most often, Backtrack reduces each policy's failure rate by 19-48%, raising success by up to 7.4 percentage points; on the three shorter suites, where control success is already 85-99%, its effect is smaller. On MetaWorld, all twelve controller configurations tested with SmolVLA improve on the unassisted policy.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 失败预测头读取冻结 VLA 的特征；触发阈值后控制器沿近期实际手臂运动回退，再交回原策略。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 在冻结 VLA 表征上训练 0.48–0.88% 参数量的失败头，触发后沿已执行轨迹回退，再把控制交还原策略重试。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: LIBERO 每任务 5 seeds×50 episodes。LIBERO-Long 上 SmolVLA 61.0%＋7.4 点、π0.5 94.72%＋1.6 点、π0-FAST 85.32%＋7.08 点，对应失败率减少 19.0%/30.3%/48.2%；MetaWorld 的 12 个控制器配置全部改善。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 全部为仿真；回退不恢复物体或环境状态，且可能二次碰撞；对不可逆失败或需要新策略的失败无能为力；配置在 LIBERO-Long 的部分 seeds 上选择。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
它给出了极低成本恢复基线，适合判断复杂 recovery agent 的增益是否真的超过“检测后退一步再试”。

RynnUnify: Towards Unified Embodied Brain

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM智能体与程序学习

首发 2026-10-23，v1  ·  收录于 2026-10-27 日报

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

We introduce RynnUnify, a 16B unified embodied model that combines strong embodied understanding with long-horizon visual planning through interleaved video--language reasoning. With capabilities spanning spatial reasoning, physical prediction, and grounding, RynnUnify connects an understanding of the physical world with visual anticipation of how it evolves across successive subtasks. Building on these capabilities, we further develop an agentic extension through reinforcement learning to selectively use video predictions for reasoning about unobserved states and interaction outcomes. We also develop a world-action extension of the full RynnUnify model, translating its understanding and prediction capabilities into robot control. To evaluate these capabilities, we introduce Rynn-VP and Rynn-GEU for long-horizon visual planning and anticipatory reasoning. Experiments show that RynnUnify achieves the highest average embodied understanding score among the evaluated unified multimodal models and improves the Rynn-VP overall score by 9.75 points over Cosmos 3 Nano. Its agentic extension improves the Rynn-GEU average by 6.0 points over direct reasoning, while the world-action extension achieves 51.5\% success on 20 selected composite RoboCasa365 tasks and 46.7\% average success across three real-robot tasks. Together, these results establish RynnUnify as a shared foundation for embodied understanding, visual planning, and robot control, taking a step toward a unified embodied brain.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 自回归推理器与视频生成器通过联合注意力交互，场景记忆与时间前缀支持连续视频生成。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 把 8B 自回归 reasoner 与 8B 视频生成器通过联合注意力连接，并分别扩展为可选择调用视频预测的 agent 与读取视频隐状态的 world-action policy。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: RoboCasa365 的 20 个精选复合任务成功率 51.5%，高于 CMA 47.0%、Xiaomi-Robotics-1 46.0%；Composite-Unseen 为 50.0%，CMA 为 44.0%。Astribot S1 三个真机任务平均成功率 46.7%，π0.5 为 25.0%，GR00T N1.7 为 26.7%。其 agentic 版本在 Rynn-GEU 上由 44.0 提升至 50.0。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 16B 计算量高；“统一”包含后续 agent/WAM 扩展，不等于一个零改动 checkpoint 同时完成全部任务；真机只有三项任务，项目页未给出逐任务试次数；20-task 结果是筛选子集，应与完整 RoboCasa365 分开看。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

We present MOTIO, an agentic skill-engineering system that turns ordinary human-action videos, reality-grounded 3D assets, motion references, and reusable robot skills into executable humanoid loco-manipulation programs. Through in-context task and contact reasoning, an agent constructs staged robot-native interactions and improves them using physics execution, multi-frame feedback, and human validation---without task-specific teleoperation or robot demonstration collection. Agentic 3D supplies metric product and environment assets, while existing whole-body, inverse-kinematics, and dexterous-hand interfaces realize the programs. Across 33 timestamped first approvals, the median recorded agent-turn time is 97.0 minutes and request-to-approval duration is 2.80 hours. Simulation-side layout and object variation prepare a long-horizon bottle-disposal skill for a continuous 101.75-second physical G1 execution in a scanned office; physical refinement reduces screw-tightening thread residual by 76.0%. Agent-generated skills additionally supervise BC/DAgger distillation into one shared reference policy, completing 18 simulated tasks under the same checkpoint without inference-time expert intervention. Project page: https://iiiiqiiii.github.io/motio/

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: MOTIO 从经审核的资产生成受视频和技能条件约束的程序，通过仿真、多帧反馈及人工实机验证形成技能库。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话核心贡献
docs.text: 把人类动作视频、3D 资产、动作参考和现有控制器交给 agent，通过物理执行、多帧反馈和人工验收迭代出可执行 humanoid 技能，并可蒸馏成共享策略。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 33 个首次获批技能的中位 agent-turn 时间 97 分钟、请求到批准 2.80 小时；31 个 bottle-disposal 仿真布局全通过，G1 完成 101.75 秒连续实体执行；螺纹残差下降 76%，共享 BC/DAgger checkpoint 在仿真完成 18 个任务。

docs.title: 相对已有工作的真实新意
docs.text: 把 agentic coding 的交付物从一次性代码推进到“经物理验证的技能工程流程+可蒸馏参考”，覆盖移动、接触、工具和材料任务。

docs.text: 核心闭环依赖人工反馈与最终批准；实体证据主要是精选连续演示而非多随机初始条件的成功率，也缺少同预算强基线。开发耗时以 wall-clock/agent-turn 报告，不等于自主性。

RoboLongR: Causally Consistent Rewards Teach Robots to Progressively Master Long-Horizon Manipulation

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM智能体与程序学习

首发 2026-10-24，v1（最新索引批次补收）  ·  收录于 2026-10-28 日报

核心方法｜WM/WAM（reward model）+ Agent式在线修正｜低层策略学习 + 阶段进度｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Long-horizon manipulation requires actions whose validity depends on earlier interactions, yet visual progress can conceal missing task prerequisites. We propose RoboLongR, an offline-to-online framework that learns history-dependent rewards to guide policy adaptation to new tasks. Its central objective is causal consistency: aligning rewarded progress with prerequisites supported by execution history. Stage-shuffle supervision encourages execution-order sensitivity, recurrent memory preserves evidence of earlier interactions, and two-round training refines trajectory segments using predicted progress. The resulting rewards guide stage-conditioned policy refinement from behavior cloning to online reinforcement learning. Sparse terminal feedback connects policy experience to reward learning by triggering correction for repeated high-scoring failures. Pretrained on demonstrations from 88 RLBench tasks and Open-X data, RoboLongR achieves 31.8% average success on 18 long-horizon tasks excluded from reward pretraining, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 9.2 percentage points. Across four real-robot tasks, it achieves 57.5% success, a 32.5-percentage-point improvement over the comparison method. Reward-level controls probe sensitivity to synthetic order perturbations, while ablations examine the contributions of individual components to policy improvement.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 奖励自适应分段提供阶段顺序监督；策略适配结合粗阶段标签、在线历史奖励查询与高分失败后的奖励修正。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话核心贡献
docs.text: 用 stage-shuffle、循环记忆和在线失败修正学习依赖执行历史的奖励，避免“视觉上看起来完成、但前置步骤没做”的假进度。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 88 个 RLBench 任务与 Open-X 预训练后，在 18 个未用于 reward pretraining 的长时任务、3 seeds、每任务每 seed 50 次评测上为 31.8%，ReWiND 22.6%；Franka 四任务每项 10 次，整任务 23/40=57.5%，ReWiND 10/40=25.0%。

docs.title: 相对已有工作的真实新意
docs.text: 重点不是生成动作的 VLA，而是让奖励对顺序和历史证据敏感，再驱动 BC→PPO 适配；项目页明确说明这不是恢复因果图。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 不是 zero-shot：目标任务有示范并进行在线 PPO；真实任务每项 10 次、由单个盲法标注者判定。合成 shuffle 可能泄露边界线索、惩罚合法顺序，整段修正也可能压低有效前缀。

docs.text:

docs.text:
X-World: Transferring Video Priors to Variable-View Robot Control

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM

首发 2026-10-25，v1（最新索引批次补收）  ·  收录于 2026-10-28 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

作者 GitHub 仓库用于项目网页与论文文档，当前未提供模型实现；其中 scripts 为站点维护脚本。 （2026-10-29 核查）

核心方法｜VLA + WM/WAM｜低层控制/策略学习｜桌面双臂操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Video diffusion models provide a source of interaction representations for robot control, but transferring these representations requires reconciling variable camera inputs with heterogeneous action interfaces and closed-loop execution. We present X-World, a framework that transfers a video prior through a fixed-length token sequence to a shared action expert. A residual cross-view attention branch extends a pretrained video backbone to one, two, or three views while retaining its original self-attention path. A layer-aligned Q-Former aggregates backbone features, and dataset-specific modules map between native state and action interfaces and the shared action expert. Training separates video adaptation from action-only pretraining by freezing the video backbone in the latter stage, followed by joint target-domain post-training. The policy extracts video features with a single backbone pass and uses asynchronous action chunking for execution. On LIBERO, X-World reaches 98.5\% mean success; its LIBERO-trained checkpoint obtains 76.5\% on LIBERO-Plus without further adaptation. The seven-shift breakdown reveals gains in robot, language, lighting, and layout perturbations, alongside weaknesses under camera, background, and noise shifts relative to OpenVLA-OFT. On six dual-arm real-world tasks, it achieves 81.7\% mean success over 20 trials per task. Removing video adaptation or cross-view fusion produces the largest observed success drops among the tested removals.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 视频骨干经多视角数据适配后，由逐层对齐的 Q-Former 将表征压缩为动作 DiT 的条件。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话核心贡献
docs.text: 用 residual cross-view attention 让视频 backbone 接受 1–3 视角，再由 layer-aligned Q-Former 和共享 action expert 对接不同数据集/动作接口。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: LIBERO 98.5%，LIBERO-Plus 零适配 76.5%（OpenVLA-OFT 69.6%）；真实双 UR5e 六任务每项 20 次，合计 98/120=81.7%，高于 X-VLA 58.3%、Genie-Envisioner 51.7%、π0.5 45.0%。

docs.title: 相对已有工作的真实新意
docs.text: 创新点是可变视角视频先验的接口与融合，而不是新的世界预测损失；异步 action chunking 用于闭环执行。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 每任务只收 30 分钟遥操作数据，真实评测仅一个固定双臂平台；在相机、背景和噪声 shift 上反而弱于 OpenVLA-OFT，且基线预训练数据/算力未控制。

docs.title: RoboDuo
docs.text:
RoboDuo: Attempt, Check and Atomic Recovery through Code for Vision-Language-Action Models

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能

首发 2026-10-25，v1（最新索引批次补收）  ·  收录于 2026-10-28 日报

大系统 + 模块/trick + 数据｜VLA + Agent/agentic coding｜技能/阶段 + 规划/观测/验证｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map a language instruction and the current observation directly to actions, without checking whether the instruction has been completed. For long-horizon tasks, a single failed step therefore goes unnoticed and leaves the whole task unfinished. Such failed episodes, however, often end with the task partially complete. Moreover, the unfinished steps are reusable atomic skills that recur across demonstrations. A failed attempt can thus be recovered by composing with atomic skills. We propose RoboDuo, a closed-loop dual-system framework that uses code as the interface between a coding agent and two VLAs. The agent writes a program that lets a full-task VLA attempt the whole task and checks whether it is complete; on failure, an atomic VLA finishes the remaining steps. Since the agent emits no actions and only decides which VLA for execution, RoboDuo wraps an existing full-task VLA without updating its weights. To train the atomic VLA and the coding agent with the completion-checking ability, we build LIBERO-Atomic, LIBERO-Code, and LIBERO-Judge from a single set of LIBERO demonstrations. RoboDuo consistently improves X-VLA and $π_{0.5}$ on LIBERO and LIBERO-PRO, with the largest gains on long-horizon tasks, and recovers failed rollouts of a frozen full-task VLA on a real robot.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 生成程序先调用整任务 VLA；未完成时切换为经目标验证、允许有限重试的原子动作计划。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话核心贡献
docs.text: 让 coding agent 生成“先让整任务 VLA 尝试—检查完成—失败后调用 atomic VLA 补步骤”的程序，在不改整任务 VLA 权重的情况下加入闭环恢复。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: LIBERO Long 上 X-VLA 87.4→91.6、π0.5 93.6→96.2，分别消除 33% 和 41% 失败；真实双臂水果整理三种布局共 30 次，整任务成功由 11/30 升至 16/30，平均入篮数量也提升。

docs.title: 相对已有工作的真实新意
docs.text: 不是再训练一个更强端到端策略，而是用代码把 frozen full-task VLA、完成判定和原子技能拼成可恢复双系统，并构造 LIBERO-Atomic/Code/Judge 数据。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 真实系统用 GPT-6 Astra 判断抓取与篮中数量，属于强外部/特权验证器；atomic VLA 另需遥操作片段训练，单步最多重试 3 次。标准 LIBERO 平均增益约 1.15 pp，主要价值集中在长链和失败恢复。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
今天与“验证—恢复—技能编排”最直接的一篇，且诚实展示了监控器在真实部署中的作用。

docs.title: RynnVLA-Latent

docs.title: RynnVLA-Latent
docs.text:
RynnVLA-Latent: Scaling Robotic Manipulation Foundation Models with 3D-Grounded Latent Actions

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM移动操作

首发 2026-10-25，v1（最新索引批次补收）  ·  收录于 2026-10-28 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

官方仓库已提供实现；模型权重通过作者提供的独立模型平台入口发布，不在 Git 仓库内。 （2026-10-29 核查）

核心方法 + 数据｜VLA / WM-WAM｜低层控制/策略学习｜桌面操作 + 移动操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Scaling vision-language-action (VLA) models is constrained by scarce action-labeled demonstrations and incompatible control spaces across robot embodiments. We present RynnVLA-Latent, a framework that turns heterogeneous interaction videos into scalable supervision for robot policy pretraining. At its core, RynnLAM learns continuous, 3D-grounded latent actions from visual transitions without requiring native robot controls. By combining residual future-feature prediction, camera-compensated 3D-flow supervision, and camera-motion decoupling, RynnLAM encourages representations that capture control-relevant motion rather than appearance changes alone. We apply RynnLAM to 30.1K hours of human, robot, and simulation videos, producing 745.52M latent-action descriptors. RynnVLA-Latent then learns to predict latent-action chunks from visual observations and language through flow matching, before adapting its pretrained backbone and action expert to embodiment-specific robot actions. The resulting 4B policy achieves 98.8% success on LIBERO, 84.7% on LIBERO-Plus without benchmark-specific adaptation, 51.9% average success across five VLABench tracks, and 88.6% average success on the RoboTwin 2.0 bimanual benchmark. It also achieves the highest observed success rates among the compared methods on six real-world manipulation tasks across dexterous-hand and mobile-gripper platforms. Together with representation ablations and data-scaling results, these findings demonstrate the potential of latent-action supervision for scaling robot policy learning beyond native action-labeled data.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 潜动作模型架构
docs.text: RynnLAM 将帧间变化分解为运动 token、动作潜变量与相机潜变量，分别接受特征、动态流与相机位姿监督。图源：作者论文 · Figure 3 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话核心贡献
docs.text: 从视觉转移学习连续、3D-grounded latent action，把 30.1K 小时异构人类/机器人/仿真视频变成 7.4552 亿个动作描述符，再适配各机器人原生动作。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 4B 模型在 LIBERO 为 98.8%、LIBERO-Plus 零适配 84.7%、RoboTwin 2.0 双臂 88.6%、VLABench 五轨平均成功率 51.9%。六个真实任务每项 35 次：固定双臂三任务 85.71/42.86/82.86%，轮式双臂三任务 40.00/57.14/54.29%，均为表中最高点估计。

docs.title: 相对已有工作的真实新意
docs.text: 相对常见动作 tokenization，关键是用相机补偿的 3D flow 与未来特征残差把无原生控制标签的视频变成共享预训练监督；同时给出数据规模趋势。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 深度、位姿和 flow 都是伪标签，不能证明 latent action 具有可辨识的因果控制含义；部署仍需 3,850 条 embodiment-specific 动作数据，且部分 RoboTwin 协议并非所有基线都更强。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
今天最值得读的 VLA 核心方法之一，覆盖固定双臂和真正的轮式 mobile manipulation。

docs.text:
ThinkLocoManip: A Whole-Body Control Agentic Harness for Legged Loco-Manipulation

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能移动操作

首发 2026-10-25，v1（最新索引批次补收）  ·  收录于 2026-10-28 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

本次未在已核验的原论文与摘要中找到作者项目主页或代码入口。 （2026-11-01 核查）

大系统｜Agent / agentic coding｜技能/阶段 + 规划/观测/验证｜移动操作（轮式四足+机械臂）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

In this paper, we propose ThinkLocoManip, an agentic harness for legged loco-manipulation designed to tackle complex, long-horizon tasks in large-scale environments. Existing approaches typically follow either direct action generation or a plan-then-act paradigm, both of which can struggle with the generalization and error-recovery capabilities required for extended task execution. In contrast, ThinkLocoManip adopts an interleaved reasoning-and-acting paradigm, allowing the agent to continuously reason about its current state, execute actions, observe their outcomes, and adapt its strategy accordingly. Building on this paradigm, our agentic harness orchestrates a suite of specialized tools for perception, navigation, manipulation, and locomotion, enabling flexible composition of heterogeneous capabilities. Unlike existing robotic agentic harnesses, ThinkLocoManip explicitly incorporates locomotion as a tool domain for agent reasoning and execution. We further design a set of skills that explicitly account for both tool usage within each functional domain and coordination across domains, supporting effective execution of complex behaviors over long horizons. To tackle task failure during long-horizon interactions, we develop keyframe thinking mechanism to preserve critical execution context and support efficient error recovery. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate that ThinkLocoManip substantially outperforms representative methods based on both direct action generation and plan-then-act paradigms across challenging long-horizon legged loco-manipulation tasks. Notably, ThinkLocoManip achieves a success rate of 77%, more than twice that of the strongest plan-then-act baseline (37.1%). Our experiments further validate the effectiveness of interleaved reasoning and acting, tool orchestration, and coordinated skill execution.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 任务规划协调感知、导航、操作与运动工具，并通过关键帧思考处理执行失败和恢复。图源：作者论文 · Figure 3 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话核心贡献

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: Lenovo BOT MX 上做 5 个室内长时任务，共 70 次整任务试验；整任务成功率 77.0%，高于 plan-then-act 37.1%、π0.5 24.3%、ACT 18.6；外部干扰测试为 11/15，对照 plan-then-act 为 0/15。

docs.title: 相对已有工作的真实新意
docs.text: 真实新意在于把 locomotion 提升为 agent 可显式调度的一等工具，并用接触关键帧保存恢复上下文；不是新的低层 VLA 或动作表示。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 11 个工具和 5 个技能高度工程化；地图、SAM3、抓取检测器和低层控制器均已准备好。部分任务仅 10 次试验，未报告跨训练随机种子。
