基准/诊断 + 核心方法｜WM/WAM + VLA｜低层策略学习｜桌面操作（仿真）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

World Action Models (WAMs) combine future-video prediction with robot action learning, yet improvements in task success alone do not reveal how predictive supervision manifests in execution behavior or whether its benefits persist under task and environmental shifts. We conduct controlled future-video prediction loss ablations within FastWAM and OpenWAM, keeping model architecture, initialization, robot training data, and training steps fixed within each model family. Under clean conditions on seen tasks, predictive supervision increases success rates by 24.38 and 72.91 percentage points, respectively. Trajectory clustering further reveals higher success rates within several coarse trajectory clusters, including cases where cluster frequencies change little, indicating that the gains are not solely reflected in changes in the prevalence of trajectory patterns. However, these benefits do not consistently persist under distribution shifts: improvements on unseen tasks vary across models and tasks, while both models exhibit low success rates under the evaluated environmental randomizations, without a consistent advantage from predictive supervision. We further introduce future-video prediction as an auxiliary training objective for $π_{0.5}$, where a lightweight Transformer predictor used only during training increases success from 82.94% to 89.19%. These findings support future-video prediction as effective auxiliary supervision for action learning, while distinguishing improved execution on familiar tasks from reliable transfer and showing that such gains need not rely on a large pretrained video diffusion transformer (DiT) in the evaluated setting.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 训练配置对比
docs.text: 两种辅助视频预测分支在训练中更新共享视觉语言通路，推理时移除视频分支并保留原动作路径。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话核心贡献
docs.text: 在 FastWAM/OpenWAM 内固定架构、初始化、机器人数据和训练步数，只改变 future-video loss，以区分“预测监督帮助训练”与“世界模型带来迁移”。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: Seen+Clean 中 FastWAM/OpenWAM 分别提升 24.38/72.91 pp；扩展实验中提升 36.37/89.25 pp，但环境随机化时绝对成功率接近 0，且增益为负。给 π0.5 加仅训练期使用的轻量视频预测器，在 3,200 次匹配 rollout 上由 82.94% 提至 89.19%，高于 5B Wan 分支的 86.97%。

docs.title: 相对已有工作的真实新意
docs.text: 它证明在这组设置里，WAM 的主要收益可以是训练期辅助监督，并不等同于推理期“会预测未来”或具有稳健 OOD 世界模型。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 纯仿真；WAM 每个配置只有一个训练 run，数千 rollout 不能替代多训练种子。随机化条件存在 floor effect，无法区分“预测监督无效”与“基础策略整体太弱”。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
对当前 WAM 叙事最有价值的反证/边界论文，轻量 predictor 结果也很实用。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Learning generalizable humanoid loco-manipulation remains bottlenecked by costly real-world demonstrations. Simulation provides a scalable alternative, but requires visually faithful, physics-ready scenes and executable whole-body motions. We present Zero-HLM, a real-to-sim-to-real framework that transforms smartphone captures and simulated source demonstrations into scalable training data for humanoid loco-manipulation. Gaussian-guided agentic real-to-sim reconstruction aligns visual and physical scenes; motion-environment co-adaptation uses rollout feedback to correct whole-body references and interaction geometry. We generate 4,800 physically validated demonstrations for zero-shot transfer across three Unitree G1 tasks. Simulation-trained GR00T N1.7 achieves 66.7% mean full-task success, versus 46.7% with real-data training. On generalized configurations, expanded simulation training raises pooled success from 23% for base-trained real-data policies to 69%, without additional real demonstrations. Project page: https://young-bit.github.io/zero-hlm/

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 场景重建与运动环境协同适配生成全身示范，再用成功轨迹及第一视角渲染训练部署策略。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话核心贡献
docs.text: 用 smartphone capture、Gaussian 引导的 agentic real-to-sim 和 motion–environment co-adaptation，从少量源演示生成物理验证的 humanoid loco-manipulation 训练数据。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 每任务从 15 条遥操作源演示出发，共生成 4,800 条成功仿真演示并微调 GR00T N1.7；Unitree G1 三任务、每任务 20 次 Base 测试，800 条仿真数据的整任务平均成功率 66.7%，Real-Only(100) 为 46.7%；五种 Expanded 配置共 100 次试验，69% 对 23%。

docs.title: 相对已有工作的真实新意
docs.text: 不是单纯 domain randomization，而是让 agent 同时重建视觉/碰撞场景并根据 rollout 修正全身参考与交互几何。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 所谓“无真实机器人数据”指最终策略训练不使用真实示范，但系统仍需真实场景采集、标定和 15 条仿真源遥操作；优势部分来自 800 对 100 的数据量差异，且仅三任务。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
对 humanoid 移动操作的数据闭环和真实迁移边界写得比较完整，阶段成功率与整任务成功率也分开报告。

docs.title: Pretraining Knows What, Simulation Teaches How
docs.text:
Pretraining Knows What, Simulation Teaches How: Compositional Generalization in a Sim-Trained Robot Agent (ZAP)

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM智能体与程序学习

首发 2026-10-26，v1（最新索引批次补收）  ·  收录于 2026-10-28 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

本次未在已核验的原论文与摘要中找到作者项目主页或代码入口。配图为三种机器人场景与共用交互接口的系统概览，不是策略网络架构图。配图从 v1 原论文 PDF 第 4 页 Figure 2 提取。 （2026-11-01 核查）

大系统 + 核心方法｜Agent / agentic coding + VLA/WAM 对照｜规划/观测/验证 + 工具层控制｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

A robot policy needs to understand what a task is asking for in a scene, and how to move the robot to accomplish that task. To achieve these two skills, we introduce Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP), a recipe that teaches a small off-the-shelf vision-language model to control a robot via a simple tool harness. We use a pretrained 27B parameter model to bootstrap world understanding and reasoning, followed by supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on simple simulated tasks to teach it how to move the robot. Without any real-world robot data during training, ZAP reaches 96.7% success on real-world tasks, matching GPT-6 Astra in our harness and outperforming the MolmoAct2 VLA (33.3%), while running 3x faster and 17x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra. We demonstrate that ZAP also generalizes to completely new objects, goals, strategies, and language by seating a test tube in a rack (and choosing a different hole in the rack when prompted), handing a test tube between arms mid-air, drawing an X on a tic-tac-toe board, and playing chess. These goals and types of manipulation don't appear in our training data. Furthermore, ZAP also transfers to an unseen embodiment. On a single-arm Franka, ZAP reaches 55.9% on RoboLab-120, 4.9 percentage points ahead of the leading VLA/WAM baseline.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 系统概览
docs.text: ZAP 在仿真双臂 YAM、真实 YAM 与仿真单臂 Franka 上使用共同的图像标注、三维物体读数与控制反馈接口。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话核心贡献
docs.text: 把 27B 通用 VLM 的语义推理与仿真中学到的末端位姿工具调用分离：SFT+GRPO 只教“怎么动”，不再用真实机器人动作数据教“任务是什么意思”。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 双臂 YAM 真实硬件 10 个任务、每模型 30 次试验：ZAP 96.7%，与同 harness 的 GPT-6 Astra 持平，MolmoAct2 33.3%，Base Qwen 16.7%；平均 146 秒/任务、约 0.29 美元。零重训迁移到单臂 Franka 后，RoboLab-120 为 55.9%，高于 Lakeside 51.0%、FLUX 3 Action 42.9%。

docs.title: 相对已有工作的真实新意
docs.text: 强结果来自“通用语义预训练 + 仿真运动课 + embodiment-agnostic 工具接口”的组合，说明 agent harness 可把推理和动作学习解耦。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 真实评测每任务仅 3 次；训练成功轨迹包含最多约 1,000 leaves/task 的 prefix-tree 搜索，计算预算很大。换 harness 后同一 GPT-6 Astra 从 96.7% 降到 36.7%，说明系统接口而非模型本身主导结果；棋类/画图等展示多为少量个案。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
它对 VLA 与 agent-as-policy 的边界给出了非常鲜明、可量化的对照。

Learning Force-Reactive Humanoid Loco-Manipulation (FLORE)

VLA 与策略学习

首发 2026-10-26，v1（最新索引批次补收）  ·  收录于 2026-10-28 日报

核心方法｜VLA（diffusion policy）｜低层控制/策略学习｜移动/全身操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Many everyday tasks require controlling contact force as well as motion. On a humanoid, this force must often be coordinated across both hands and the whole body, and cannot be specified by kinematic trajectories alone. Therefore, we present FLORE, a framework for learning force-reactive humanoid loco-manipulation. We collect robot-free demonstrations using two force-sensing UMI-style handheld grippers for hand motion and contact wrenches, and wearable trackers for body motion. A force-reactive diffusion policy takes vision, proprioception, and measured wrenches as input, then predicts actions and per-hand force commands. A hybrid compliance whole-body controller with force tracking executes these commands while maintaining balance: an integral of the force error measured by real force/torque (F/T) sensors lets each hand track force accurately along the commanded direction and remain compliant along the others. In simulation, the controller tracks per-hand force commands of varied magnitude and direction, with little loss in whole-body motion accuracy. Across three contact-rich tasks on the robot, the force-reactive policy succeeds in 80% of rollouts, compared with 26.7% for a position-only policy trained on the same demonstrations and executed by the same controller. For more details, please visit our website: https://louis-leee.github.io/FLoRe/.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 带力传感的手持示教采集视觉、运动与接触力，力反应扩散策略连接可同时跟踪运动与力的全身控制器。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话核心贡献
docs.text: 在 robot-free 示范中同时记录手部运动、接触 wrench 和身体运动，让 diffusion policy 预测动作与双手力命令，再由混合顺应全身控制器执行。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 三项接触任务 push gantry、rotate box、wipe board，每策略每任务 10 次；FLORE 为 7/10、9/10、8/10，平均 80%，位置-only diffusion policy 为 26.7%，去掉 force command 为 36.7%。

docs.title: 相对已有工作的真实新意
docs.text: 把“看起来相同但接触力不同”的状态显式纳入 humanoid 策略和全身控制，而非仅靠视觉/运动轨迹。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 只覆盖三项任务和 30 次主方法 rollout；依赖专用力感 UMI 示范设备与机器人腕部 F/T 传感器，约 1.25–1.50 N 的零力底噪限制小力命令，横向/向下力较弱。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
它解决的是 VLA 常被忽略但家庭接触任务很关键的 force-reactivity，方法与实验对应关系很干净。

E0.5: From Reconstructive to Future-Predictive 3D Foundations for Robotic World-Action Modeling

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

World-action models (WAMs) offer a promising framework for embodied intelligence, yet mainstream approaches remain centered on video foundation models or vision-language models. Even when geometric features extracted by 3D models such as VGGT are incorporated, they are typically passed into a video model or VLM that serves as the primary backbone, leaving 3D geometry as an auxiliary input or prediction target rather than the native foundation for world modeling. We present E0.5, a geometry-native world-action model built directly on 3D foundation models. E0.5 introduces two key innovations. First, it adopts a 3D foundation model as the primary backbone, making 3D geometry the native representation for both world modeling and action prediction. Second, it explicitly predicts future 3D states together with actions, enabling the model to capture geometric world dynamics beyond action-only modeling or future video prediction. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 first demonstrate the effectiveness of E0.5 without embodied-data pretraining, achieving success rates of 89.90\% and 50.09\% under clean and randomized settings, respectively. Building on these results, we further pretrain E0.5 on more than 160k robot trajectories from AgiBotWorld-Beta, jointly learning robot actions and future geometry within the pretrained 3D foundation. This embodied pretraining improves mean real-world manipulation success rates by approximately 15 and 7 percentage points on AgileX Piper and Zerith H1, respectively. Together, these results demonstrate the potential of geometry-native foundations to acquire robot interaction knowledge and transfer it to physical manipulation. E0.5 embodies this geometry-native approach as a member of the VWA family of world-action models.

Rollback: Experience Backtracking in World Models for Policy Improvement

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM

首发 2026-10-26，arXiv:2610.36068 v1；补收：索引延迟  ·  收录于 2026-10-29 日报

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Action-conditioned world models offer a scalable alternative to costly real-world interaction for improving robot policies. However, existing world-model-based methods largely treat world models as forward-only surrogates of the physical environment, leaving untapped a capability no physical environment affords: rewinding to past decision points to explore counterfactual futures. We introduce Rollback, a policy improvement paradigm that turns world models from passive simulators into counterfactual engines: it rolls back to critical decision points, branches into alternative actions, and contrasts their outcomes to attribute success to individual decisions. This concentrates imagination where it matters most and distills counterfactual outcomes into fine-grained, action-level supervision without a separately learned value model. We build a scalable training system that unifies distributed world-model search with asynchronous real-robot execution, forming a self-reinforcing cycle: real-world experience continually sharpens the world model, and a sharper world model in turn drives further policy improvement. We term the world-model side of this cycle test-time physics grounding, a capability that hand-built physics simulators lack: while the world model serves as the training environment, real transitions from the policy it trains correct its dynamics through a lightweight LoRA pipeline. Experiments on three challenging real-world tasks show that Rollback improves success rates over the strongest baseline by an absolute 10.67%, 11.11%, and 11.85% on block extraction, ball tossing, and tabletop curling, respectively, while achieving more stable improvement throughout training. Although initialized from teleoperated demonstrations far below human level, Rollback surpasses the average success rate of human players on both ball tossing and tabletop curling within 8 hours of training.

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Complex whole-body loco-manipulation requires executing diverse maneuvers, such as crouching, grasping, and locomotion, within a single long-horizon task. While performing simple pick-and-place behaviors is well-established, scaling to complex, long-horizon tasks remains difficult. Currently, this challenge is addressed by relying on human motion data and correspondingly humanoid platforms, which limits platform independence and introduces substantial data processing overhead. Instead, we extend proximal policy optimization (PPO) to train a single policy for multi-phase tasks across diverse robotic hardware, leveraging prior task structure to shape behavior. Our method adapts PPO using a phase-conditioned critic, phase-gated reward functions, and a multi-phase reset curriculum to guide exploration. To support varied hardware, we employ a decoupled hierarchical control architecture that separates lower-level balancing dynamics from high-level phase execution. We demonstrate multi-stage loco-manipulation skills on hardware on both the Unitree G1 and a Boston Dynamics Spot equipped with a manipulator arm, and validate our design choices through ablations. Our approach enables the acquisition of complex loco-manipulation behaviors purely through environment interaction while directly incorporating high-level task structure into policy learning.

RoboAuto: Autonomous Robot Program Search through Multi-Level Physical Understanding

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能

首发 2026-10-27，arXiv:2610.36533 v1；补收：索引延迟且此前未推送  ·  收录于 2026-10-30 日报

大系统｜Agent / agentic coding｜技能/阶段＋规划/观测/验证｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Recently, LLM-based autonomous agents have shown strong capabilities in iteratively generating, evaluating, and refining executable solutions. In robotic manipulation, Code-as-Policy lets these agents search over modular and editable robot programs. However, effective program search requires physical understanding: agents must understand how objects can be manipulated, how scene geometry constrains actions, and why interactions succeed or fail. Existing methods rely mainly on execution feedback for program refinement, often leaving these physical questions unresolved. We introduce RoboAuto, a framework for robot program search that explicitly organizes physical understanding at the object, scene, and interaction levels through three components. First, a hierarchical knowledge base combines executable skills with object-centric knowledge of affordances, spatial relations, and action effects, learned from embodied data and online task solving. Second, scene grounding connects this knowledge to the current environment by identifying relevant objects and resolving action-critical quantities. Third, multi-stage planning with self-designed experiments checks whether each stage produces its expected physical effects and actively tests competing hypotheses to resolve physical uncertainties. RoboAuto achieves superior performance across five benchmark families, attaining an 89.1% success rate on short-horizon LIBERO-PRO tasks and more than twice the mean success rate of ASPIRE on LIBERO-PRO Long and LIBERO-Plus. It also outperforms ASPIRE and $π_{0.5}$ on three challenging long-horizon real-robot tasks requiring precise manipulation. We further show that the knowledge base transfers across simulators and embodiments, and that program search performance scales with its size. Project page: https://roboauto-ai.github.io/

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Flow-based policies for language-conditioned multi-task manipulation commonly share a single $\textit{Gaussian}$ source prior and a common linear transport path across tasks. However, reliably executing multiple tasks with distinct motion requirements remains challenging for a shared policy. We introduce $\textbf{TOPS}$ ($\textbf{T}$ask-$\textbf{O}$riented $\textbf{P}$riors and $\textbf{S}$chedules), which adapts the flow source prior and interpolation schedule to each task without modifying the network architecture. TOPS first constructs multimodal task sources from reverse-mapped expert action sequences, allowing language instructions to select where generation begins. Guided by source-target covariance mismatch, it then slows the transition toward expert actions early in denoising and accelerates it later along directions requiring expansion. Under a $\textit{Gaussian}$ endpoint model, our analysis shows that this schedule adjustment can lower an upper bound on velocity-prediction risk. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and CALVIN demonstrate improved performance across in-distribution, perturbation and cross-environment settings, alongside better data efficiency. Using one integration step, TOPS raises LIBERO-10 success from $53.44\%$ to $69.67\%$ compared with ten-step Standard Flow Matching (FM), while reducing inference time to approximately one-sixth of the baseline. TOPS also yields consistent gains when transferred to the large-scale flow-based $π_{0.5}$ policy across all four evaluated settings. Real-world experiments further demonstrate improved task success, including an increase from $20\%$ with standard FM to $80\%$ with TOPS on the upper-drawer opening task.

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Mobile robot manipulators extend contact-task capability beyond the workspace of fixed robot installations, but their bases must also sustain the forces generated by the task. On lightweight platforms, base motion and support compliance can change the force and motion realised at the workpiece. How these non-rigid base effects manifest during sustained contact remains insufficiently characterised. This paper investigates non-rigid base effects in mobile robot manipulators through a sanding case study combining exploratory simulation with experiments on two lightweight, unactuated wheeled testbeds. Joint measurements of contact force, tool motion, and base vibration show that sustained contact coexisted with substantial task error: under low base-ground resistance, only 54-70% of a 100 N command was realised, with tool-centre-point errors reaching 100 mm. Increasing base-ground resistance during contact improved force realisation and arrested further tool displacement, while base vibration did not vary consistently with force-tracking error in the tested conditions. These observations illustrate how non-rigid base behaviour can affect contact-task execution and highlight the value of examining force, motion, and vibration together when characterising lightweight mobile manipulation.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Learning controllable world dynamics from heterogeneous interaction videos is challenging because robot embodiments use incompatible action spaces, while human videos lack native control labels. We present RynnWorld-Latent, a cross-embodiment video world model that uses the 3D-grounded latent actions introduced by RynnLAM as a shared conditioning interface. This representation enables joint pretraining on human interaction videos, robot demonstrations, and simulation rollouts without requiring a common native action space. Built on a pretrained video transformer, RynnWorld-Latent combines global action tokens with an identity-initialized local pathway that aligns actions with future video latents. We pretrain on 23 datasets comprising approximately 553.5M frames and adapt the model to target robots through post-training. The framework supports two data-generation routes: digital teleoperation uses target robot commands to generate action-video demonstrations, while latent-action synthesis transfers source motion to an edited initial frame and pairs the resulting rollout with retargeted pseudo robot actions. Experiments show improved video prediction metrics on public benchmarks and two real-robot platforms, alongside qualitative action following when different action sequences share the same initial observation. Synthetic mid-training improves policy success rates on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, and both generation routes improve real-world policy success rates over real-demonstration-only training in the evaluated settings. These results support universal latent actions as a scalable interface for learning controllable visual dynamics across heterogeneous embodiments.

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM

首发 2026-10-27，arXiv:2610.36823 v1；补收：此前未推送  ·  收录于 2026-10-30 日报

核心方法｜WM/WAM｜低层控制/策略学习｜双臂桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Pretrained video generation models encode rich priors about physical interactions, but leveraging them for robot control typically requires either resource-intensive video generation at test time or action heads trained from scratch that do not fully utilize the pretrained backbone. We introduce Tokenizing Actions as Video Patches in a Shared Transformer Policy (TAPESTRY), a world action model that repurposes a pretrained video diffusion transformer into a robotic policy without requiring video generation at inference. Our key idea is to treat robot actions as single-patch tokens in the video model's latent space. A lightweight linear projection maps each action timestep to the patch dimensions of the pretrained VAE, and the resulting tokens are processed by the same patchifying layers and transformer backbone used for video. The shared backbone is optimized through three diffusion objectives sampled per minibatch element: Video diffusion uses VAE latents from robot and human videos to establish dynamics priors. Joint video+action diffusion trains on robot demonstrations using a coupled diffusion timestep and an asymmetric attention mask. Action-only diffusion denoises actions conditioned on clean image latents. At test time, the model generates a compact action token sequence in a single DDIM step from pure noise, producing smooth action chunks at 84 ms per action chunk on consumer hardware and avoiding the cost of full video generation. Across simulation benchmarks and real-robot experiments, TAPESTRY achieves strong performance with substantially lower inference cost than comparable joint video--action policies. More information can be found at https://tapestry-wam.github.io.

docs.text: 视频与动作共享 patch 表示及预训练视频骨干；训练覆盖视频、视频动作联合和纯动作扩散，部署仅单步预测动作。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.text: 把每个动作时刻编码为视频 VAE 的单个 patch token，让动作与视频复用同一个预训练 DiT；推理只走动作分支，并利用零终端 SNR 的 v-prediction 做单步 DDIM。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 在“仅 LIBERO-90 有动作标签、四个目标套件只有视频”的特殊 learning-from-video 协议中，平均成功率 76%，高于 Cosmos Policy/DreamZero 的 70%；每套件 100 次。真实双臂平台上，三个 ID 任务整任务成功 28/30；三个 OOD 组合任务 full success 10/15、partial success 13/15。单个 action chunk 84 ms（RTX 5090），约比同 GPU 优化后的 DreamZero 快 44 倍。

docs.text: 不是“先生成视频再反演动作”，而是 action-as-video-patch 的共享 tokenization 与骨干；单步推理同时揭示视频先验和动作频谱错配。

首发 2026-10-27，arXiv:2610.36840 v1；补收：此前未推送  ·  收录于 2026-10-30 日报

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

World Action Models (WAMs) learn representations for robot control by coupling future visual prediction with action generation. Successful manipulation depends primarily on how the robot and task-relevant objects evolve, whereas future-video prediction must also reconstruct the appearance and background of the entire scene. We therefore propose Trace-WAM, which augments video-action learning with future 3D motion prediction as an auxiliary objective. This objective supervises temporal point correspondence together with image-plane displacement and depth change, directly describing the interaction dynamics and spatial changes involved in manipulation. To this end, we adopt a three-branch Mixture-of-Transformer (Tri-MoT) architecture to jointly learn video prediction, motion prediction, and action generation. The motion expert predicts future trajectories from current visual features, allowing motion supervision to shape the representations used for action generation. Because the action expert does not consume predicted trajectories, inference retains the current-observation policy path: a single visual forward pass followed by action denoising. Experiments on RoboCasa-GR1, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus demonstrate strong in-distribution performance and out-of-distribution generalization, with particularly clear gains over Fast-WAM under limited demonstrations and distribution shifts.

docs.text:
From 12 to 200 Demonstrations: How ACT, Diffusion Policy, SmolVLA and π0.5 Scale on a Low-Cost Arm

VLA 与策略学习

首发 2026-10-27，arXiv:2610.37170 v1  ·  收录于 2026-10-29 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

本次未在已核验的原论文与摘要中找到作者项目主页或代码入口。配图由原论文 SVG 渲染为 PNG。 （2026-11-03 核查）

基准／诊断｜VLA＋模仿学习｜低层策略／数据缩放｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

We trained four widely used imitation-learning policies, ACT, Diffusion Policy, SmolVLA and $π_{0.5}$, on nested subsets of 12, 25, 50, 100 and 200 teleoperated demonstrations of one pick-and-place task with distractor objects, using one fixed training recipe per policy. Every trained model was then run on a physical SO-101 arm on a fixed set of object placements: 1,340 scored episodes in 126 blocks. ACT, trained from scratch, rose from 1 success in 40 episodes at 12 demonstrations to 37 in 40 at 100. $π_{0.5}$ with its action expert fine-tuned was the best policy when data was scarce (16 of 40 at 12 demonstrations, 28 of 40 at 25) and then stayed near 70%; from 100 demonstrations ACT was ahead, by a margin this study does not fully resolve. SmolVLA and Diffusion Policy peaked near 50%, and both were affected by a failure to start: SmolVLA's arm never started moving in 47% of episodes, and Diffusion Policy hardly ever started until an idle lead-in was trimmed from the demonstrations. For $π_{0.5}$ the fine-tuning recipe mattered more than the amount of data: low-rank adaptation succeeded in 4 of 110 episodes, against 130 of 200 for action-expert fine-tuning. From the joint and camera recordings we place every episode on a four-stage ladder (started, reached the ball, carried it, delivered it) and show that for ACT more data moves failures from reaching, to grasping, to none, while the failures $π_{0.5}$ retains are in grasping. We also measure how weak a ten-episode block is as a measurement (the same checkpoint tested twice differs by 2 successes in 10 on average), separate seed-to-seed variation from that noise, and audit the human scoring against the recordings. Training length was fixed within each recipe, so the amount of data and the number of times it was seen change together; we state which conclusions survive that confound and which do not.

基准／诊断＋模块｜WM/WAM｜规划／验证／测试时选择｜桌面操作（仿真）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

World action models (WAMs) predict the visual consequences of the actions they generate, which makes test-time selection a natural way to improve a fixed policy: imagine the futures of candidate actions and execute the best one. The benefit of selection is bounded by the selectable headroom, how much better the best candidate truly is, but the standard estimate, which executes each candidate once and keeps the best outcome, conflates candidate quality with the randomness of everything that follows. We introduce a denoised counterfactual protocol, based on bitwise-reproducible branching, repeated continuations, held-out oracles, and common random numbers, that measures the headroom a selector can realize, and use its measurements to build a fail-gated selector. Across four WAMs, two benchmarks, over 100,000 branched rollouts, and pre-registered tests, we find that (i) the standard estimate overstates the selectable headroom of native samples: bounds from 17 continuations per candidate place its selectable share between 24% and 66% for three WAMs; (ii) structured action perturbations create up to 16 points of selectable headroom; and (iii) in both WAMs with action-conditioned imagination, imagined futures carry candidate-outcome information with no detectable loss relative to real futures, information that the value head of Cosmos Policy leaves unused. Deviating from the policy chunk only when a readout of the WAM predicts failure, the selector raises closed-loop task success from 76.9% to 81.6% on held-out episodes of training tasks, with the largest gain where the policy fails most often, and from 62.6% to 69.8% on unseen tasks.

VLA 与策略学习

模块／trick｜VLA｜低层执行／测试时检索｜桌面操作（Mobile ALOHA，但底座不参与）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies demonstrate remarkable semantic generalization, yet remain highly vulnerable to out-of-distribution (OOD) visual shifts during execution. While existing test-time methods attempt to suppress spurious visual cues, they fundamentally overlook the rich, uncorrupted kinematic priors embedded in the policy's own training experience. We introduce Retrieve to Act (R2A), a test-time scaling framework that formulates OOD robustness purely as a geometric motion primitive retrieval problem. R2A bypasses fragile visual features by structuring successful training demonstrations into an offline spatiotemporal motion primitive graph. During inference, a query-dependent Graph Neural Network dynamically localizes the robot's ongoing execution within this graph, retrieving structurally compatible future motion primitives. These retrieved geometric priors are then seamlessly harmonized with the frozen VLA's predicted actions via a learned, dimension-wise gating mechanism, adaptively rectifying erroneous spatial trajectories while preserving the policy's local reactivity. Extensive experiments across three state-of-the-art VLA architectures, GR00T N1.7, $π_{0.5}$, and StableVLA, demonstrate that R2A consistently and significantly enhances robustness against diverse contextual perturbations. R2A achieves absolute success rate improvements of up to +12% in simulation benchmarks (LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin2.0-Plus) and +40% in real-world deployments, without requiring any finetuning of the base policies. Project page: https://retrieve2act.github.io/r2a/

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

The vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action model (WAM) communities debate whether control policies should inherit pretrained knowledge from vision-language models or from visual generators. The debate, however, bundles three separable choices: backbone initialization, the objective applied to future observations, and whether the machinery for that future loss is kept at inference. A gap between a VLA and a WAM therefore cannot simply be attributed to any one of them. We show that decoupling these choices yields a common framework for both families, which we term Just Action Model (JAM): a pretrained visual backbone with an action expert, trained with an action loss and a foresight loss. The foresight loss trains current-observation features to predict frozen encodings of the recorded future through a prediction head discarded after training, so no visual generation is involved in either training or inference, and the backbone can be chosen freely. We first compare objectives within fixed policy architectures, then evaluate the foresight recipe across backbone families. The resulting JAM policies outperform their matched FastWAM and ImageWAM counterparts on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, and achieve similar or slightly higher success rates on RoboTwin. Compared with FastWAM, JAM improves the success rates from 97.0%/55.3%/91.2% to 98.2%/64.5%/91.4%, respectively. With cached foresight targets, JAM reduces estimated online training FLOPs per sample per update by 73% relative to FastWAM. Our results show that future supervision improves control without visual generation or additional inference machinery, and strong foresight performance is attainable with either generator-initialized or vision-language backbones. Project Page: https://y0uroy.github.io/JAM

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate high-level reasoning with low-level action execution for end-to-end robotic control. However, most VLA models target static manipulation in unconstrained environments, overlooking spatial constraints and dynamic obstacles. Fine-tuning VLAs on obstacle-avoidance data is a straightforward solution, but collecting such data is costly, especially for dynamic scenarios, and may degrade their original task capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose VLA-Stem, a lightweight, reinforcement-learning-based safety mechanism for VLA systems. Without fine-tuning the underlying VLA policy, VLA-Stem converts its action chunks into motion references and uses trajectory-level guidance to preserve their spatial intent while allowing flexible motion and timing adjustments. Conditioned on these references, robot proprioception, and local obstacle information, the Stem policy adaptively modifies execution at inference time, preserving the original task intent while enabling responsive adaptation to spatial constraints and dynamic obstacles. For robust and sample-efficient training, we combine teacher-student distillation with curriculum learning. We evaluate VLA-Stem on reference following, static spatial constraints, and dynamic obstacle avoidance. Across six constrained simulation settings, VLA-Stem achieves 52.8% average collision-free task success versus 23.7% for the strongest safety baseline, while preserving base-policy performance in obstacle-free settings; real-world experiments further show consistent collision reductions under static and dynamic obstacles. These results demonstrate that VLA-Stem couples high-level VLA task intent with rapid, reflex-like responses to immediate physical risks, providing a brainstem-inspired mechanism for robust robot execution.

docs.text:
复制原文

Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions, but their understanding of physical dynamics remains limited. Video world models can capture scene dynamics, yet generating future videos introduces high latency into the control loop. We introduce PDRVLA, whose lightweight Physical Dynamics Module extracts physical tokens from vision--language features to condition action generation without online video generation. The module learns through direct prediction of future RGB, depth, and optical-flow features, with auxiliary supervision through a frozen pretrained video world model. Training relies entirely on publicly available data, expanded through human-to-robot synthesis, subtask annotation, and embodied chain-of-thought (ECoT) annotation. Across four simulation benchmarks, PDRVLA achieves success rates of 99.3% on LIBERO, 89.9% on LIBERO-Plus, 93.6% on RoboTwin~2.0, and 81.5% on SimplerEnv. Ablations show improved future prediction with world-model supervision and evaluate how subtask conditioning, future object-pose supervision, and ECoT training affect action success.

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Multi-robot control requires integrating distributed camera views while predicting separate action sequences. Most vision-language-action and world-action models target one robot. Combining multiple views alone does not establish spatial correspondence between them. World Dreamer v5-lite is a multi-robot world-action model built around a shared world state for robot-specific action prediction. Calibrated features from a pretrained video encoder populate this state in workspace coordinates; its spatial size remains fixed as views are added. A vision-language model provides scene context and one query per robot. The queries read the shared state and exchange pose-aware information, while their action streams remain separate. Masked-view cooperative training withholds selected camera views from both visual branches while retaining all action targets. This encourages the use of observations shared by other robots. Pretraining uses more than 10,000 hours of trajectories from 20 simulated robot types, RoboFactory, and real robots. On RoboFactory, World Dreamer v5-lite achieves 74.0% mean success, 23.7 percentage points above the strongest evaluated baseline. Across four real-robot tasks, it reaches 78.8% mean success, a margin of 13.8 points. It also reaches 58.08% overall on RoboCasa365.

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Imitation policies that reliably execute most of a manipulation trajectory can still fail in localized regions requiring last-mile precision. Updating the full policy or exploring residual actions everywhere treats this local failure as a global learning problem. We introduce Adaptive Residual Correction (ARC), a lightweight post-training module that uses reinforcement learning (RL) to learn a residual correction on top of a frozen policy while using sparse human corrections to structure autonomous exploration. Rather than treating human corrections as imitation targets, ARC uses pre-intervention states to determine 'when' residual control should become active and correction geometry to determine 'where' in residual action space autonomous refinement should explore; task reward determines 'what' residual is ultimately executed. Across three precision-manipulation tasks on a real robot, ARC improves average task success from 33.3% to 75.0%. The human corrections define task-dependent 2-3 dimensional subspaces of the seven-joint residual space that retain 96.0-97.7% of squared correction magnitude. Together, these results show that sparse human corrections can localize and constrain autonomous post-training without requiring the observed correction itself to serve as the final action target.

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Dexterous manipulation with multi-fingered hands is the next frontier of robotics, yet learned hand skills remain limited to simple grasps or basic repeated motions, such as rotating an object. As robots attempt more demanding in-hand maneuvers, safety, such as not dropping the object, becomes critical, yet it is rarely measured. We study in-hand object pose reaching, a task that demands diverse and difficult grasps: moving an object to almost any position and orientation within reach of the fingers, at any wrist orientation, through long sequences of consecutive goals. We present a recipe for training such policies for a LEAP hand in simulation without human data, built on a range of insights, from diverse resets and goals via generated grasp datasets to an adaptive friction curriculum. With careful system identification, the policies transfer zero-shot to the real hand, using either motion capture or a single wrist-mounted depth camera, and prove remarkably capable and robust. On top of the task policy, we add a learned residual safety filter with adjustable conservativeness, letting us tune the balance between performance and safety and greatly reduce object drops. In 13.3 hours of real-robot evaluation over 4,800 unseen goals across 4 objects and diverse wrist orientations, the state-based policy reaches 95.2% of goals within 2 cm and 0.4 rad, and the filter cuts its drops by 75% while still reaching 91.5% of goals. The policies can also spin a lightbulb held in an arbitrary pose, reach out-of-distribution goals, withstand fast arm motion and perturbations, and, needing only a wrist camera, serve as portable skills such as screwing in a lightbulb. We release the full recipe as a platform for studying performance, reliability, and safety in high-dimensional dexterous systems. Videos and more are available at https://ian-chuang.github.io/dexsafe/.

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress in robotic manipulation, but their generalization remains constrained by the diversity and coverage of action-labeled robot demonstrations. Human videos provide much broader behavioral and environmental experience, while learning from them faces a fundamental trade-off between scalable data and explicit action grounding. We introduce ThinkWorld, a VLA learning framework that grounds action reasoning in world dynamics and strengthens it through reinforcement learning with world imagination. ThinkWorld represents each action thought as a Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD), a sequence of discrete motion tokens that captures the intermediate dynamics connecting the current world to a future state and serves as a common action representation across embodiments. We first initialize CoD with action-labeled demonstrations, then predict the future induced by each CoD and reinforce those whose predictions better match the observed outcome. This enables videos without action annotations to provide direct supervision from observed state transitions, allowing human and robot experience to refine the same reasoning space. Experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate effective human-to-robot transfer and strong generalization to unseen tasks and environments.

docs.text: 监督阶段将机器人动作与人手运动映射到共享离散空间；强化阶段用想象未来与观测未来的对齐奖励训练运动推理。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 用离散运动 token 组成 Chain-of-Dynamics，把人手与机器人动作放到共享运动空间，再以“想象未来与真实未来的一致性”做强化，利用无动作标注的人类视频。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: YAM 双臂实机的颜色匹配、挂杯和分拣，合计 120 次（ID/OOD 各 60）：ThinkWorld 112/120，macro success 94.4%，MolmoAct2 为 62.2%；ID 60/60，OOD 52/60。LIBERO-PRO 累积消融从基础 40.1% 到最终 55.6%，其中最后的 imagination-RL 只再加 1.2 个点。

docs.title: 真实新意
docs.text: CoD 是训练期跨 embodiment 动作推理空间；部署时不生成 CoD 或未来图像，因此不是在线 world-model planning。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 实机条件细分后每格只有 5 次，且主要报告单次训练；完整技能组合多为定性；强化阶段增益较小，整体提升来自多个累积组件。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
是“人类视频如何真正监督机器人动作”这一问题上较清晰的 action-grounding 方案。

docs.title: DexSuite
docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 10

docs.title: DexSuite
docs.text:
DexSuite: An All-in-One Framework for Dexterous Manipulation Across Arms, Hands, and Tasks

VLA 与策略学习

首发 2026-10-27，v1（10 月 30 日进入列表）  ·  收录于 2026-11-02 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

作者项目页已链接公开实现。仓库引用该论文，包含 Genesis 任务环境、机器人与控制器、遥操作与数据采集，以及 robomimic 训练和评测入口。 （2026-11-07 核查）

数据＋基准/诊断｜路线中立｜低层控制/策略学习｜桌面单臂/双臂灵巧操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Human-level dexterity remains a central open problem in robotics, yet few simulation frameworks cover the full workflow of dexterous manipulation, from setting up a robot to collecting dexterous demonstrations and evaluating policies. We present DexSuite, an all-in-one simulation framework for dexterous manipulation built on the Genesis simulator. DexSuite provides 30 tasks and assembles its 10 arms and 12 end-effectors, from parallel-jaw grippers to dexterous hands, into more than 100 single-arm robots and thousands of bimanual pairs. It also ships a standardized environment API, integrated teleoperation, and simulated tactile sensing. Moreover, we define a benchmark of 16 task-embodiment pairs spanning diverse contact complexities and horizons, and release a dataset of 4,700 successful episodes in simulation from human teleoperation, scripted experts, and learned policies. We release DexSuite as open source and hope others will build on it. Videos and datasets are available at https://dexsuiteorg.github.io

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 系统架构
docs.text: 任务、机器人组合、控制器、遥操作与学习工具通过统一接口接入 Genesis 灵巧操作仿真。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 在 Genesis 上把机器人组合、遥操作、触觉、任务和评测串成统一灵巧操作框架，覆盖从夹爪到多指手的大量 embodiment。

docs.title: 关键实验／资源
docs.text: 30 个任务、10 种机械臂、12 种末端执行器，组合出 100+ 单臂机器人和数千双臂组合；定义 16 个 task–embodiment 基准单元，发布 4700 条成功仿真 episodes，来源包括人类遥操作、脚本专家与学习策略。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 主要贡献是框架与数据规模，摘要没有给出统一策略基线的成功率比较；全部在仿真，触觉与动力学迁移到真实硬件尚未被证明。

docs.title: 为什么值得读／真实新意
docs.text:
对后续 VLA/WAM 来说，它的价值是可系统控制 embodiment 与末端执行器变化，适合做跨机器人、双臂和灵巧性诊断，而不是作为一个新模型来读。

docs.title: What Actually Matters? A Paired Evaluation of Inference Settings for π0.5 on BEHAVIOR-1K
docs.text:
What Actually Matters? A Paired Evaluation of Inference Settings for π0.5 on BEHAVIOR-1K

VLA 与策略学习移动操作

首发 2026-10-27，arXiv:2610.37917 v1；索引延迟补收  ·  收录于 2026-11-01 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

作者项目主页已核验，Code 标注 soon。已核对 v1 的 HTML 与 4 页原 PDF，论文以表格报告消融结果，未提供方法架构或流程图，本次不配框架图。 （2026-11-03 核查）

基准／诊断｜VLA｜低层推理设置＋数据采集｜家庭移动操作（仿真）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising paradigm for general-purpose household robotics. However, inference and data-collection strategies that have been deployed in smaller-scale settings do not necessarily generalize to large-scale, diverse task suites. To address this gap, we conduct a systematic, paired evaluation of previously proposed inference and data-collection strategies across all 100 tasks. Our evaluation uses a fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ model based on the 2025 BEHAVIOR Challenge winner, which achieves a Q-score of 0.39 on the public test set. These results show that proposed strategies do not transfer uniformly to new environments and tasks. Project page, videos, and detailed analysis: https://rubenhammele.github.io/behavior2026

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 在 BEHAVIOR-1K 全部 100 个任务上做 paired ablation，检验 action chunk、播放速度、flow 去噪步数、inpainting、guidance、Best-of-N 与失败点重启是否真的有效。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 基于 2025 challenge winner 微调的 π0.5，public test Q-score 0.39；每个设置覆盖 100 任务×4 instances。把每次执行从 26 动作减为 13，Q-score 降 0.16、成功任务数降 11；20 步去噪减到 1 步没有可检测损失；Best-of-4 无收益。snapshot restart 节省 29–43% 仿真步数，但没有显著提高单位仿真成本的成功数。

docs.title: 真实新意
docs.text: 不是新模型，而是在大规模家庭任务上否定若干从小型设置直接移植的 inference trick。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 仅仿真且只有一个微调 backbone；Q-score 含阶段进度，不等于整任务二值成功；实验设置与 challenge 的时间预算紧密耦合。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
对 VLA 部署配方的证据密度很高，尤其提醒 action-chunk horizon 比额外去噪和 Best-of-N 更关键。

docs.title: Self-Labeled Preference Transfer for Steerable Robot Manipulation
docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 04

docs.title: Self-Labeled Preference Transfer for Steerable Robot Manipulation
docs.text:
Self-Labeled Preference Transfer for Steerable Robot Manipulation

VLA 与策略学习

首发 2026-10-27，v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-02 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

本次未在已核验的 v1 原论文和摘要页找到作者项目主页或代码入口。 （2026-11-03 核查）

核心方法｜VLA｜策略学习／条件控制｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can learn to follow execution preferences, such as where to grasp an object or how to move around an obstacle, from demonstrations annotated with preference labels. Providing these annotations for every new task, however, is costly. We study whether learned preference control can transfer to new tasks whose demonstrations contain the desired behaviors but lack preference annotations. We find that a policy trained with preference annotations can follow preferences on a new task before adaptation but achieves limited task success. Fine-tuning on target demonstrations without these annotations improves task success while weakening preference control. Motivated by this finding, we introduce Self-Labeled Preference Transfer (SPT). SPT jointly trains a shared vision-language backbone for preference-conditioned action prediction and preference recognition on annotated source demonstrations. It then freezes the recognizer to preserve its cross-task preference recognition capability and uses it to self-label target demonstrations for policy fine-tuning. Across five types of execution preferences in simulation, the recognizer achieves 96.4% accuracy, and SPT reaches 84.8% preference following and 89.2% task success, compared with 59.4% and 88.0% for naive finetuning. We further extend to multiple preferences, achieving 93.8% preference following compared with 42.5% of baselines. In real-world experiments, SPT increases preference following from 52.5% to 92.5% relative to naive finetuning across two task transfers. These results show that SPT can support preference adaptation across tasks and objects while maintaining success, without additional manual preference annotations.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 先联合学习偏好条件动作与偏好识别，再用冻结识别器为目标任务示范补标签并适配策略。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 先在源任务上联合学习“偏好条件动作预测＋偏好识别”，再冻结识别器给无偏好标签的目标示范自动补标签，从而保住可控执行风格。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: RoboTwin 2.0 上覆盖抓取高度、释放高度、绕障宽度、抓取方向、放置位置五类偏好；识别准确率 96.4%，偏好遵循/任务成功为 84.8%/89.2%，朴素微调为 59.4%/88.0%；双偏好遵循 93.8% 对基线 42.5%。UR5e 上两种跨任务迁移，偏好遵循 52.5%→92.5%；每个偏好命令仅 10 次真实试验。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 偏好轴均为预定义二元标签，阈值由源示范校准；真实实验只有两个迁移任务且样本小，未覆盖开放词汇偏好或冲突偏好。

docs.title: 为什么值得读／真实新意
docs.text:
关注“同一任务如何做”而非只做任务成功，且明确区分 preference following 与 task success；自标注机制很简单，但对可控 VLA 数据扩展很实用。

docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 05

docs.title: METATRON
docs.text:
METATRON: A Promptable Whole-Body Execution Layer for Humanoids

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能

首发 2026-10-27，v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-02 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

作者官方项目主页和交互式演示入口已核验，未提供可核验的训练或部署代码仓库入口；没有把演示页面或概念伪代码当作实现。 配图从 v1 原论文 PDF 第 3 页 Figure 2 提取。 （2026-11-03 核查）

大系统｜Agent/agentic coding｜技能/阶段＋低层控制｜移动/全身操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Humanoid controllers often require task-specific training despite sharing the need for balance and whole-body coordination. We present Metatron, a promptable whole-body execution layer combining a generative base policy with a programmable skill layer. The base policy receives partial goals, collectively called a prompt, that can combine timed body-part targets, velocity commands, and style cues. It produces diverse whole-body motions consistent with these goals. Training combines motion capture, synthetic recovery trajectories, and retargeted scene-interaction motions. After training, the policy is frozen. Stateful programs called skills express task intent as prompts at each control step, drawing rough geometric sketches that the policy turns into coordinated movement. Skills are ordinary code, refined by coding agents that analyze motion data and fit compact rules without task-specific policy training. On the physical Unitree G1, one frozen checkpoint supports walking, recovery, teleoperated object pickup, and sitting on furniture. Comparative evaluations show higher reaching success and push robustness than the tested reference-tracking pipelines. The same recipe produces climbing and acrobatics on a simulated character. Metatron enables coding agents to turn learned motor capabilities into new skills through code, without further policy training.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 部分目标与观测历史经先验和条件分支生成全身动作；后验、完整参考和冻结跟踪器仅用于训练。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 用冻结的生成式全身控制器承接稀疏 body-part/速度/风格 prompt，再让普通代码技能（可由 coding agent 拟合）逐步产生 prompt，实现无需任务级重训的全身行为组合。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: Unitree G1 单一 checkpoint 支持行走、起身恢复、遥操作拾物和坐家具；54 个全身伸手目标上到达率 83%，ARDY+SONIC 为 39%；800–1000 N、100 ms 推力下保持直立成功率 75%，两个参考跟踪管线均为 0%；另有每条件 500 次的仿真扰动消融。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 拾物仍是遥操作，坐下前由人工把机器人放到家具附近；长时任务规划和目标选择在系统外，硬件恢复多为定性展示；部分对比是完整管线比较，不能单独归因到接口或训练组件。

docs.title: 为什么值得读／真实新意
docs.text:
它最有启发性的不是“又一个人形控制器”，而是把技能开发明确变成可检查、可由 coding agent 修改的程序层，而底层统一负责平衡和协调。

docs.title: Same Label, Different Interface
docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 09

docs.title: Same Label, Different Interface
docs.text:
Same Label, Different Interface: Beyond Action-Space Labels in Robot Learning

VLA 与策略学习

首发 2026-10-28，v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-02 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

本次未在已核验的 v1 原论文和摘要页找到作者项目主页或代码入口。 （2026-11-03 核查）

基准/诊断｜非特定路线（对 VLA/策略评测有直接影响）｜低层控制｜桌面接触操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Robot-learning studies often compare position and velocity actions as though each label identified a single experimental treatment, yet the label alone does not determine what the robot executes. Before affecting robot motion, bounded policy output passes through filtering, physical scaling, reference construction, feedback, timing, and effort limits. We study how these omitted properties affect attribution under one shared learner and training budget. Across three contact-rich Factory tasks (PegInsert, GearMesh, and NutThread), we compare five joint-space interfaces, with ten independently trained policies per condition. We first remain within the same position-feedback law and vary the executed interface: substituting only the physical action scale as the directly modified component changes sample-median evaluation success by 0.645-1.000 across tasks, while removing an exponential moving average produces task-dependent changes. We then move to a cross-law comparison and choose a velocity scale that exactly matches the position interface's local raw-torque command gain. This calibration raises the sample median on GearMesh and NutThread, with no median change on PegInsert. Yet clear residual sample-median gaps remain on PegInsert and GearMesh, while the NutThread interval includes zero. Thus, even this explicit equality leaves feedback and held-action dynamics unmatched and does not establish position-velocity trained-outcome equivalence. Action-interface comparisons should therefore report the executed pathway and state the physical quantity they match.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 执行接口流程
docs.text: 策略输出经物理尺度、滤波、指令映射、保持、反馈和力矩限制进入物理执行；图中标出各对照条件改变的环节。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 证明“position/velocity action”标签不足以定义实验处理，物理尺度、滤波、反馈律、held-action dynamics 与力矩限制都会显著改变训练结论。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: Factory 的 PegInsert、GearMesh、NutThread 三个接触任务，5 种 joint-space interface，每条件独立训练 10 个策略；仅改变物理 action scale 就让样本中位成功率跨任务变化 0.645–1.000；即使把速度接口校准到与位置接口相同的局部原始力矩增益，仍在 PegInsert/GearMesh 保留明显差距。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 全部是仿真，只有 3 个 Factory 任务与单一学习器；结论主要是因果归因与报告规范，不提供可直接部署的新策略。

docs.title: 为什么值得读／真实新意
docs.text:
这是评测方法论论文：它提醒任何跨模型/跨数据 VLA 对比都必须报告完整执行链，而不能把 action label 当作足够的控制变量。

docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 06

docs.title: Embodied at Sea
docs.text:
Embodied at Sea: Imitation Learning for Multi-Task Underwater Manipulation

VLA 与策略学习移动操作

首发 2026-10-28，v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-02 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

作者项目页将 Code 和 Dataset 均标为 Coming soon；日报中的“工具链开源”表述保留原文，当前未核验到可用发布入口。 （2026-11-03 核查）

大系统／数据｜VLA｜低层控制/策略学习｜移动操作（ROV，非家庭场景）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Behavior Cloning has demonstrated promising generalization capabilities for robotic manipulation in terrestrial environments. However, marine visual distortions and dynamic currents create a severe domain shift that remains a key bottleneck in adapting generalist architectures to underwater field manipulation. To address this, 1616 episodes of underwater manipulation data were collected in calm and turbulent waters and were used to train 14 generalist Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models (DynamicVLA) with varying proprioception observation configurations. Across three tasks on 1260 gradable on-hardware rollouts in a pool, 10 models outperformed the baseline, with the highest-performing model achieving a 93.3% overall success rate, including partial successes. Results are also introduced from a case study evaluating the performance of a single-task Action Chunking Transformer (ACT) and a generalist VLA (SmolVLA) policy for two tasks in marine archaeology and conservation: grasping and mooring. Experiments are performed on an ROV on and around the WWII wreck Coralita X127 and at Manoel Island Marina, Malta. Across 748 collected episodes and 508 gradable on-hardware rollouts, the ACT policy substantially outperformed SmolVLA (47.9% vs. 7.9% pooled success rate), earning a 66.7% success rate on the most successful task at the marine archaeological site. To enable further contributions to embodied intelligence in marine field robotics, the BLUEMBODIED KIT used to collect data, train models, and deploy policies on the ROV has been open sourced.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 改造后的 DynamicVLA 将水下观测、语言与机器人状态编码为六维动作，经 MAVLink 接入 ROV 控制链。图源：作者论文 · Figure 6 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 用大规模水下真实数据系统比较多任务 VLA 与单任务 ACT，并把训练—部署工具链开源，给出强 domain shift 下的移动操作证据。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 池中采集 1616 episodes，训练 14 个 DynamicVLA；3 个任务、1260 次可评分硬件 rollout 中 10 个模型胜过基线，最佳“含部分成功”总体率 93.3%。海上 ROV 案例另有 748 episodes、508 次可评分 rollout，ACT 汇总成功 47.9%，SmolVLA 仅 7.9%；最佳现场任务为 66.7%。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 93.3% 包含 partial success，不能等同完整任务成功；动态水流、可评分筛选及任务差异会影响可比性；领域是水下而非家庭操作。

docs.title: 为什么值得读／真实新意
docs.text:
它提供了罕见的大样本真实移动操作负结果：通用 VLA 在强 domain shift 下可能远输单任务 action chunking，提醒不要把基准上的“generalist”直接外推到现场。

docs.title: ELEVATE
docs.text:
ELEVATE: Agentic Controller Acquisition from Task Failure for Quadrupedal Manipulation

大系统＋核心方法｜Agent / agentic coding｜规划／验证＋技能／阶段＋低层策略学习｜移动操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Quadrupedal manipulators can extend their workspace through whole-body interaction, but task-planning agents' capabilities remain limited by their available controllers. We present ELEVATE, a framework that uses persistent failures during task-program refinement to identify and acquire missing whole-body control capabilities. When these failures suggest a missing physical capability, a coding agent formulates and iteratively refines a reinforcement-learning problem, specifying behavior-specific rewards, curricula, and termination conditions. Validated controllers are added to the capability library and composed with existing controllers to retry the task. Starting from a single pretrained loco-manipulation controller, ELEVATE autonomously acquires controllers for wall-supported elevation, supported manipulation, and wall descent across a sequence of seven simulation tasks. These controllers are reused in subsequent reaching and object-manipulation tasks. On the five tasks beyond the initial controller's workspace, ELEVATE achieves mean success rates of 98.4%-100% across five independent runs, while coding-agent baselines with a fixed controller library fail to complete these tasks. The synthesized task programs, together with the acquired controllers, also transfer to a physical quadrupedal manipulator without real-robot training or fine-tuning, achieving 18/20 successes in rack retrieval and 16/20 in floor-to-rack placement. Videos and demonstrations are available at https://agentic-quad-elevate.github.io/public/.

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 任务程序持续失败后，智能体判断控制能力缺口，定义并迭代强化学习问题；通过验证的新控制器进入技能库以重试任务。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 把“程序反复失败”解释为控制能力缺口，让 coding agent 自动定义并迭代 RL 奖励、课程和终止条件，训练新全身控制器后加入技能库重试原任务。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 从一个预训练 loco-manipulation 控制器出发，在 7 个仿真任务中学习 wall stance、supported manipulation、wall descent；五次独立运行、每方法合计 1,750 次 held-out 试验，整体成功率 99.0%，ASPIRE 为 28.4%，Code-as-Policies 为 23.0%。在超出初始工作空间的 5 个任务上为 98.4%–100%。Go2＋PiPER 真机零样本部署：货架取瓶 18/20，地面取瓶后上架 16/20。

docs.title: 真实新意
docs.text: 不止重新组合现有 API，而是由失败触发“新增低层控制器”的自动获取与复用。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: ELEVATE 获得了额外控制器训练预算，而两个基线的控制库固定，因此高成功率主要证明“能力扩展有效”，不是高层程序合成本身更强；训练依赖作者提供的 RL 模板、仿真环境与基础设施，任务族也集中在墙面支撑姿态。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
少见地把 agentic coding 从代码修补推进到真实移动机械臂控制能力的生成，并有明确 sim-to-real 结果。

核心方法＋数据｜其他：在线 RL 数据采集｜低层策略学习／人机共享控制｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Modern robot learning systems feed on high-quality demonstration data, and their performance hinges on coverage. Without good coverage, small errors compound and the policy can quickly go into out-of-distribution states from which it cannot recover. Yet there is no principled way of collecting high-coverage data, and data collection often relies on heuristic instructions to human operators. Purely online reinforcement learning (RL) explores at the cost of safety and sample efficiency, while DAgger-style interventions require the policy to fail by chance before a human can correct it. In this paper, we ask instead whether we can modify how the robot behaves during data collection to collect more useful data. We propose Data Inoculation (DI), a shared-control framework in which a human provide closed-loop teleoperation commands while a residual policy perturbs these commands. The residual policy is trained online, on the growing dataset, with the same reward-maximizing objective later used for policy extraction, so its perturbations steer data collection toward the deviations a policy trained on the data would make. These perturbations expose the robot to a wider range of states, while the human's continuous corrections provide recovery demonstrations, "inoculating" the dataset against the learner's future mistakes while the human remains in control. On three challenging real-world robotic tasks, DI consistently improves or matches the success rate of policies trained with both behavioral cloning and offline RL, showing DI as an effective data collection strategy for improving downstream policy performance.

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 在线强化学习训练残差策略扰动人类遥操作，主动诱发偏离并收集人类连续纠正，增加恢复数据覆盖。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 数据采集时让在线学习的 residual policy 有针对性地扰动人类遥操作，主动诱发未来策略可能进入的偏离状态，再由人类连续纠正以收集恢复数据。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: Franka＋Robotiq 上做 T-cube、USB-C 插入和 keycap 拆卸；三位操作者，T-cube 9 个 seed、其余各 5 个，每 seed 训练独立策略并测试 20 次。相对 clean 示范，DI 的 BC/RL 成功率：cable 0.66/0.67 vs 0.37/0.35，T-cube 0.50/0.59 vs 0.38/0.42，keycap 0.72/0.84 vs 0.63/0.81。

docs.title: 真实新意
docs.text: 扰动不是固定随机噪声，而是按与最终策略相同的任务 reward 在线学习，目标是暴露有用失误并收集恢复行为。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 人类全程在环，成本高；online RL 初期接近随机扰动并会降低采集成功率；需要任务 reward 和按任务训练的 residual policy。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
它把“恢复能力不足”前移为数据采集问题，且实机统计规模明显大于常见单种子演示。

核心方法｜VLA｜低层控制/策略学习＋观测适配｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Generalist robot policies increasingly learn from data collected across diverse tasks and embodiments, yet typically assume a single controller for each robot. This assumption limits transfer because different controllers can assign different physical meanings to the same action and may require different strategies to complete a task. We study how to transfer robot data across both embodiments and controllers without allowing conflicting action interpretations to interfere with learning. Our setting spans six controller types as well as variations in controller gains and compliance. We propose a framework that encodes behavioral interaction under a controller through examples of commanded actions and the resulting robot motions. A transformer context encoder summarizes these interactions, allowing a single policy to adapt in context. Across real-world experiments, our method improves average success by 33 percentage points over naive data pooling, achieves 50\% success on unseen controller modes and 52\% on unseen controller gains, and transfers to tasks with limited controller-specific data. On contact-rich tasks such as USB insertion and surface wiping, behavioral interaction context enables the policy to adapt not only its actions but also its strategy. Our results provide a path toward generalist robot policies that can leverage data collected across diverse action interpretations. For more information, visit \href{https://controller-transfer.github.io}{https://controller-transfer.github.io}.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 以 commanded–achieved 交互历史编码控制器上下文，为同一 VLA 提供跨控制器行为适配条件。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 不再假设“同一机器人只有一种控制器”，而是把部署控制器下的 commanded–achieved 交互轨迹压成上下文 token，让 VLA 在不做测试时训练的情况下适配控制器类型、增益与顺应性。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 5 个真实操作任务、6 类控制器、4 档增益，训练数据 2880 条轨迹；每个任务–控制器单元 20 次试验。零样本未知控制器模式成功率 50%，高于 SysID 的 27% 和真值控制器元数据的 12%；5-shot 时为 69%（SysID 47%）；未知增益成功率 52%，总体比朴素混合数据高 33 个百分点。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 只验证一个 VLA 架构和单一实验室；分析重标定依赖阻抗式因果假设，未证明可直接扩展到 admittance 控制；需要 3 条部署控制器交互轨迹作为上下文。

docs.text:
它把“动作格式统一”推进到“相同动作在不同控制栈下的物理语义和策略也不同”，并用真实接触任务证明仅做系统辨识不够。

核心方法＋模块／诊断｜WM/WAM｜低层控制＋测试时路由｜桌面双臂操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

World Action Models (WAMs) can condition robot actions on generated visual futures, but this additional context is neither cost-free nor uniformly beneficial. We examine what a predicted future actually changes: the action delta $Δa$ between the future-conditioned and future-free execution paths of the same model. Under a shared WAM checkpoint, this delta barely shifts average benchmark success ($+0.8$ points on LIBERO, $-0.8$ on RoboTwin~2.0), while generating visual futures increases inference latency by 1.7--1.9$\times$. These aggregate metrics conceal a concentrated failure mode that we term \emph{future-induced negative transfer}: while predictive deltas benefit long-horizon tasks ($+2.4$ points on LIBERO-Long) and remain negligible on most routine manipulations, they induce severe degradation on precision tasks---with \emph{Press Stapler} and \emph{Place Can Basket} losing 54.0 and 34.0 points, recurring as top failure modes across independently trained WAM variants. We introduce \textbf{Utility-WAM} for in-place correction of future-conditioned control. Its primary learning component is a residual adapter that repairs future-induced velocity deltas under a frozen shared WAM by aligning them with ground-truth dynamic guidance and penalizing excess error beyond the future-free baseline. The adapter selectively eliminates the majority of severe task drops (reducing losses to 6.0 and 14.0 points) while preserving long-horizon foresight. To eliminate superfluous video computation, a lightweight pre-generation gate reuses counterfactual action outcomes to selectively bypass video generation on 75.5\% of RoboTwin queries, cutting latency by 38\% while improving average success to 93.3\% on RoboTwin~2.0 and 98.9\% on LIBERO. On physical bimanual manipulation across three real-world tasks, Utility-WAM succeeds in 53 of 60 trials, compared to 43 for FAST-WAM.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 共享 WAM 提供有无未来的配对动作路径，冻结后训练残差 adapter 修复有害动作差分，再训练 gate 决定是否生成未来。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 直接测量同一 WAM 在“有／无预测未来”时的动作差分，训练残差 adapter 修复有害差分，再用轻量 gate 决定哪些时刻值得生成视频。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 始终使用未来仅让 LIBERO 平均 +0.8 点、RoboTwin -0.8 点，却增加 1.7–1.9× 延迟；对 Press Stapler 和 Place Can Basket 分别造成 -54、-34 点。Utility-WAM 跳过 75.5% RoboTwin 视频查询，延迟降低 38%，达到 RoboTwin 93.3%、LIBERO 98.9%。双 PiPER 三项真机任务、每项 20 次：53/60，对 FAST-WAM 的 43/60。

docs.title: 真实新意
docs.text: 不把“预测未来”默认视为正贡献，而是以动作变化为审计对象，先纠错、再按效用选择是否调用未来。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 主要实验共享一个 5B WAM 第一阶段 checkpoint，独立重训方差未知；gate 用离线动作误差代理，不是闭环 return；真机每任务训练 200 条示范。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
对 WAM 测试时是否真的需要视频生成给出了少见的负迁移证据和可部署修复方案。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Multi-arm robot platforms, including bimanual and humanoid robots, have the capability to complete tasks with lower cycle times than single-arm systems, but they are more difficult to safely control due to the presence of multi-arm constraints. The paradigm of training generalist robot policies from massive datasets is a promising approach to address general-purpose multi-arm manipulation, but the acquisition of large multi-arm manipulation datasets remains a bottleneck. Automated demonstration generation can alleviate this burden by synthesizing new demonstrations from a handful of source demonstrations, but existing algorithms ignore multi-arm constraints and as a result often induce unsafe and unsuccessful behaviors. We address this limitation by introducing ScheduleGen, an integrated planning & scheduling algorithm for multi-arm demonstration generation. We evaluate ScheduleGen on 28 simulation task variants, including seven externally authored RoboDojo tasks and settings inaccessible to prior systems; it achieves 79.6% mean data-generation success and trains policies with 65.5% mean success. ScheduleGen policies outperform those trained on a state-of-the-art data generation baseline, and achieve 50-80% success across eight real-world variants through zero-shot sim-to-real and real-to-sim-to-real transfer. Videos and more at: https://schedulegen.github.io/

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.text: 适配接触技能并连接各臂轨迹，检查碰撞后联合调度，回放成功运动以生成多臂模仿数据。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.text: 从少量源示范中适配接触技能、规划无碰连接运动，并联合调度多臂时序，自动生成可训练模仿策略的数据。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel at instruction following, yet most remain feed-forward: they condition actions only on the current observation and discard both long-horizon temporal context and the hierarchical structure of VLM representations. We present PRIME W0, a hierarchical conditional flow-matching framework that closes this gap through three synergistic designs: (1)per-layer KV injection from a pretrained VLM into an Adaptive MoE action expert; (2)dynamics-aware conditioning via asynchronous world-model subgoal-image prediction and a DINOv2 historical-frame semantic bridge; and (3)Action Dynamic Manifold (ADM) flow matching with covariance-structured noise that respects robot kinematic coupling. PRIME W0 is trained in four stages---VLM pre-training, DAT/NTP visuomotor pre-training, DiT flow-matching decoder assembly with WM injection, and end-to-end SFT---and achieves state-of-the-art results on LIBERO and real-robot benchmarks, with systematic ablations validating each architectural component.

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Reasoning informs decision-making by connecting intended actions with their expected consequences. Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models incorporate embodied chains of thought (ECoTs) to guide action generation. However, such guidance remains implicit, as actions are conditioned on ECoTs rather than explicitly optimized to align with them. We introduce CoRAct, a consequence-grounded reasoning-to-action alignment framework that explicitly aligns reasoning and action through reward-guided optimization in action noise space. CoRAct formulates two physically grounded ECoT components as verifiable signals: movement specifies intended motion, while waypoints encode expected spatial consequences. A unified Mixture-of-Transformers jointly models ECoT reasoning, action generation, and action-conditioned future prediction. For candidate actions generated from sampled noise, CoRAct computes alignment rewards based on movement consistency and agreement between predicted outcomes and specified waypoints. These rewards guide group-relative optimization of the initial noise distribution, steering action generation toward consistency with intended actions and expected consequences. Experiments across RoboCasa, VLABench, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improvements in task success, generalization, and reasoning-execution alignment over strong ECoT-based VLA baselines. CoRAct also grounds externally provided ECoTs in executable behavior, enabling zero-shot adaptation to novel scenarios by leveraging knowledge from powerful vision-language models. Project page and dataset: https://onlyxingxingzyx.github.io/CoRAct/

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 联合建模 ECoT、动作与动作条件未来，再冻结骨干，用运动及后果一致性奖励优化条件噪声策略。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 把 ECoT 中的运动描述与 waypoint 后果变成可验证 reward，在 action-noise space 做 group-relative post-training，使动作真正对齐推理而非只以推理为条件。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 消融中 VLABench 由 39.2% 提升至 51.8%，RoboCasa 由 68.6% 提升至 75.5%；17 个 RoboCasa 任务每项 30 次、10 个 VLABench 任务每项 50 次。三项真机任务每项 30 次，CoRAct 为 56.6/46.6/63.3%，π0.5 为 33.3/26.6/56.6%。

docs.title: 真实新意
docs.text: 核心不是生成更多 CoT，而是以动作一致性和预测后果一致性优化 flow 初始噪声分布，部署时只采一个动作候选。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 目前只对可直接落到动作与 waypoint 的推理做对齐，高层 subgoal／计划未覆盖；闭环 agent correction 的部分结果另用了 GPT-5.6 Sol，应与核心策略结果分开看。

docs.text:
LOGIV: Graph-Verified Execution with Causal Local Repair for Long-Horizon Robot Tasks

智能体与程序学习

首发 2026-10-29，arXiv:2610.40016 v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-01 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

大系统＋模块｜Agent｜规划／观测／验证／恢复｜桌面双臂操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Agentic robots must turn a high-level goal into actions while keeping the physical conditions needed for future steps valid. A completed action does not ensure that its effects will persist: a later disturbance can invalidate support that the remaining plan still assumes. We present LOGIV, a graph engineering framework for agentic robot execution that uses an explicit task graph to connect symbolic planning, observation-based verification, and embodied action. LOGIV compiles a validated plan into condition-support and resource-ordering edges, checks their physical validity during execution, and uses dependency tracing to determine what must be restored after a failure. Repair is constrained by retained unfinished actions, and the combined continuation is symbolically validated before execution resumes. The framework operates above existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and World Action Model (WAM) policies without adding trainable components. Across 20 dual-arm tasks from RoboTwin~V2 and BiCoord with three execution backbones, LOGIV improves mean task success without injected disturbances by 10.67 and 15.33 percentage points, respectively. Under predefined perturbations, it achieves higher task completion and condition restoration than three adapted recovery baselines for every backbone on both benchmarks. On three real-robot tasks, successful trials increase from 12/30 to 17/30. These results support explicit, continuously checked task dependencies as a practical interface for reliable agentic robot execution.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 状态门、节点门和图门持续核验事实与依赖；失败后定位受影响节点，验证局部修复计划并重建任务图。图源：作者论文 · Figure 3 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 将长任务编译为条件依赖图，持续检查已完成动作提供的物理条件；条件被后续扰动破坏时，只修复受影响因果子图，并在恢复执行前做符号验证。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: RoboTwin V2 与 BiCoord 各 10 个任务、三种执行 backbone。以 π0.5 为例，RoboTwin clean/perturbed full-task success 从 56/32 提升至 72/60，BiCoord 从 39/31 提升至 50/48。真机三任务各 10 次，π0.5 由 12/30 提升至 17/30；消融中去掉 graph gate，扰动成功率从 60% 降至 48%。

docs.title: 真实新意
docs.text: 创新在显式追踪“未来动作仍依赖哪些已建立条件”，不是新的 VLA/WAM 动作表示。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: PDDL 操作符预定义；在线使用 GPT-4o，单次失败最多 4 次 VLM 调用、3 轮修复；真机没有注入扰动且每任务仅 10 次。报告明确关闭人工协助。

docs.text:

模块/trick（带训练机制）｜VLA/WAM 可插拔｜低层控制/策略学习｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Robot foundation models increasingly rely on flow-based action generation for general-purpose manipulation, yet the generated actions are not guaranteed to satisfy physical constraints such as joint limits and collision avoidance. This problem is especially challenging when the feasible set cannot be described analytically and is accessible only through black-box feasibility oracles. We study this practical oracle-only setting and propose an oracle-guided differentiable safeguard for safe flow-matching robot policies. The safeguard uses binary feasibility queries to correct unsafe updates in the forward pass, while extracting local boundary information to provide constraint-aware learning signals in the backward pass. Combined with discrete-time flow matching, the same safeguard is used during training and inference, enabling forward--backward aligned policy learning without explicit or differentiable constraint models. Experiments on obstacle-aware robotic manipulation demonstrate 100% constraint satisfaction while preserving task performance.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 同一可行性 oracle 在前向中搜索首次越界并截断更新，在反向中估计边界法向与梯度，同时用于安全训练。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 只用黑盒二元可行性查询，在 flow 生成前向中截断越界更新、反向中估计局部边界梯度，让训练和部署使用同一个安全干预。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 单一仿真避障搬运任务、每方法 30 episodes；π0.5+safeguard 达到 100% step safety、11/30 成功，原始高斯初始化 π0.5 为 78.25% safety、13/30 成功；平滑度 LDLJ 从 -22.99 改善到 -18.35。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 仅单任务仿真、30 次小样本；成功率略低于无约束基线；每个 action chunk 推理 1.345 s，对比 0.071 s，约慢 18.9 倍；安全性受 oracle 保真度、查询分辨率和初始可行样本限制。

docs.title: 为什么值得读／真实新意
docs.text:
这是很典型的高价值“trick”：不需要显式可微约束，且边界信息进入训练；但距离真实时安全层还有显著延迟与验证缺口。

docs.text:
RoboAtom: Large-scale Atomic-Action Supervision for Robot Learning

VLA 与策略学习记忆与技能

首发 2026-10-29，arXiv:2610.40207 v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-01 日报

数据＋基准＋核心方法｜VLA｜技能／阶段＋低层执行｜桌面／双臂操作（仿真控制评测）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Fine-grained action annotations can support skill reuse and compositional generalization in robot policies. However, robot datasets typically provide task-level instructions without subtask annotations. Although some include subtask labels, inconsistent formats and conventions hinder cross-source joint training. We propose RoboAtom-Data, which adds unified, time-aligned atomic-action annotations to existing data from multiple sources, covering 1.45 million trajectories, 6.88 million skill-labeled segments, and 16,882.1 hours. Our pipeline combines a unified protocol, large-scale manual annotation, propagation across repeated executions with the same ordered skill sequence, and multi-stage quality control. We evaluate the dataset through automatic atomic-action annotation and robot control. We construct RoboAtom-Bench to standardize evaluation of skill recognition and temporal boundary localization. Trained on the annotated data, RoboAtom-Anno achieves better automatic annotation performance than all evaluated open- and closed-source models on both RoboAtom-Bench and the external WGO-Bench. For robot control, atomic-action supervision paired with hierarchical execution improves task success over task-level baselines on LIBERO-Long, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin. We will release the data, benchmark, model, and construction pipeline to support further research on skill-level robot learning.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 数据构建流程
docs.text: 模型辅助标注与人工复核建立种子片段，PhysExtend 和质量控制扩展为数据集，专家审核建立评测标注。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 为多源机器人数据统一增加时间对齐的 atomic-action 标签，并以 skill-conditioned post-training＋System 2 调度验证阶段监督对长程执行的价值。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: RoboAtom-Data 覆盖 145 万轨迹、688 万技能片段、16,882.1 小时。相同 post-training 预算下，π0.5 在 LIBERO-Long 从 95.00→98.20%，LIBERO-Plus Overall 从 84.05→88.18%，RoboTwin Clean/Random 平均从 64.37→66.17%。

docs.title: 真实新意
docs.text: 贡献主要是跨数据源一致的阶段语义、边界定位和分层执行接口，不是新的低层 action tokenizer。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 控制增益目前只在仿真 post-training 验证，尚未证明大规模预训练收益；标签建设仍包含大量人工标注与同任务传播，尚未覆盖更碎片化的人类第一视角视频。

docs.text:

LLM-guided Planar Loco-Manipulation for Quadruped Robots

首发 2026-10-29，arXiv:2610.40248 v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-01 日报
