大系统＋核心方法｜Agent＋RL｜技能／阶段＋低层控制｜移动操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Robotic navigation typically assumes a collision-free route to the goal exists; in cluttered environments with movable obstacles, however, reaching the goal may require physical interaction. Classical solutions encode these behaviors through geometric rules and task-specific logic, while learning-based approaches often constrain the decision space to low-dimensional motion commands or predefined action sets. We instead consider a broader decision space, jointly selecting the skill, relevant object, and geometric target. Our language-conditioned task planner, fine-tuned with LoRA on synthetic data, maps natural-language tasks and a structured scene representation to variable-length sequences of parameterized actions, executed by low-level reinforcement-learning policies. The planner learns the geometric relations underlying interactive navigation and outperforms a classical planner and a prompted frontier model on interactive navigation tasks. Comparisons with models trained from scratch indicate that composition does not require pretraining when the representation is structured, whereas pretraining yields more reliable geometric targets. At the low level, we introduce an end-to-end whole-body planar pushing policy that achieves a 93.3% success rate in simulation, versus 83.5% for a hierarchical baseline, while reducing completion time by more than 60%. On hardware, the hierarchy yields the correct skill composition in 44/45 trials and end-to-end success in 34/45. Project website: https://anonymousprojects-dev.github.io/LLM-guided-LocoManipulation-Quadrupeds/

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 事件驱动规划器读取任务、场景位姿及上一技能，输出对象和几何目标，再由导航或全身推物策略执行首个技能。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 用 LoRA 微调的 Qwen2.5-1.5B 在结构化场景上联合选择技能、对象和连续几何目标，再由导航与全身推物 RL 策略执行。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 低层端到端推物策略仿真成功率 93.3%，层级基线 83.5%，完成时间降低超过 60%。九种真机场景共 45 次，技能组合正确 44/45，整任务成功 34/45；未见的 M→N→M 组合虽规划正确 10/10，但整任务仅 4/10。

docs.title: 真实新意
docs.text: 高层决策不是离散技能选择，而是同时输出对象与几何目标；低层则专门学习整身 planar pushing。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 真机规划输入来自 motion capture 的对象／机器人位姿和二维几何；只测单一房间，planner 仅在技能切换时运行，且不了解低层可执行域，导致规划正确却执行失败。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
把“高层组合正确率”和“整任务成功率”分开报告，清楚暴露 planner–controller 接口失配。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM

首发 2026-10-29，arXiv:2610.40373 v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-01 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

核心方法｜VLA＋WM/WAM｜低层策略学习｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated promising capabilities in robotic manipulation by integrating visual perception, language understanding, and action generation. Recent advances have further incorporated future prediction to enhance the understanding of environmental dynamics and task progression. However, existing methods often model short-term dynamics and long-term task objectives separately, while directly incorporating predicted futures into action policies without sufficiently considering their relevance to current action requirements. To address these limitations, we propose HiFOR, a hierarchical foresight framework with action-guided world retrieval. Specifically, Hierarchical Foresight Prediction jointly predicts short-term state evolution, semantic milestones, and final goal states through a Hierarchical Dependency Mask (HDM), establishing dependencies across temporal horizons. Building upon these predictions, Structure-Aware Latent World Modeling organizes future latent representations along the horizon, view, and spatial dimensions to facilitate fine-grained retrieval. Furthermore, Action-Guided Factorized World Retrieval adaptively retrieves relevant future information from the structured latent world based on evolving action representations during denoising, providing targeted guidance for action generation. Extensive experiments on two simulation benchmarks and six real-world robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 分层预测短期、里程碑与目标未来，将潜变量组织到时间、视角和空间维度，并由动作去噪表征选择相关未来。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 同时预测短期状态、阶段里程碑和最终目标的 latent future，并让 action denoising 按 horizon、视角和空间位置检索当前最相关的未来信息。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: RoboTwin 2.0 Hard 为 49.40%，复现的 π0.5 为 40.35%；LIBERO 平均 98.3%，π0.5 为 96.9%。AgileX PiPER 六项真机任务、每任务 50 次，平均 81.7%，比 π0.5 高 11.0 点；每任务使用 100 条示范，长程任务 200 条。

docs.title: 真实新意
docs.text: 不是简单把未来特征拼到策略，而是显式组织多时间尺度 latent world，并由动作表示动态检索。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 训练使用 8×H200；论文未给真机均值的置信区间或多训练种子方差，也未充分量化 hierarchical future 模块的部署延迟。

docs.text:

docs.title: Continuous-Action World Models
docs.text:
Continuous-Action World Models: Learning Cross-Embodiment Spatiotemporal Dynamics Priors

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM

首发 2026-10-29，v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-02 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

本次未在已核验的 v1 原论文和摘要页找到作者项目主页或代码入口。 （2026-11-05 核查）

核心方法｜WM/WAM｜低层控制/策略学习｜桌面双臂操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

We introduce Continuous-Action World Models (CoAWM), a framework for learning cross-embodiment spatiotemporal dynamics priors that support robot action generation across embodiments and execution frequencies. At its core is a shared latent function space that captures the spatial and temporal structure of robot actions. We learn this space through two stages. First, function pretraining brings trajectories from different embodiments and sampling frequencies into a common representation, learning shared dynamics priors through action reconstruction and consistency across temporal sampling views. By accommodating heterogeneous robot trajectories, this stage broadens the range of data sources available for pretraining and facilitates scaling to larger and more diverse datasets. Second, we connect the pretrained function space to a world-model backbone, enabling observations, language instructions, and the current robot state to condition the prediction of a latent action function. A single decoder takes any query time and returns the corresponding end-effector action. By separating shared dynamics priors from task-conditioned action selection and temporal sampling, our approach provides a unified foundation for transferring robot experience across embodiments and control frequencies.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 连续动作函数分两阶段学习跨形态、跨采样频率的时空先验，再连接世界模型，部署时按物理时间查询动作。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 把动作块表示为可按物理时间任意查询的连续潜在函数，并用跨 embodiment、跨采样频率的轨迹预训练，再接入 LaWAM 的视觉世界模型来生成可执行动作。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 8192 个留出窗口上重建误差为 2.503 mm／0.2295°；16 个任务、800 对配对初始条件下，相比 LaWAM，平移/旋转 jerk RMS 分别降低 36.7%/54.2%，速度基本不变；50 个任务在 10–60 Hz 六种执行频率下，150 次试验分别成功 110–121 次；13 个双方均成功场景中估计正机械功降低 22.6%。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 作者明确称为快速验证，尚未完成更大规模训练与完整微调；75.1% 的整体任务成功率不算强，长时执行仍有明显 jerk 尾部，能耗只在“双方都成功”的 13 个场景上统计。

docs.title: 为什么值得读／真实新意
docs.text:
新意不只是“连续动作”，而是把跨频率轨迹预训练、世界模型条件化与查询式执行统一到同一潜在函数接口；实验同时报告任务成功、平滑性、频率迁移和能耗，评价维度较完整。

docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 10

docs.title: SwapBot
docs.text:
SwapBot: Tool-Centric Robot Manipulation via Interchangeable End-Effectors and Tactile Sensing

记忆与技能

首发 2026-10-29，arXiv:2610.40646 v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-01 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

作者项目主页已核验，暂未提供可核验的代码入口；Hardware Guide 标注 soon。 （2026-11-05 核查）

大系统＋模块｜其他：视触觉模仿学习｜技能／阶段＋低层控制｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Robot manipulation in everyday environments inherently involves substantial tool usage. Seemingly simple household tasks, such as cooking pan-fried tofu, require forceful cutting, delicate brushing, and precise placement using different tools under contact-rich interaction. Thus, the ability to autonomously swap and use task-appropriate tools is important for tool-centric manipulation. We introduce SwapBot, a modular, tool-centric end effector system featuring low-cost adapters that quickly convert common household tools into robot end effectors. Rather than pursuing a single universal gripper, SwapBot adopts a unified design principle that combines a fixed robot-side coupling interface with low-cost, tool-side adapters, enabling compatibility with diverse tools, including articulated ones, and multiple robot platforms. Each adapter integrates compact tactile sensors, supports fast autonomous swapping, and interfaces with an intuitive teleoperation system for efficient demonstration collection. User studies show that, during teleoperation, SwapBot reduces task completion time and operator workload. Using collected demonstrations on the robot, we train imitation learning policies to successfully perform tool-centric tasks like cooking tofu, stirring salad, flipping meat. Our ablation study shows that using tactile-augmented demonstrations improves policy performance across contact-rich skills, increasing success rates by 15 to 25 percentage points over RGB-only policies. These results highlight modular, tactile-equipped tools as a practical and extensible pathway toward robust and capable robot manipulation. Project website https://personalrobotics.github.io/SwapBot.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 高层根据俯视观测与目标图选择工具，低层工具专用扩散策略结合多视角图像、触觉与本体状态生成动作。图源：作者论文 · Figure 4 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 用统一快换接口把普通厨房工具变成带低成本触觉阵列的机器人末端，并配套同构遥操作与分层工具策略。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 每个工具技能 100 条示范；20 rollouts/seed、三种子。多视角 RGB＋触觉在刷酱／夹取／切割达到 85/70/90%，RGB-only 为 70/45/75%。高层工具选择准确率 96.8%；手工串联最佳技能完成整道豆腐任务 12/20。另有 12 人、每人每条件 10 次的遥操作用户研究。

docs.title: 真实新意
docs.text: 创新在可扩展的“工具即末端”硬件接口与触觉数据，而不是 VLA 或语言规划。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 长程子目标序列人工预定义，技能完成检测与 reset 规则较强；触觉传感器低分辨率、易磨损，放置由人工经验决定；整任务只测 20 次。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
提醒家庭操作的大系统能力可能首先受工具接口和接触可观测性限制，而不只是基础模型规模。

docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 01

docs.title: WorldBridge
docs.text:
WorldBridge: Scaling World Models for Robot Learning with Unlabeled Videos

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM

首发 2026-10-29，v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-03 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

日报题名沿用邮件原文；arXiv v1 原题为“WorldBridge: Bridging Video and Action for Task Generalization in World Action Models”。作者项目主页已核验，暂未提供可核验的作者代码仓库入口。 （2026-11-05 核查）

大系统 / 核心方法｜VLA + WM/WAM｜低层策略学习｜桌面操作（含多平台）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Achieving the broad task generalization of embodied models in physical environments remains a central challenge in robot learning. We study this challenge in World Action Models (WAMs) through two complementary capabilities: video generalization, which predicts the visual evolution of new tasks, and action generalization, which translates these predictions into executable behavior through a video-to-action bridge. By varying video and action supervision for tasks outside an initial training set, we examine their respective contributions to task transfer. On RoboTwin 2.0, using only in-distribution video-action supervision yields a 25.07% success rate on out-of-distribution tasks. Introducing videos of these tasks without their action labels raises success to 55.90%, while adding just one action-labeled demonstration per task further improves it to 70.70%. These findings suggest that broader video coverage enables task transfer by leveraging existing inverse-dynamics capabilities, while even sparse action supervision further strengthens those capabilities. Guided by this perspective, we introduce WorldBridge, a WAM with separate video and action experts connected through structured attention and trained with joint flow matching. WorldBridge incorporates visual memory at two temporal scales and action forcing, alongside a unified data processing pipeline that standardizes and filters heterogeneous robot trajectories and egocentric hand-derived supervision. Across multiple manipulation benchmarks, WorldBridge achieves state-of-the-art performance among the compared methods, including 96.23% on RoboTwin 2.0 full data setting and 80.9% on clean to random setting, 82.8% on RoboCasa GR1 TableTop, and 57.6% on DOMINO Level-1. Our study highlights the complementary roles of video prediction and action grounding in developing robots that generalize across tasks.

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 视频专家和共享动作专家通过结构化注意力与联合 flow matching 连接，并使用统一动作空间及长短期视觉记忆。图源：作者论文 · Figure 3 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 把视频专家与动作专家通过结构化注意力和联合 flow matching 连接，使无动作标注的视频直接改善机器人策略，而不是只靠成对动作数据扩规模。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 任务生成实验中，纯 ID 视频-动作训练在 OOD 任务成功率为 25.07%；加入无动作 OOD 视频后为 55.90%，每任务再给 1 条动作示范后为 70.70%。完整系统在 RoboTwin、C2R、RoboCasa-GR1 tabletop、DOMINO-L1 分别报告 96.23%、80.9%、82.8%、57.6%。真实平台覆盖 Agibot G2 与 AC-1；BridgeData V2 微调平均成功率 84.4%，优化后端到端推理约 103.9 ms、近 7 Hz。

docs.title: 真实新意与局限
docs.text: 新意在于让“只有视频、没有动作”的数据进入同一世界—动作生成框架。局限是所谓 OOD 结果已经看过对应 OOD 任务视频；加 1 条动作示范后也不再是严格零样本。训练依赖大规模异构数据和平台微调，论文未充分给出置信区间。

docs.text:
这是本期最直接连接世界模型、VLA 与无动作视频扩展性的工作，实验跨度和真实平台证据也最完整。

docs.title: CaPtain
docs.text:
CaPtain: A Physical-Critic Post-Training Pipeline for Robot Agents

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能

首发 2026-10-29，v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-03 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗GitHub ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

日报题名沿用邮件原文；arXiv v1 原题为“CaPtain: A Pipeline for Post-Training Code-as-Policy Robot Agents”。官方仓库提供 CaPtain 的 SFT/RL 流程及独立的 CaPtain-Harness；模型和数据需通过作者另列的平台获取。原日报描述为“调用 VLA”，原论文与官方仓库则明确为调用低层代码 API、无 VLA 的 code-as-policy agent，保留日报原文并注明此差异。本次未运行复现实验。 （2026-11-03 核查）

核心方法 / 大系统｜Agent + VLA 接口｜技能/阶段 + 规划/验证｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Across coding, web, and tool-use tasks, language-model agents are now routinely trained with the same recipe: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to learn the interface, then multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) to master it. Code-as-policy (CaP) casts robot manipulation in the same form, as the policy writes code against robot APIs and reads back the results, so the same recipe should apply. Yet existing CaP agents sidestep training: they either prompt closed frontier models or delegate manipulation to pre-trained vision-language-action models (VLAs) and high-level skills, while small open vision-language models (VLMs) fail outright. We present CaPtain, an open post-training pipeline that turns a small open VLM into a capable CaP agent, with no VLA, frontier model, or privileged state at test time. CaPtain trains and deploys the policy inside CaPtain-Harness, which exposes low-level perception, geometry, and guarded-motion primitives across simulation and real hardware. We first align the base model via SFT on synthetic trajectories generated with GPT-6 Astra, then apply multi-turn RL. Multi-turn RL must credit tens of agent requests, whose physical effects often surface turns later, from a single end-of-episode outcome. We therefore introduce a physical critic that reads privileged simulator state, never seen by the policy, and credits each request by how much it changes the predicted chance of success. Starting from Qwen3.5-4B (0% zero-shot), CaPtain-4B reaches 55.4% held-out LIBERO success after SFT and 73.8% after RL. On LIBERO-PRO, it reaches 78.5%, surpassing several frontier-model agents, and its RL gains persist across three perturbation suites (+17.6 to +21.2 points). Without target-domain training, it attains 83.3% on SimplerEnv WidowX, exceeds frontier models on CaP-Bench, and runs on a real robot after simulation-only adaptation. We release all code, data, and model weights.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 上方为低层代码 API、执行与回执构成的推理闭环；下方为 SFT 与利用特权仿真状态 critic 的 RL，测试时移除 critic。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 用“精确仿真状态可见但对策略隐藏”的 physical critic 做多轮强化学习后训练，让 4B 具身 agent 学会调用 VLA、判断完成、请求重试和恢复。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: held-out LIBERO 上从未训练模型的 0%，经 SFT 到 55.4%，再经 RL 到 73.8%；严格成功率 52.1%→67.5%，错误提前结束 7.1%→2.1%。LIBERO-PRO 为 78.5%，扰动设置相对提升 17.6–21.2 个百分点；SimplerEnv WidowX 为 83.3%。LIBERO 系列每条件 240–800 回合。真实 Astrabot XR1 仅展示两条执行轨迹，未形成有统计量的真实成功率。

docs.title: 真实新意与局限
docs.text: 相比一般 SFT agent，关键是 privileged physical critic 只用于 RL 训练，部署时不需要真值状态；但 RL 只覆盖 40 个 LIBERO 任务和单 7DoF 机械臂，critic 对 2 cm/5 cm 状态噪声的相关性明显下降。真实机证据目前主要是定性展示，且适配层含 benchmark-specific safeguards。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
它把 agentic embodied 的“验证与恢复”从 prompt 设计推进到可量化的后训练问题，边界披露也相对清楚。

From Teleoperation to Long-Horizon Dexterity: A Controlled Study of Imitation Learning Design Choices

VLA 与策略学习

日报题名沿用邮件原文；arXiv v1 原题为“From Teleoperation to Long-Horizon Dexterity: Evaluating Visuomotor Skills and Offline Proxies for Dexterous Manipulation”。本次未在已核验的 v1 原论文和摘要页找到作者项目主页或代码入口。 （2026-11-05 核查）

基准/诊断｜VLA + 模仿学习｜低层策略学习｜桌面灵巧操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Imitation learning policies are intended to make robotic manipulation robust to variations in object pose, appearance, and environment that challenge pre-programmed motion. However, real-world performance remains difficult to predict, as conventional optimization signals such as validation loss show no consistent relationship with robot success. To identify the design choices that govern real-world performance, 281 imitation-learning policies spanning seven policy families were evaluated in approximately 1,700 real-robot trials of RJ45 connector grasping and insertion using a five-fingered robotic hand. Controlled ablations showed that observation and action representations dominated conventional optimizer and sampling choices. For point-cloud policies, region-of-interest cropping, representation in the robot-base frame, and normalization within the point encoder each improved success by 70-100 percentage points. For the vision-language-action policy, absolute rather than relative action prediction improved insertion success by up to 70 percentage points. Skill decomposition, multi-view perception, and recovery demonstrations were associated with the strongest-performing systems, although their effects were not independently isolated. Of 67 offline metrics evaluated, only five measures of predicted-motion smoothness and directness reliably correlated with insertion success (r = -0.70 to -0.80), and only within a single policy family. These results identify representation choices as key determinants of real-world imitation-learning performance and show that offline metrics can shortlist policies, but cannot replace real-robot evaluation.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 技能流程
docs.text: 遥操作数据经同步、技能分段和训练形成视觉运动技能，执行时由经典点到点运动与学习技能协同编排。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 通过 281 个策略、约 1700 次真实试验，系统拆解 RJ45 抓取插入中表示、归一化、动作坐标和技能分解的影响，显示若干“工程选择”的效应远大于换模型。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 在五指手 RJ45 抓取插入上，ROI、基座坐标系和归一化各可带来约 70–100 个百分点提升；VLA 的 absolute 对 relative action 选择相差约 70 点。最佳 iDP3 在两个夹具上均达 100%；紧凑点云策略以约 1/8 推理显存匹配微调 VLA，并在环境变化下达 80–100%。端到端插入最高仅 10%，技能分解显著更好。67 个离线指标中只有 5 个平滑/直接性指标在单一策略族内相关（r≈-0.70 至 -0.80）。

docs.title: 真实新意与局限
docs.text: 它的价值是控制变量与负结果，不是新算法。局限是单一 RJ45 任务族和单套手部硬件；技能分解、多视角、恢复等因素并未全部独立隔离，离线指标也没有跨策略族通用性。

docs.text:

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Robot-free human demonstrations offer a promising route to scaling dexterous manipulation data. The key challenge is to preserve the demonstrator's natural dexterity while producing contact-grounded observations and actions that transfer to robot hands. We present Contact Imitation Interface (CIMI), a framework with contact-grounded demonstration and learning interfaces. The demonstration interface combines shared contact geometry and fingertip RGB views with contact-alignment-first retargeting and reprojection of wider scene views. The learning interface introduces a hierarchical policy in which a contact-surface planner predicts relative contact-surface trajectories and a controller coordinates wrist and finger commands to improve contact alignment. CIMI combines contact-grounded observations, retargeting, and action representations, improving mean final-stage success by at least 50 percentage points over baseline policies across six hand-task pairs on LEAP and Wuji. Hardware designs and software are publicly available.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 共享指尖接触界面连接人类示范、接触优先重定向、视角重投影及接触表面规划与控制。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 以共享接触几何和指尖 RGB 为跨人手/机器人手接口，用 contact-first retargeting 与接触表面层级策略从无机器人遥操作的人类示范学习多指操作。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 在 LEAP/Wuji 两种手、6 个手-任务组合上，每方法每组合 20 次真实 rollout；完整 ContactSurface+CTX+CC 平均最终阶段成功率 80.8%，WristJoint+CTX+CC 为 30.8%，去掉 contact correction 的 ContactSurface+CTX 仅 1.7%。各任务收集 103–187 条人类示范；完整方法在 LEAP 四任务为 75/85/80/90%，Wuji 两任务为 70/85%。

docs.title: 真实新意与局限
docs.text: 创新集中在接触表示与跨形态数据接口，而非 VLA/agent。需要专用指尖相机、几何标定、retargeting 和按手设计的控制器；每条件仅 20 次，且对比主要是同一系统组件消融。

docs.text:

大系统 / 模块｜Agentic coding + VLA｜技能/阶段 + 规划/恢复｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Robot agents built on vision-language models depend on both the planner and its harness: the tools, feedback, memory, and recovery logic around it. Can improvements to a large teacher's harness be carried into a compact agent with lower inference compute cost? We present TinyAstral, a two-stage approach. We first freeze an open-weight teacher and improve its harness through recursive self-improvement (RSI): frontier LLM agents read the teacher's trajectories and propose harness edits, and each edit is accepted only if it passes a paired statistical test. We then freeze the final harness, collect teacher trajectories with reasoning and failure recovery, and distill a small student that replaces the teacher in the same harness. On RoboTwin, harness evolution raises the teacher's success from 33.4% to 63.6%; the final 4B student reaches 62.8%. Across four harness versions, distilled 4B students score close to their corresponding teachers, and later versions yield stronger students, showing that harness evolution gains carry into compact models. The harness gains also transfer to other frozen planners without retraining. On identical episodes, the final 4B student outperforms open 4B agents, the open 27B harness-RSI model SenseNova-RoboRSI, and our own teacher model placed in three competitors' harnesses. It stays close to its teacher on all three training benchmarks, and on three benchmarks never used for RSI or training it scores close to a 552B planner running the same harness. On the measured deployment episodes, it uses about one fifth of its teacher's accelerator time.

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 先通过配对统计验收演化冻结教师的 harness，再将成功轨迹、推理和恢复过程蒸馏到小模型，最后在同一 harness 中部署。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 先用带配对统计验收的递归自改进进化教师 harness，再把教师的推理和恢复轨迹蒸馏到 4B 学生，实现接近教师效果但显著降低推理成本。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 教师在 RoboTwin 从 33.4% 提至 63.6%，4B 学生达到 62.8%；评估含 RoboTwin 500、Guava 450、LIBERO-PRO 300，以及 SimplerEnv 960、VLABench 500、EB-Manip 228 回合，均使用严格整任务成功率和相同配对初始条件。20 个 SimplerEnv 回合中，学生用 25.3 accelerator-seconds、成功 14/20，教师为 123.8 accelerator-seconds。

docs.title: 真实新意与局限
docs.text: 新意是把“自改进 harness”进一步压缩为可部署小模型；但蒸馏数据只保留成功教师轨迹，失败种子还允许额外重试，存在筛选偏差。SO-ARM101 真实机只提供定性分拣/堆叠展示，不足以证明跨硬件泛化。

docs.text:

docs.title: VLA Policies Do Not Know When Not to Act
docs.text:
VLA Policies Do Not Know When Not to Act

VLA 与策略学习

首发 2026-10-30，v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-03 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

日报题名沿用邮件原文；arXiv v1 原题为“VLA Policies Do Not Know When Not to Act: Unintended Task Execution and Start Suppression”。原论文给出的作者仓库两次核验均返回 HTTP 404，暂不列作可用代码入口。已核对 v1 HTML 与 17 页 PDF；原文三张图均为任务执行分布、门控距离或微调结果等评测图，未提供方法架构图，本次不配框架图。 （2026-11-06 核查）

基准/诊断｜VLA｜规划/观测/验证 + 低层接口｜桌面操作（仿真）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

A robot should act only on an instruction from a person or on an intent that the robot explicitly represents and generates. Unintended actions taken without such an instruction can cause risk or inconvenience to people and the environment. We examine how recent vision-language-action (VLA) policies respond when the instruction is missing or meaningless. We apply a paired protocol with empty, neutral, nonsense, infeasible, and wrong-task instructions to six model checkpoints in LIBERO-Goal simulation. Holding the initial state fixed and varying only the instruction, we ask three questions: whether the robot starts to move, which task it completes, and what the instruction determines. Even when the instruction was empty, the robot started moving in every episode with all six checkpoints, and with five of them it often completed a task that the instruction had not specified. On two GR00T checkpoints, the instruction determined which task was executed but not whether the robot started moving; the robot moved even on infeasible instructions. We then tested three methods for suppressing the start: prepending "if no task is given do not move" to the instruction; a gate that holds the robot when the first action chunk for the given instruction nearly equals that for an empty instruction; and fine-tuning the policy to hold still on non-task inputs. The prefix stopped the robot in none of the six checkpoints, and the gate held it on non-task inputs in five of the six checkpoints. The fine-tuned policy never completed a task on non-task inputs, but it did not reliably keep the robot still, and it failed to suppress the start on infeasible instructions.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 证明多种 VLA 在空指令、已完成或不可执行指令下仍倾向持续动作，并系统比较 prompt、动作差分门控和微调三类抑制方案。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 6 个 checkpoint、每条件每模型 200 回合、单一 LIBERO 布局。空指令下 5 个模型完成任意任务的比例为 30.5–94.0%，SmolVLA 也会移动或接触物体；基于动作差分的 gate 能让 6 个模型中的 5 个在非任务输入时保持静止，prompt 前缀基本无效，微调可阻止继续任务但仍难处理静止/不可行状态。

docs.title: 真实新意与局限
docs.text: 新意是把“何时不应行动”从语言拒答转成闭环动作安全诊断，不是新策略。只在一个 LIBERO 仿真布局评估，未覆盖危险物、碰撞损失或真实机器人，因此不能直接解释为完整安全结论。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
它暴露了当前 VLA 被成功率指标掩盖的终止与 no-op 能力缺口，对系统部署和 agent verifier 很重要。

首发 2026-10-30，v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-03 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

日报题名沿用邮件原文；arXiv v1 原题为“Direct Action-Manifold Modeling for Efficient and Robust Bimanual Manipulation”。本次未在已核验的 v1 原论文和摘要页找到作者项目主页或代码入口。 （2026-11-06 核查）

核心方法 + 模块｜动作生成（非 VLA）｜低层策略学习/执行｜桌面双臂操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Diffusion and flow matching visuomotor policies require iterative denoising or numerical integration for multimodal action generation, introducing latency and execution mismatch. We instead consider a different formulation: conditioned on vision and proprioception, demonstrated bimanual action chunks concentrate in a structured observation-dependent region of joint-action space, making the action target more direct to model than the generative process. Based on this view, we propose the Direct Manifold Action Transformer (DMAT), which reformulates action generation as the direct modeling of clean, observation-conditioned joint-space action chunks from stochastic interpolants, thereby enabling single-step inference without relying on iterative generative inference or auxiliary trajectory-straightening procedures. Within DMAT, local 3D geometry anchors predictions to spatial structure, while State-Consistent Spectral-Time Refinement (STR) reconciles predicted chunks with proprioception and suppresses high-frequency residuals. Across 567 standard and out-of-distribution (OOD) trials per method, DMAT outperformed Improved 3D Diffusion Policy (IDP3) and DiTFlow3D in aggregate success rate, achieving relative improvements of 129.1% and 95.7%, respectively, while generating action chunks 2.06x and 1.34x faster and remaining robust under repeated 50 N interventions. These results pave the way for a novel generative paradigm for efficient and robust bimanual manipulation.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 局部三维条件编码后单步预测动作块，再以 STR 对齐当前关节状态，并通过滚动时域执行闭环控制。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 不再迭代去噪或积分，而从随机插值状态单步预测干净动作块，并以局部 3D 条件和 STR 在重规划边界对齐真实关节状态。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: Fourier GR2 上做抓放、花瓶擦拭、双臂倒豆；每任务仅 50 条示范。标准条件 108 次/方法中 DMAT 为 70.4%（76/108），相对 IDP3、DiTFlow3D 分别提升 76.7% 和 46.2%；单块生成 24.2 ms，快 2.06×/1.34×。标准+OOD 共 567 次/方法；另有重复 50 N 拉拽。消融显示 Direct 44.4%、加 3D geometry 63.9%、再加 STR 70.4%。

docs.title: 真实新意与局限
docs.text: 直接 clean-action 建模是表示层创新，STR 则是执行接口模块；论文的成功率增益主要来自局部几何，不能只归因于“单步生成”。对比仅两个 10-step 基线，任务与单一 GR2 平台有限，STR 含多个人工阈值和门控，尚未验证跨平台迁移。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
它把生成速度、空间条件和物理扰动恢复放到同一真实双臂实验中，且消融足以看清各部分贡献。

docs.text:
SimuGuard: Auditing Contact Artifacts in Robot Simulation Benchmarks

VLA 与策略学习

首发 2026-10-30，v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-03 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

日报题名沿用邮件原文；arXiv v1 原题为“When the Simulator Fails, Not the Policy: Auditing Contact Artifacts in Simulated Robot Benchmarks”。官方仓库已包含监测、检测、精确回放和干预代码；README 将当前版本标为开发版，完整验证的适配器主要为 RoboTwin 2.0/SAPIEN 3，不能把论文跨基准实验等同于每个适配器均已完整发布。检测输出仍需人工核验。本次未运行复现实验。 （2026-11-03 核查）

基准/诊断 / 模块｜VLA 基准审计｜验证｜桌面操作（仿真）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Simulation benchmarks score robot policies by success rate, and every failed episode counts against the policy. Many of these failures are the simulator's fault, not the policy's; we find the cause and fix it. Testing a vision language action model and a world action model in simulation, we find that the policy often places the object and the simulator then ejects it, and that the benchmark's own scripted demonstrations fail the same way. We present SimuGuard, an auditing plugin for LIBERO, RoboTwin, RoboCasa and RoboDojo. It leaves the evaluation unchanged. At every physics step, it records the state and flags an object that starts moving at a contact faster than the robot's contact or gravity account for. It replays a recorded episode bit for bit, and it reruns the episode with one simulation parameter changed. With it we trace these episodes on RoboTwin to the collision detection of the physics engine: for geometry one to two centimeters apart, the engine reports a penetration of about two centimeters, and the solver throws the object out at several meters per second. The cause is one constant: the distance algorithm discards triangles below a fixed area threshold, which valid triangles fall below at the centimeter scale. With that constant changed and nothing else, episodes with an artifact fall from 12 in 100 to none, and the success rate on five container tasks rises from 89% to 98%. Success rates in simulation thus count failures that the simulator causes. Benchmarks on PhysX 5.3.1 or earlier should rerun in a repaired engine. Where the engine cannot change, they should report the success rate together with the range it spans when every flagged episode fails or passes: 75.8% to 98.5% around a reported 83.1% for LingBot-VA.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 审计流程
docs.text: 在原基准评测旁记录物理步、检测接触伪影、精确回放、改变单个参数重跑，并沿用原任务成功判据计分。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 提出可插拔接触伪影审计器，揭示 PhysX 细小三角形碰撞阈值会制造约 2 cm 的穿透并显著扭曲 VLA 排名。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 覆盖 LIBERO、RoboTwin、RoboCasa、RoboDojo；一个常数修正使 5 个容器任务中伪影从 12/100 降至 0/100，成功率从 89% 升至 98%。对 LingBot-VA，若把被标记回合全部判失败/成功，原报告 83.1% 可落在 75.8–98.5% 的宽区间。

docs.title: 真实新意与局限
docs.text: 这是 simulator/result auditing，不是策略改进。它只处理一类接触网格伪影，修复与特定 PhysX 版本和资产有关；不能替代真实机验证，也不说明所有仿真失败都应被忽略。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
当几个百分点就足以宣称 SOTA 时，9 点成功率变化说明基准物理层本身必须进入审计链。

docs.title: REA
docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 03

docs.title: REA
docs.text:
REA: Runtime Embodied Agency without Waiting for the Brain

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能移动操作

首发 2026-10-30，v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-03 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

日报题名沿用邮件原文；arXiv v1 原题为“REA: A Routed Embodied Agent Runtime for Asynchronous Brain-Cerebellum Control”。作者项目主页已核验，暂未提供可核验的作者代码仓库入口。 配图从 v1 原论文 PDF 第 1 页 Figure 1 提取。 （2026-11-06 核查）

大系统｜Agent + VLA + 代码技能｜技能/阶段 + 规划/观测/验证｜桌面操作 + 有限全身移动操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Foundation models are becoming remarkably reliable at high-level reasoning, yet they remain too slow and costly to serve as fine-grained controllers. Conversely, fast policies like VLAs and whole-body controllers offer more efficient reflexes, but struggle to generalize. While pairing a deliberative brain (foundation models) with a reactive cerebellum (fast policies) seems natural for embodied systems, two obstacles remain: methods are built and scored on incompatible stacks, and their asynchronous coordination is difficult. For example, an agent that calls the VLA in the agentic loop can stall the fast execution, while a VLA that calls the agent on errors tends to re-trigger fallbacks repeatedly or completely miss silent failures. To address this, we propose REA (Routed Embodied Agent), a unified runtime where a deliberative System 2, an embodied router System 1 and reactive System 0 policies cooperate under a single golden rule - no running policy waits on the brain. Instead of querying the brain at each failure, REA employs a route memory that stores each policy's measured success ahead of time, a boundary-triggered judge gate that consults the brain on policy execution, and a shared-budget escalation ladder for bounded recovery. Evaluated on 3,000 test episodes across 60 LIBERO-Pro tasks, REA reaches 95.9% success and beats the best single-agent baseline in its own policy pool (94.7%) while reducing control steps by 25% and control time by 17%. In a separate 100-episode RoboTwin 2.0 study, REA achieves 84% success with VLA policies and 86% with VLA+code, compared with 80% for the strongest single VLA baseline MEDex. These results demonstrate learned and programmatic policies operating within the same runtime. REA also transfers to BEHAVIOR-1K and a real Unitree G1 humanoid, achieving the highest observed success among the compared methods.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 运行时框架
docs.text: 冻结代码策略由 route memory 路由，并在边界交由视觉 judge 判断完成或升级恢复，配合共享预算继续执行。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 以异步 System-2/System-1/router/System-0 运行时把慢推理与执行解耦，并在技能边界学习路由和共享预算，使策略不必等待“脑”完成推理。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: LIBERO-PRO 60 任务、3000 回合中成功率 95.9%，高于最佳单一路线 94.7%，步骤数减 25%、时间减 17%，与 hindsight oracle 相差不超过 1%。RoboTwin 100 回合中 VLA+代码 86%，VLA 84%，最强单 VLA 80%。真实 Unitree G1“走到椅子并推移”10 次中成功 8 次，对比 Agents SDK 5、Codex 4、ASPIRE 2；AlohaMini2 方块放置各 10 次，REA 10/10。

docs.title: 真实新意与局限
docs.text: 核心是运行时编排和预算路由，不是新的低层策略。相对最佳单一路线，LIBERO 的绝对增益只有 1.2 点；系统依赖预先测量的路线记忆、179 个程序的技能池和人工判定。G1 实验没有测椅子位移且样本很小，因此只能视作有限全身操作证据，不能泛化为完整 mobile manipulation。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
它提供了 agentic 具身系统真正需要优化的系统指标：等待、切换、预算与边界判断，而不只报告任务成功率。

docs.title: RoboArchitect
docs.text:
RoboArchitect: Self-Improving Agent Harnesses for Robot Policies

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习

首发 2026-10-30，v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-03 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

日报题名沿用邮件原文；arXiv v1 原题为“RoboArchitect: Automating the Design of Robotic Agents with Persistent Memory”。官方仓库已提供 harness 演化、评测、策略包装和实验划分；冻结策略、辅助模型、相应基准及检查点需另行配置。本次核验资源，未运行优化或复现实验。 （2026-11-03 核查）

大系统 / 模块｜Agentic coding + VLA｜规划/观测/验证｜桌面操作（仿真）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Recent work shows that a frozen robot policy performs far better inside an agent harness, where control code decides when to query the policy, consult vision tools, or command the arm directly. Yet today these harnesses are built by hand and redesigned for each new robot or benchmark. We show that harness design can be automated, offering a strong alternative to finetuning on a novel setup. In RoboArchitect, a coding model observes a robot's rollouts, diagnoses failures, and iteratively revises the harness around the frozen policy. The harness evolves on a set of episodes for its optimization and is evaluated on held-out scenes and tasks. Without updating any model weights, RoboArchitect raises average success from 9.7% to 43.3% on unseen scenes (4.5x) and from 12.7% to 40.2% on unseen tasks (3.2x), across multiple benchmarks and policies. The gains are largest where the benchmark is far from the policy's training data: wrapping a general-purpose policy, the evolved harness yields a specialist that often outperforms even the finetuned version. Intuitive control strategies are automatically designed, such as lifting a jammed arm clear or reaching in horizontally when an obstacle blocks the way from above. The harness also evolves its own persistent memory, carrying learned experience, such as effective grasp depths, into later decisions. These results suggest that substantial headroom in robotic manipulation lies in the agent harness, and its design can be effectively automated and optimized without weight updates.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 编码模型读取冻结策略的执行轨迹，迭代修改 harness、工具与持久记忆，并在独立场景和任务中评估。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 让 coding model 阅读 rollout、诊断失败并自动修改冻结机器人策略外围的感知、记忆、规划和恢复代码，形成可持续改进的 agent harness。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 在多基准、多冻结策略上，unseen scenes 成功率从 9.7% 提至 43.3%，unseen tasks 从 12.7% 提至 40.2%。统一 harness 用 2201 个程序化优化回合，随后在 2160 个独立 held-out 标准回合评估；最多 5 轮改写，并保留跨轮持久记忆。

docs.title: 真实新意与局限
docs.text: 新意是把 agentic coding 明确放在策略外部，并用 held-out rollout 验证“改代码而非改权重”的收益。它不是 VLA 本体进步；系统级优化仍消耗大量针对性 rollout，当前主要为仿真，5 轮上限之外是否继续改进未知。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
这是“agentic coding for robotics”中实验设计较完整的一篇，适合作为大系统与核心策略贡献的分界案例。

docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 02

docs.title: WorldSketch
docs.text:
WorldSketch: Embodied Reasoning via Visual-Validated World Models

世界模型与 WAM智能体与程序学习

大系统＋核心方法｜WM/WAM＋Agent/agentic coding｜规划/观测/验证｜模拟厨房全身操作；另含仅导航实验

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Most agentic robotic systems use vision-language models (VLMs) either to orchestrate predefined skills or to directly generate actions, constraints, and control programs. The former is limited by the available skill library, while the latter requires VLMs to reason about precise geometry and contact. In this paper, we propose WorldSketch, a new paradigm for agentic robotics in which a VLM constructs a world model rather than generating robot actions. The VLM acts as an agent that actively queries perception tools to build and visually validate a minimal kinematic world model, capturing only task-relevant objects, their interaction geometry, and possible motions. A geometric planner then jointly optimizes contact and whole-body motion on the resulting model. Moreover, the world model is self-improving: execution feedback verifies outcomes, updates uncertain hypotheses, and enables the agent to revise the model when its predictions are contradicted. We demonstrate the generality of this paradigm across RoboCasa, LIBERO-PRO, and R2R-CE navigation, achieving zero-shot success rates of 91%, 97%, and 76%, respectively. On RoboCasa, WorldSketch outperforms the next-best zero-shot agent baseline by 58 percentage points while using 10 times fewer VLM input tokens; on LIBERO-PRO, it exceeds CaP-X by 82 percentage points. In navigation, it matches the success rate of step-by-step VLM agents while using 6 times fewer input tokens.

日报题名沿用邮件原文；arXiv v1 原题为“PREM: Prediction-Regulated Memory for Robot Manipulation”。原文项目入口现引导至已核验的新项目页；Code 与 Model 均标为 Coming soon，未提供可用下载入口。原图带透明背景，沿用完整原图。 （2026-11-06 核查）

核心方法｜VLA＋WM/WAM｜低层策略/视觉记忆｜模拟桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

A robot's next action can depend on recent motion or earlier visual evidence absent from its current observation. A recurrent visual-memory architecture can retain this history in a visual state, but its usefulness depends on what the state represents and how it is updated with new observations. We introduce Prediction-Regulated Memory (PREM), a framework that uses action-conditioned future prediction to guide both memory learning and updating in vision-language-action policies. During training, predicting future visual features provides temporal supervision for memory learning. During execution, PREM compares current visual features with the prediction made at the preceding decision and uses the spatially normalized prediction discrepancy to regulate updates to the visual state at each spatial location. The updated visual state supplies temporal context for action generation alongside current observations. Built on $π_{0.5}$, PREM improves average success rate from 9.63% to 20.74% on DOMINO dynamic manipulation tasks and from 14.4% to 83.8% on the RMBench M(1) memory-dependent setting. Further evaluations on LIBERO and LIBERO-Pro show improvements in general manipulation and robustness to spatial perturbations. PREM incurs a mean inference overhead of 7.7 ms on a single NVIDIA H800 GPU.

大系统｜Agent/agentic coding｜规划/观测/验证｜模拟桌面与移动操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-language models can interpret instructions and plan manipulation tasks, yet struggle when acting directly as robot policies. On RoboDojo, a large planning-execution gap separates high-level task decisions from physical execution: removing arm execution raises GPT-6 Astra's success rate from 22.5% under the reference control interface to 76.2%. We present Auriga, a task-agnostic agent harness that closes 68.3% of this gap in zero-shot manipulation without target-task trials or resets. In Auriga, the model makes all task decisions over an explicit task belief and acts through either direct tool calls or synthesized multi-step Python programs, while the harness supplies calibrated 3D measurements, finger-referenced dual-arm control, and a single admission gateway to the robot. Before motion, the model inspects a visual trajectory preview while simulation is paused; during execution, the harness checks declared stage tolerances and grasp bounds, stopping the robot on divergence and returning the measured discrepancy for in-place recovery. Developed across 13 cross-task capability iterations and frozen for evaluation, Auriga ranks first on the RoboDojo leaderboard with a 57.7% success rate (64.0 Score), more than doubling the reference harness on the same model, and remains first under scene randomization while learned policies drop by up to 33.9%. On RoboCasa365, the same frozen harness reaches a 73.2% success rate, outperforming VLA-assisted agents by up to 23.1% on composite tasks. Project page: https://auriga.stelledge.com/ Code: https://github.com/lose4578/Auriga

JADE: Joint Action Denoising for Vision-Language-Action Models

VLA 与策略学习

首发 2026-10-31 首发（11-03 批次补收）  ·  收录于 2026-11-04 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

日报题名沿用邮件原文；arXiv v1 原题为“Vision-Language Models Are Joint Denoisers in Robotic Action Generation”。原论文指向的作者 GitHub 仓库及 API 入口两次核验仍返回 HTTP 404，暂不列作可用代码入口。 （2026-11-06 核查）

核心方法｜VLA｜低层策略学习｜模拟＋真实桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Diffusion-based vision-language-action (VLA) models cascade pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) with diffusion action experts, but typically restrict the VLM to providing static conditioning. This separation limits how much pretrained perception and reasoning can guide action generation, especially in out-of-distribution settings. We introduce JADE, a Joint Action DEnoiser that enables the VLM and action expert to jointly refine actions. Our key insight is that structured action latents allow the VLM to read the current noisy action together with visual observations and language instructions. At every denoising step, the VLM contextualizes the noisy action and guides the action expert through gated cross-attention, so that its guidance evolves with the action being generated. We further supervise the VLM to recover clean action latents from noisy ones, which gives it a direct action-learning signal and couples perception with control. Additionally, joint denoising enables JADE to generate actions with fewer sampling steps, helping offset the additional cost of VLM participation. An adaptive step-size schedule further balances task performance and inference latency. On RoboDojo, JADE achieves an average success rate of 12.67%, the highest among the evaluated $π_{0.5}$-based methods, and is competitive with recent VLA and WAM foundation models pretrained at scale. It also improves performance on RoboTwin 2.0 and raises the average success rate across four real-world bimanual tasks by 20.8 percentage points compared with $π_{0.5}$.

原归档未标版本，摘要采用 v1。

docs.text: 冻结 OAT 编码含噪动作，VLM 在每个去噪步骤联合处理图像、指令和动作潜变量，经门控交叉注意力指导动作专家。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: RoboTwin 50 任务、每任务/设置 100 次，JADE 在 clean/random 扰动下为 79.3%/54.4%，平均 66.9%，高于 query conditioning 61.3%；2 步去噪 66.0%，接近 10 步 66.9%。RoboDojo 42 任务共 6300 episodes，动态动作条件 VLM 的成功率/Score 为 15.0%/23.2%，高于关闭该机制的 11.1%/18.1%。真实 PiPER 双臂四任务、每任务 100 示范、每策略 30 次，π0.5 49.2%，JADE 70.0%。

docs.text: 动作表示本身未被重定义，创新是“VLM 参与整个去噪轨迹”。代价是每步重新运行 VLM，训练微基准开销增加约 23%；RoboDojo 的绝对成功率仍低，真实实验也需要每任务 100 条示范。

docs.text:

docs.text:
Same Path, Less Time: Training-Free Trajectory Time-Scaling for Chunked Robot Policies

VLA 与策略学习

首发 2026-11-01 首发（v1）  ·  收录于 2026-11-04 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

日报题名沿用邮件原文；arXiv v1 原题为“Same Path, Less Time: Training-Free Fast Execution of Vision-Language-Action Models under Inference Latency”。本次未在已核验的原论文与摘要页找到作者项目主页或实现仓库入口。 （2026-11-06 核查）

模块/trick｜VLA｜低层执行｜模拟桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict chunks of future actions, yet deployed robots waste time in two ways that are independent of model capability: they halt while the next chunk is inferred, and they move at the speed of slow, cautious demonstrations. Existing remedies remove one loss each, and stacking them fails, because asynchrony and speed-up each change the correspondence between planned progress and executed motion. We present Path-preserving Time Scaling (PTS), a training-free execution layer for frozen action-chunking policies built on one principle: the robot's motion is a time reparameterization of a reference path, and the path changes only in response to new observations. A path layer decodes every replan deterministically in one step and enters it at the progress consumed during inference. A time layer sums the planned increments, keeps the arm at 1x while the gripper moves, and caps the rate by the actuator's linear range and by chunk feasibility under latency. We show that misaligned entry and stochastic sampling add a bias and a variance to the continuation error, and derive a break-even success rate that states when speeding up pays off. On LIBERO with two frozen VLAs under injected inference latency, PTS raises task throughput over the strongest deployable baseline by 33% for pi0.5 and 104% for SmolVLA while matching or improving the success rate, is best on all six model-suite combinations, and exceeds zero-latency 1x execution. Against asynchronous 1x execution with the same one-step decoder, the time layer alone adds 28% and 38%. On LIBERO-Dynamic it improves on stop-and-wait execution by 38% and is comparable to asynchronous 1x execution.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 执行流程
docs.text: 冻结 VLA 在后台生成动作块，路径层对齐已消耗进度，时间层在夹爪动作和执行器上限约束下缩放速率。图源：作者论文 · Figure 3 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 在不训练策略的前提下，对冻结 chunk policy 的几何路径做确定性保形时间缩放，并用进度对齐、夹爪独立时标和执行器速率上限提高吞吐。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 两种 VLA、四个 LIBERO suite、六类执行基线，共 6160 个测试 episodes；π0.5 吞吐提高 33%，SmolVLA 提高 104%。动态基准中比 stop-and-wait 快 38%，但成功率 0.475 与异步执行 0.483 接近；object suite 为 0.37，低于异步的 0.50，说明速度提升不等于成功率提升。

docs.title: 真实新意与局限
docs.text: 这是执行层 trick，不是策略或表示创新；仅在模拟器验证，依赖近似线性执行器响应、经验性单步解码和一个调好的速率上限。

docs.text:
它是低成本、可插拔的系统优化，也提醒评测必须同时报告吞吐和成功率。

核心方法｜VLA＋Agent memory｜技能/阶段＋记忆更新｜真实长时程操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have enabled fine manipulation capabilities, yet performing tasks that require working memory remains a key challenge. Most existing VLA architectures operate under a Markovian assumption, mapping only the current observation to an action, which leads to failure in non-Markovian environments. Inspired by the human 'inner monologue', we propose Hierarchical Explicit Language Memory (HeLM), a hierarchical VLA framework that maintains task-relevant history in explicit language through factorized event detection and event-triggered memory updates. We evaluate HeLM across 10 non-Markovian real-world tasks with 56 variants, including five newly formulated inter-episode tasks that require persistent context across task boundaries. HeLM improves intra-episode success by 12.8 percentage points over the strongest baseline and achieves 78% subtask success on compositional generalization tasks, while using up to 4.5x less memory and running 2.5x faster than the keyframe baseline at long horizons.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 高层 VLM 通过事件检测和触发更新维护工作记忆与跨 episode 语言上下文，再向低层 VLA 发出动作指令。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 用分解的事件检测和事件触发更新维护显式语言记忆，使 VLA 能处理跨阶段乃至跨 episode 的非马尔可夫依赖。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 摘要报告 10 个真实非马尔可夫任务、56 个变体，其中 5 个需要跨 episode 记忆；相对最强方法，episode 内任务提高 12.8 个百分点，组合设置下子任务成功率 78%，记忆开销最多降低 4.5×、速度提高 2.5×。注意 78% 是子任务成功率，不等同于整任务成功率。

docs.title: 真实新意与局限
docs.text: 新意是结构化、事件触发的语言记忆，而非简单追加历史帧。公开索引未充分披露每条件试验次数，本文不据此推断统计置信度；显式语言记忆还会受事件检测与语言摘要错误影响。

docs.text:
它把长期记忆从“更长上下文”推进到可更新、可压缩的状态机制，且包含跨 episode 真机任务。

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

日报题名沿用邮件原文；arXiv v1 原题为“Beyond Policy Patches: Distilling RL Specialists into Vision-Language-Action Policies”。作者项目主页已核验，暂未提供可核验的作者实现仓库入口。 （2026-11-06 核查）

核心方法｜VLA｜低层策略学习/修复｜真实桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can handle noncritical stages of long-horizon manipulation yet fail during short precision-critical phases. Lightweight reinforcement learning (RL) specialists can address these failures without directly applying RL to the full VLA, but retain auxiliary controllers and switching mechanisms at deployment. We study how to transfer their capabilities into a single flow-matching VLA. Direct imitation of specialist rollouts can reproduce action jitter and leave the VLA unprepared for states encountered during its own execution. We introduce REPAIR, a value-guided distillation framework that combines offline initialization with on-policy refinement. At each critical-phase observation, REPAIR queries the corresponding specialist for multiple action candidates and weights them using its critic to construct a supervision distribution. A shared weighted flow-matching objective trains the VLA first on observations from specialist-assisted rollouts, then on observations collected through its own execution. Specialists provide supervision without taking control during on-policy collection and are removed at deployment. Across six real-robot tasks with 30 evaluation trials per task, REPAIR achieves 100% success on all six tasks, with lower mean end-effector jerk than specialist-assisted execution on every task.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 训练框架
docs.text: 示范先初始化 VLA，关键阶段 RL 专家与 critic 为离线及学生状态上的在线蒸馏提供监督，部署时只保留单一 VLA。图源：作者论文 · Figure 4 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 在危险或失败阶段让 RL 专家及其 critic 对多个候选动作加权监督 VLA，再以 student-state 在线精炼，部署时移除专家。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 六个真实机器人任务、每任务 30 次，REPAIR 全部达到 100% 成功；基础 π0.5 分别为 30%、33.3%、0%、13.3%、20%、0%，任务专用 RL 专家虽接近 100% 但动作抖动更大。相对专家接管，REPAIR 降低 29.8%–67.5% jerk。双 peg 任务中 critic 加权 8 候选为 90%，执行动作克隆 60%、重新查询 66.7%、均匀 8 候选 76.7%；10 条专家＋10 条学生轨迹优于仅 20 条专家离线数据。

docs.title: 真实新意与局限
docs.text: 真实新意是把专家从部署时补丁变成可蒸馏监督，并让 critic 选择更适合 VLA 的动作。它仍需为关键阶段训练任务专用 RL 专家/critic，并收集在线学生状态；因此不是零样本通用修复，100% 也仅对应六个受控实验室任务。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
它提供了少见的真实机器人强结果，并把成功率与控制平滑度同时纳入评估。

日报题名沿用邮件原文；arXiv v1 原题为“Pixel-UMI: Learning Environment-Aware Whole-Body Manipulation from Sensorized Human Demonstrations”。作者专属项目页已核验，标注 Open Sourced Soon，尚无可核验的实现下载入口。 配图从 v1 原论文 PDF 第 1 页 Figure 1 提取。 （2026-11-06 核查）

数据＋核心方法｜模仿学习/策略学习｜低层全身控制｜移动操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Sensorized human demonstrations offer scalable data for mobile manipulation, but embodiment differences complicate policy learning. We present Pixel-UMI, a pipeline for learning environment-aware whole-body policies from human data. We first introduce Environment-Aware Retargeting (EAR), which combines reconstructed scene geometry with demonstrated head and gripper trajectories to determine robot posture and generate collision-aware joint and base targets. Delay-calibrated action assignment converts these trajectories into actions. However, kinematic differences can leave residual pose errors, creating viewpoint mismatches between human demonstrations and robot observations. We therefore introduce Retargeting-Error-Aware Masking (REAM), which uses these errors during training to reduce reliance on mismatched views at deployment. Finally, because estimated actions cannot fully capture contact-rich interactions, we collect on-policy human corrections through DAgger to improve performance. We evaluate Pixel-UMI on five challenging tasks spanning articulated-object manipulation, deformable-object handling, constrained-space reaching, whole-body collision avoidance, and contact-rich bimanual coordination, achieving 87.0% average task progress. Video results are available at https://pixel-robot.com/pixel-umi

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 系统概览
docs.text: 人体全身示范经场景感知重定向和误差感知掩码转换为机器人数据，按需加入在线修正，再学习环境感知全身策略。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 用场景几何感知重定向、时延校准、视角误差掩码和 DAgger 修正，把人体视频转成可训练的轮式双臂全身动作数据。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 五个真实任务，每任务/条件 20 次、4 个随机配置；平均阶段进度 87.0%。环境感知重定向相对无场景感知提高 64.41 个百分点；绝对关节目标 77.74%，显著高于末端相对基座 25.12% 和关节相对动作 27.50%；时延校准再增 24.05 点。两个难任务经两轮 DAgger 从 6.82% 提到 50.68% 再到 79.77%，每轮每任务收集 60 条成功修正 rollout。

docs.title: 真实新意与局限
docs.text: 新意是人体视频到移动全身策略的工程链路及关键误差建模，不是 VLA。动作标签仍是近似值、不能恢复接触力；单头深度重建不完整，默认静态场景，头部/夹爪目标也不能刻画全部身体运动。

docs.text:

日报题名沿用邮件原文；arXiv v1 原题为“Pixel: A Co-Designed Full-Stack Robot System for Learning General-Purpose Mobile Manipulation”。作者专属项目页已核验，标注 Open Sourced Soon，尚无可核验的实现下载入口；未把计划开源写作已公开代码。 （2026-11-06 核查）

大系统＋数据＋核心接口｜VLA/策略学习｜低层全身控制｜移动操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

General-purpose mobile manipulation requires a combination of capable robot hardware, scalable demonstration collection, expressive whole-body control, and effective policy learning. Yet these components are often developed independently, creating mismatches that limit the capabilities of the complete system. We present Pixel, a co-designed full-stack system for learning general-purpose mobile manipulation. Pixel combines a low-cost wheeled humanoid with human-aligned kinematics and compliant grippers, multiple teleoperation and robot-free human data-collection interfaces, a unified whole-body controller, and a common policy learning pipeline across human and robot demonstrations. A hierarchical learning stack further enables language-conditioned visuomotor control and long-horizon task execution. We evaluate the system across hardware, data collection, and policy learning, and demonstrate mobile-manipulation behaviors requiring dexterity, active perception, navigation, and whole-body coordination. We hope that Pixel provides an integrated and extensible foundation for studying how robot hardware, data, control, and learning can be designed together for robot learning. More results at https://pixel-robot.com/pixel

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 策略框架
docs.text: 高层 VLM 依据语音、上下文和关键帧选择子任务，低层策略使用视觉条件与 DiT 动作专家执行全身动作。图源：作者论文 · Figure 5 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 以低于 1.5 万美元的 23-DoF 轮式双臂平台、三种数据来源和统一的相对基座动作接口，把低成本硬件、全身示教与可泛化策略连成一套完整系统。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 六个真实全身任务，每个策略/条件 20 次 rollout；传感人体数据训练的三任务平均阶段进度 82.0%，机器人遥操作数据训练的另三任务为 78.7%。相对基座动作帧为 82.0%，优于 relative-pure 67.3% 和 relative-head 25.7%；人类数据与机器人数据联合训练在两个任务达 94.3%，人类数据单训为 85.0%。这里报告的是任务阶段进度，不等同于整任务成功率。

docs.title: 真实新意与局限
docs.text: 新意主要是“可复现硬件＋跨来源数据＋动作接口”的系统协同，并非新的大模型架构。轮式底盘不能处理楼梯/复杂地形，简化夹爪牺牲灵巧性；人体接口缺少接触力/触觉，高层技能组合也未被系统评估。

docs.text:

基准/诊断｜VLA safety｜观测/验证＋动作通道审计｜桌面操作；另含自动驾驶

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models pair physical control with natural-language rationales that supervisors can read to monitor embodied safety. Prior attacks on VLA reasoning corrupt the rationale itself and leave visible evidence in the text. We show that visual perturbations can instead alter the physical action while keeping the generated rationale word-for-word identical. At the shared text/action interface of Alpamayo for driving and InstructVLA for manipulation, our text-neutral action-subspace (TNAS) diagnostic shows that the locally most action-sensitive direction is nearly orthogonal to the active text-loss gradients, with 1.87% and 5.28% norm overlap. At equal hidden-state perturbation norms across both models, interventions along this text-neutral residual shift actions 4.64x to 47.8x more than text-gradient perturbations, whereas text-gradient perturbations induce 21.2x to 277x more text drift. Steering visual perturbations along this direction reaches the same decoupling from the image. Across 154 obstacle-annotated driving scenes in Alpamayo, TNAS-guided attacks induce a new collision under a word-for-word identical rationale in 52.6% of scenes under full-image perturbations and 35.1% under a localized forward-camera patch, compared with 4.55% for unguided action attacks. Relative to a text-preserving baseline, TNAS guidance raises exact rationale preservation from 83.0% to 89.5% and cuts teacher-forced text drift by 68.4% at a comparable collision rate. In InstructVLA, TNAS guidance cuts text drift by 40.5% and preserves the exact response on 85.0% of examples alongside a 1.73-unit action-chunk shift. An unchanged rationale therefore cannot certify a safe action, so monitors for reasoning VLAs must verify the predicted action channel directly.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 诊断机制
docs.text: 输入扰动沿文本中性、动作敏感方向改变共享隐状态，使理由文本保持逐字相同而动作输出发生偏移。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 识别与文本梯度近乎正交、但对动作高度敏感的 text-neutral action subspace，证明逐字不变的 rationale 不能保证动作安全。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: InstructVLA 200 个样本中，文本/动作敏感方向的范数重叠均值仅 5.28%；TNAS 引导使动作变化显著增大，同时将文本漂移降低 40.5%，自由生成时可在 85.0% 样本上保持完全相同文本。自动驾驶的 154 个障碍场景中，全文图扰动在逐字相同 rationale 下制造新碰撞的比例为 52.6%，局部 patch 为 35.1%，无引导攻击为 4.55%。

docs.title: 真实新意与局限
docs.text: 这是开放循环诊断/攻击，不是新的控制策略，也没有真实机器人危险执行；InstructVLA 侧用 action-chunk shift 而不是任务失败或碰撞率。攻击计算昂贵，单个 InstructVLA 条件约 13 GPU-hours/200 样本。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
对 reasoning VLA 很重要：语言解释只能作为旁证，验证器必须直接检查动作通道或预测物理后果。

核心方法＋数据接口｜VLA｜低层策略学习｜真实桌面/双臂操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies provide a strong starting point for deployment, but adapting them to a target robot and environment still requires costly embodiment-specific demonstrations. Human demonstrations are far easier to collect, yet directly leveraging them is challenging due to the substantial human-robot embodiment gap, particularly when the underlying VLA has been pretrained primarily on robot data. We introduce H2RB (Human-To-Robot Bridge), a human-robot co-training framework for adapting pretrained VLA policies from unpaired human and robot demonstrations. H2RB bridges the embodiment gap at both interfaces: geometry-anchored alignment grounds human and robot observations in a compatible representation, while a decoupled-decoder tokenizer shares action latents without forcing both domains through a single action mapping. This design allows human demonstrations to provide useful behavioral supervision while retaining the rich visual, semantic, and control priors of the pretrained VLA. Across real-world tasks, H2RB substantially improves object transfer performance from 8.0 to 51.8 and enables skill transfer to score 62.7, in settings where co-train baselines totally fail to transfer human-demonstrated skills. The benefit also persists under object-placement shifts, improving out-of-distribution transfer from 6.0 to 45.3. H2RB suggests a way for human demonstrations to serve as a scalable supervision source for adapting pretrained robotic policies, reducing the dependence on costly target-robot data collection.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 共享时序编码器与分离的人/机器人解码器对齐动作潜空间，手部几何锚定视觉表征并指导动作专家。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: H2RB 同时对齐人类与机器人的视觉几何表征，并以共享 latent action、分离 decoder 保留各自运动学，把未配对人类示范用于机器人目标对象和新技能迁移。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: OpenArm humanoid＋Inspire hands。对象迁移包含 90 次目标任务 rollout，H2RB 的加权阶段分数从朴素 co-train 的 8.0 提至 51.8，OOD 放置由 6.0 提至 45.3。开/关技能各 15 次，技能迁移分数 62.7，而三个 shared-action/co-train 基线均为 0；其中完全完成比例为 30%。异构预训练后技能分数升至 81.7。RB-Y1 50 次二元成功评测由 72% 升至 78%。

docs.title: 真实新意与局限
docs.text: 新意不是只共享一个物理 action space，而是分别解决感知域差异与动作实现差异。主指标是 0–100 加权阶段分数，不能直接当整任务成功率；任务集中于取放、开合与包裹处理，依赖手部几何估计和 embodiment-specific decoder。

docs.text:
比“把人体动作硬重定向给机器人”更系统地解释了跨形态迁移为什么失败、应在哪两个接口对齐。

核心方法｜多任务 diffusion policy｜低层策略学习｜模拟＋真实双臂桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Diffusion-based policies have achieved strong performance on single-task robotic manipulation. However, a single model trained jointly on multiple tasks consistently underperforms the per-task specialists trained on the same demonstrations. We focus on two challenges. First, the convolutional encoders commonly used in diffusion-based policies produce visual conditions that are not discriminative enough. Second, gradients from incompatible action modes update the shared denoiser's dense parameters along the same directions, causing destructive interference during joint training. To address both, we propose SR-DP (Spectrally Routed Diffusion Policy). A frozen VGGT encoder with a spatial-compression adapter produces compact multi-scale semantic-geometric tokens, a task-discriminative visual condition for tasks that share a workspace. We first train the denoiser as a standard diffusion policy, then decompose selected linear layers by SVD into a frozen basis of orthogonal rank-one experts, adapted through spectral routing and Householder input rotations. On six RoboTwin tasks, SR-DP averages a 68.4% success rate, surpassing multi-task VO-DP by 21.8 points and the strongest per-task baseline by 3.8 points. On four real-world bimanual tasks, Stage 2 reaches a 43.0% average success rate and improves over Stage 1 by 19.0 points.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 冻结 VGGT 和空间压缩适配器提供几何条件，DiT 的部分线性层分解为 rank-one experts 并通过谱路由调节。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 用冻结 VGGT 提供语义—几何条件，并把共享 denoiser 的线性层 SVD 分解为正交 rank-one experts，通过 spectral routing 减少多任务梯度冲突。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: RoboTwin 六任务平均成功率 68.4%，比多任务 VO-DP 高 21.8 个百分点，也比最强逐任务专家高 3.8 点；四个真实双臂任务中，第二阶段平均成功率 43.0%，比第一阶段高 19.0 点。

docs.title: 真实新意与局限
docs.text: 创新是参数空间的谱路由和几何视觉条件，不是 VLA/语言推理。公开索引没有给出真机每任务试验次数与方差；真机绝对成功率仅 43%，且只覆盖四个共享工作区任务。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
对于“一个多任务策略为什么会比每任务专家更差”，它给出了可操作的梯度干扰解决方案。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Predicting how the world evolves in response to robot actions is central to policy learning, evaluation, and planning. However, many action-conditioned world models predict future observations in 2D image or video space without explicitly modeling the underlying 3D scene, making spatial consistency across viewpoints and over long-horizon interactions challenging. We introduce 3D World Simulator, an action-conditioned multimodal world modeling framework that jointly predicts appearance, geometry, and tactile observations from a unified 3D representation. Our approach combines a hybrid particle-voxel autoencoder that compresses point clouds into compact 3D voxel latents with an action-conditioned latent dynamics model that predicts their evolution. The shared 3D representation supports geometrically consistent rendering from arbitrary viewpoints and flexible integration of spatially aligned tactile signals. Our experiments demonstrate interactive, long-horizon, multimodal prediction at 50 Hz. We then show how our model enables scalable data generation for policy training and evaluation using tactile and multi-view visual observations, including wrist-mounted and novel camera views. Furthermore, we scale our method to large datasets containing diverse objects and demonstrate model-based planning with unseen objects and robot configurations. Together, these results highlight the potential of hybrid particle-voxel dynamics as a foundation for multimodal 3D world simulation.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.text: 混合粒子—体素自编码器构建三维潜状态，动作条件时序模型预测后续状态，再解码为点云与多视角图像。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 以粒子—体素混合 latent 统一预测几何、多视角 RGB/depth 和空间对齐触觉，使动作条件世界模拟器能以 50 Hz 进行长时程 3D rollout。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 六个 ALOHA 任务、200 步开放循环上，PSNR 23.24、LPIPS 0.240、depth AbsRel 0.097、场景 Chamfer 7.72、触觉 L1 0.081，全面优于 Cosmos、Robot4DGen、IWS 和三个粒子基线。Part Assembly、Cloth Folding、T-Pushing 各使用 100 条真实或模拟示范；ACT、DP、π0.5、Cosmos Policy 在模拟与真机各 20 次/配置，二者表现高度相关。预训练模型还在未见 ALOHA 单臂及 cloth/rope/foam/sloth 上进行零样本 MPPI 规划。

核心方法｜WM/物理模拟＋策略学习｜低层控制｜真实桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Learning robust manipulation policies for diverse everyday objects remains challenging because objects with different materials exhibit distinct deformation and contact dynamics. While diffusion policies provide a powerful framework for modeling multimodal manipulation behaviors, they typically lack explicit physical reasoning and may produce averaged actions when facing heterogeneous objects. We present a physics-aware diffusion policy that augments visual imitation learning with object physical understanding. Our framework recovers material properties from visual demonstrations by coupling 3D Gaussian Splatting with differentiable Material Point Method simulation, where video guidance and particle-level constraints enable accurate physical parameter estimation. The estimated physics conditions are further integrated into a material-aware Mixture-of-Experts diffusion policy, allowing adaptive behavior generation across different physical regimes. For practical deployment, we introduce a physics memory bank that provides efficient physical retrieval without requiring online simulation optimization. Experiments on a wide range of simulated and real-world objects demonstrate improved manipulation success and generalization over existing diffusion-based approaches. These results show that incorporating physical knowledge is critical for scalable robot manipulation in diverse environments.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 以三维高斯与可微 MPM 估计材料物理条件，再由材料感知路由器选择 diffusion experts 生成动作。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 用 3DGS＋可微 MPM 从视频估计材料参数，再以材料感知 MoE diffusion policy 针对弹性、泡沫、塑性和刚性物体路由不同专家。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 取放和堆叠；仿真每任务 120 次，真机每任务 30 次。真实取放四材料平均成功率：完整方法 62.5%，DP 28.9%，DP3 42.3%左右；消融中只加 physics condition 已由 28.9% 升至 49.4%。100 条真机遥操作示范、300 条仿真示范。在线物理优化每查询 798 秒；memory bank 检索约 415 ms、快约 1900 倍，成功率 59.2%，仅比在线优化低 1.5 点。

docs.title: 真实新意与局限
docs.text: 物理参数真正进入策略条件和专家路由，而不是只生成逼真视频。系统仍依赖离线物理优化、四个人工材料类别和固定相机；memory bank 的 415 ms 也不适合作为高频在线模块，真机任务只包含取放和堆叠。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
提供了少见的“材料物理估计是否真的改善真机动作”的直接消融。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved promising performance for generalized robotic manipulation, yet their reliance on expensive real-robot data remains a fundamental bottleneck. A scalable alternative is to transfer knowledge from off-the-shelf human-centric videos. However, existing methods extract latent action representations that are entangled with scene-specific noise, diluting the transferred knowledge. Motivated by this limitation, we propose Action-Intent Transfer (AIT), a two-stage method that transfers knowledge through a clean action representation shared across humans and robots. In the first stage, AIT extracts explicit action intents and disentangles the implicit action intent from manipulation videos. In the second stage, AIT aligns the human and robot domains within this shared intent space and decodes the intent into executable robot actions. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world environments demonstrate that AIT transfers human knowledge more effectively and consistently outperforms prior baselines.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 显式和隐式动作意图构成人机共享空间，由视觉语言骨干对齐表征并解码为机器人低层动作。图源：作者论文 · Figure 3 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 先从人类视频中拆出显式和隐式 action intent，再在 intent space 对齐人/机器人域并解码为机器人动作，减少场景噪声对 latent action 的污染。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: LIBERO 四套平均成功率 91.3%；CALVIN ABC→D 五任务链完全完成率 62.3%，UniVLA 为 56.5%。Astribot 12 个真实任务、每任务 20 次，平均整任务成功率 82.08%，UniVLA 为 70.42%；受控四任务中加入人类数据后由 73.8% 升至 85.0%。VLM 伪标签人工审计：语言96.7%、grasp intent 96.4%、move intent 82.4%，错误标签在训练前由人工修正。

docs.title: 真实新意与局限
docs.text: 显式 intent 提供比无约束 latent action 更可控的跨域桥梁；但 intent 主要是方向、抓取状态等预定义语义，仍需人类审核纠错，真实实验使用自建 Astribot 数据且只对比 UniVLA。

docs.text:

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated body motion and hand interaction over time, and a plausible-looking command sequence can still drop a held object or leave an interaction incomplete. We present action-conditioned latent foresight, a latent world-action model (WAM) that evaluates proposed command sequences before execution. An action generator proposes joint motion-hand command sequences from vision, language, and the robot state. An action-conditioned endpoint predictor estimates the visual features each sequence prefix reaches and measures progress toward a demonstration-derived subgoal, while a joint temporal prior scores temporal consistency given the robot state and preceding commands. The robot executes the first commands of the best-scoring sequence and replans from the next observation. During training, action consistency regularization reconstructs the first demonstrated command from observed and predicted feature changes, encouraging the predictor to retain action-relevant information. On ten tasks in the humanoid loco-manipulation simulation benchmark SIMPLE, our method achieves 89.7% average success, compared with 73.7% for Psi-Zero and 82.0% for DiT4DiT. On seven real-robot tasks, it achieves 85.7% under standard conditions and 65.7% under unseen object configurations, while GR00T N1.7 achieves 70.0% and 48.6%, respectively. Project page: https://ju6276.github.io/Action-Grounded-Foresight/

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.text: 生成多条身体—手部动作候选，由动作条件端点预测器与联合时间先验评分，只执行最佳序列前缀并重规划。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 提出 action-conditioned latent foresight：先生成多条身体运动—手部动作序列，再用动作条件端点预测器和时间先验预判执行结果，只执行最高分序列的前缀并闭环重规划。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: SIMPLE 10 个任务，每任务在三档随机化下各 10 次，平均整任务成功率 89.7%，Psi-Zero 为 73.7%、DiT4DiT 为 82.0%。Unitree G1 七个真实任务，每任务/条件 10 次；标准条件 85.7%、未见物体配置 65.7%，GR00T N1.7 分别为 70.0% 和 48.6%。每个真机任务使用 400 条示范，Place Basket 为 200 条。动作一致性正则增加 10.8 个百分点，联合时间先验相对分解先验增加 9.2 点。

docs.title: 真实新意与局限
docs.text: WAM 在这里不生成完整视频，而是预测候选动作前缀的 latent endpoint 并用于执行前排序。每任务单独训练，视觉评分依赖任务特定的示范子目标图；软物体掉落和开门不完整仍是主要失败。RTX 4090D 上推理 9.1 Hz，但 Jetson Orin NX 端侧测试只有 0.73 Hz。

docs.text:

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Recent multimodal language models can reason directly about robot scenes, but it is unclear whether they need to repeatedly reinterpret raw visual observations at every step of an interaction. We propose shifting routine spatial reasoning from images to text and symbols through a 3D geometric abstraction that is refreshed locally from observations and read directly by the language models. Specifically, our interface represents scene geometry via typed, evidence-aware symbolic references to object parts, grounds them from calibrated RGB-D, and returns compact textual checkpoints with metric residuals after each action. Symbolic task structure can thus be reused across decisions while metric values are rebound to the current scene, with direct visual reasoning invoked only on demand. Across offline policy synthesis and continuous online execution, reasoning over grounded text and symbols improves multi-step manipulation completion while substantially reducing repeated multimodal queries, positioning explicit geometric state as an effective substrate for agentic robot policies.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 接口流程
docs.text: RGB-D 观测先在本地转为三维几何与证据状态，再通过符号引用和文本检查点供 agent 推理与执行。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献

docs.title: 关键实验

docs.title: 真实新意与局限
docs.text: 创新在 agent 的状态接口，不是低层控制器。实验全部为规则几何体模拟操作；依赖标定 RGB-D，尚未覆盖真实噪声、重遮挡、关节物体或柔性物体；几何关系只是候选，不证明接触稳定。

核心架构｜VLA｜异步语义记忆＋低层控制｜Franka 桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Scaling vision-language foundation models has significantly advanced generalist robot manipulation, but the increased model scale introduces computational latency that degrades real-time physical reactivity. Existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architectures execute high-level semantic reasoning and action ex- ecution sequentially within the primary control loop, creating a fundamental tension between semantic-reasoning capability and robot agility. To address this, we propose Asynchronous Robot Policy (ARP), an architectural framework that decouples semantic reasoning from low-level action generation using asynchronous processes operating at independent frequencies. In ARP, a high-capacity Vision-Language Model (VLM) asynchronously updates a semantic memory at low fre- quency, while a lightweight Vision-Action Expert, conditioned on this semantic memory, generates robot actions at a much higher control frequency. Such a formulation, enables having a fast perception-action loop without compromising on the semantic capability. To overcome asynchronous memory staleness, ARP trains the vision-action expert on the semantic staleness and execution delay, with temporally mismatched observation across processes. On Franka manipulation tasks, ARP achieves an 18% higher success rate and 20% less time need for execution in quasi-static setups, while 3-5 times baseline performance in dynamic simulation environments. Furthermore, ARP enables operating the VLM at 10 times lower than its nominal frequency with no significant performance loss making it much more efficient than the baseline. These results highlight the architectural advantages of modeling robot policies as asynchronous processes, enabling real-world reactive deployment without sacrificing the scale of foundation models.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly pair a pre-trained vision-language model (VLM) with a flow-matching expert that conditions its action predictions on the VLM's key-value representations. Those representations must carry information useful for control, yet the VLM was never trained for the action expert's flow-matching objective. Two signals can address this: gradients backpropagated from the expert's loss (coupling), or VLM supervision to predict discrete tokens encoding the same target actions. Prominent training recipes forgo the first, blocking expert-to-VLM gradients (insulation) to protect the VLM's existing capabilities, while also supervising it on vision-language data and action tokens. Because vision-language co-training also aims to preserve those capabilities, the additional protection provided by insulation is unclear. At the same time, insulation removes a direct signal about which features continuous action prediction requires. On the other hand, action-token supervision offers an alternative way to learn action-relevant representations, which may explain why insulation succeeds in practice. We disentangle these factors in autonomous driving and manipulation by independently varying action-token supervision and whether the expert's loss updates the VLM. In open-loop driving, insulation is competitive with coupling when action tokens are supervised; without them, coupling reduces trajectory-prediction error by roughly 25%. When both components are trained jointly from the outset, coupling increases closed-loop driving route progress by approximately 17% with action-token supervision and 40% without it, and similarly improves robot manipulation performance under both settings. These findings show that the value of gradient insulation depends on the VLM's action supervision and the evaluation setting, challenging insulation as a default VLA training recipe.

docs.title: 训练接口设计
docs.text: 独立组合动作 token 监督与动作专家到 VLM 的梯度通断，并对比并发、VLM 优先和专家优先训练日程。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: 独立控制 action-token 监督和 action expert 是否向 VLM 回传梯度，检验“为保护 VLM 而默认隔离梯度”是否合理。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: π0.5 重实现和 MolmoAct2、三个 PolaRiS 任务，每条件/任务 50 个匹配初态 rollout。π0.5 无 FAST token 时，梯度耦合使阶段进度由 10.3% 升至 32.9%；有 FAST 时由 19.5% 升至 30.7%。MolmoAct2 对应为 14.5%→36.5%和 22.0%→24.3%。这里是 rubric-normalized task progress，不是整任务成功率。驾驶 827 个场景中，并发训练的 route progress 由 0.600 升至 0.703（有 token）或 0.425 升至 0.601（无 token）。

docs.title: 真实新意与局限
docs.text: 说明 insulation 的价值取决于 VLM 是否已有 action-token 监督及训练顺序，不能作为默认配方。仅两个操作模型族、全部闭环实验在模拟器，且每条件只训练一个 seed，无法评估训练方差。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
这是对当前 MoT-VLA 训练配方中一个常被直接继承、却很少独立验证的设计选择的扎实审计。

docs.title: MESA
docs.text:
MESA: An Evaluation Framework for Compositional, Semantic, and Spatial Generalization in Robotics

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能

首发 2026-11-03，v1（补收：11月5日索引补齐，既往日报未推送）  ·  收录于 2026-11-06 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

作者项目页与官方 mesa-env 仓库已核验。仓库提供 MESA-Gen 的任务与示范生成以及 MESA-Bench 的评测实现，仿真资产与固定评测初态按文档从 Hugging Face 下载。项目页另列权重与数据。本次核查以链接和仓库内容为准。 （2026-11-06 核查）

贡献=基准/诊断＋数据；路线=VLA＋Agent；层级=低层控制＋技能/语言；任务=桌面单臂/双臂（仿真）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Despite growing interest in foundation models for robotic manipulation, systematic evaluation of their capabilities remains elusive. Existing benchmarks are either narrow and saturated, offering little signal on SOTA methods, broadly scoped, providing diversity at the cost of controlled experimentation, or require training on large, messy open-source datasets. We introduce MESA, an evaluation framework designed for precise, reproducible measurement of language-conditioned policy generalization. MESA provides five evaluation suites that isolate in-distribution performance and four distinct axes of generalization: spatial configuration, object instance, object category, and subtask composition, enabling researchers to diagnose where and why policies fail, not just whether they fail. To populate these suites at scale, we develop MESA-Gen, a pipeline for task and demonstration generation built by improving MimicGen. We instantiate the framework on two platforms and release both: the single-arm MESA suite, and BiMESA, the first large-scale benchmark for bimanual generalization. We evaluate seven baseline methods spanning diffusion policies, VLM-based approaches, and pretrained VLAs, finding that the strongest model achieves only 52% on MESA and 49% on BiMESA, providing meaningful signal while leaving ample room for progress. MESA rankings are broadly consistent with RoboArena scores, suggesting that MESA captures method-level differences relevant beyond simulation. Project website: https://pairlab.github.io/MESA.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: MESA-Gen 从任务骨架生成训练和评测任务，可采集少量源示范，并通过子任务拼接扩充示范数据。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 用可控的空间、实例、类别、子任务组合四种分布偏移诊断语言条件策略，发布单臂MESA和双臂BiMESA，并用干扰任务完成率分离语言理解与控制失败。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 七类基线覆盖DP、PaliGemma动作头、GR00T、π0/FAST/π0.5；π0.5在MESA平均52.0%、BiMESA 48.7%居首，但类别泛化仅26.4%/18.6%。零样本GPT-6.1-Sol工具调用agent在BiMESA平均42.8%，类别泛化52.4%，但每任务仅10次，而学习策略为50次。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 完全仿真；MimicGen式生成数据可能偏向初始条件容易的轨迹；agent与策略的评测回合数不一致，不能把名次当严格等预算比较。

docs.text:
相比已饱和LIBERO，它更适合回答“模型究竟泛化在哪一轴”；新意是基准与诊断，不是新策略。

docs.text:
ELA: End-to-End Latent Action Policy Learning from Video Demonstrations

VLA 与策略学习

首发 2026-11-03，v1（补收：11月5日才被当日索引完整收录，既往日报未推送）  ·  收录于 2026-11-06 日报
