贡献=核心方法；路线=VLA相关/潜在动作学习；层级=低层策略学习；任务=桌面操作（仿真＋真机）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Robot imitation learning is limited by the scarcity of action-labeled data, while action-free demonstrations such as videos are abundant. Recent latent-action methods learn action-relevant representations from observation transitions, but they do not optimize latent actions for downstream control, leading to latent representations that are difficult for policies to model and difficult to accurately decode into continuous robot actions. This paper introduces ELA, an end-to-end framework for learning from video demonstrations via latent actions jointly optimized for policy learning and action decoding. ELA jointly trains a latent action model, latent action policy, and action decoder, enabling policies to leverage abundant video data with only a handful of action-labeled robot demonstrations. Experiments on simulated and real-world manipulation tasks show that ELA consistently outperforms prior latent action baselines. Moreover, it integrates seamlessly with existing imitation learning methods through lightweight 4M-parameter action decoders, requiring no changes to policy architectures or training objectives. Additional materials can be found on: https://end2end-latent-action.github.io/

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 训练时由成对图像推断潜在动作，监督未来图像重建、动作解码与策略学习；部署时由策略和解码器输出机器人动作。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 把潜在动作模型、策略和连续动作解码器联合优化，让潜在动作同时更易由观测预测、也更易解码成机器人控制，而不是先学冻结表示再接策略。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: Franka五个真机任务，每任务20次；ELA-DP平均成功率0.70，优于DP 0.48、LAPA 0.26、Villa-X 0.27、UniVLA 0.08；解码器仅约4M参数，表中ELA相关IDM为6M、用250条轨迹，而若干大规模潜在动作基线使用100万级轨迹。open-oven上ELA-DP 0.30反低于DP 0.35。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 优势依赖人类视频与少量带动作数据的具体混合；对精细接触/铰接约束的open-oven没有收益，显示潜在动作仍可能丢掉连续控制细节。

docs.text:

docs.title: Time-to-Goal
docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 08

docs.title: Time-to-Goal
docs.text:
Time-to-Goal: Learned Temporal Metrics for Long-Horizon Planning with JEPA World Models

世界模型与 WAM

首发 2026-11-04，v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-06 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

论文指向的官方仓库提供 T2G 度量训练、潜空间规划评测和代价诊断实现。部分离线数据、评测任务和 LeWM 检查点需按说明另取；H-JEPA 与 LeWorldModel 是上游资源。 （2026-11-06 核查）

贡献=模块/trick＋核心方法；路线=WM/WAM；层级=规划；任务=桌面操作＋导航（仿真）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) support planning by comparing predicted latent states with an encoded goal. For this comparison to guide temporal progress, states closer in time to the goal should receive lower costs. However, training representations for prediction and distribution regularization does not directly enforce this ordering. We examine this mismatch in flat LeWorldModel (LeWM) by analyzing how its Euclidean goal cost changes with temporal separation. Our analysis identifies conditions under which states at different long offsets receive similar average costs, weakening their temporal distinction. To learn the missing ordering explicitly, we introduce Time-to-Goal (T2G), a lightweight metric trained on latent triples from offline trajectories. A margin ranking loss encourages smaller distances for temporally nearer states, requiring no rewards or policy labels. The learned metric then replaces the Euclidean planning cost while the JEPA encoder and predictor remain frozen. Diagnostics on AntMaze and FourRoom show that T2G preserves stronger temporal contrast and improves near--far ranking at long offsets. Across four navigation and manipulation benchmarks, T2G improves the average planning success rate from 32.7\% (flat LeWM) to 63.0\% and approaches or even surpasses the performance of the hierarchical H-JEPA baselines. These results show that learning temporal ordering for the goal cost can substantially improve latent planning even with a flat world model.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 冻结的 JEPA 预测器展开候选潜在轨迹，时序度量为预测状态与目标打分，求解器据此更新动作序列。图源：作者论文 · Figure 4 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 冻结JEPA世界模型，只学习一个0.182M参数的“离目标还有多久”时序度量，替换原本不能稳定表示长程进展的欧氏目标代价。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 50个共享起终点×3种子；在AntMaze、OGBench Cube、FourRoom、Push-T上，末端窗口T2G把平坦LeWM成功率分别从18.0→58.7、32.0→63.3、40.7→78.7、40.0→51.3，四项平均32.7→63.0，并接近/超过多层H-JEPA的平均结果。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 只有Push-T与Cube属于操作，且均为仿真、目标图像已知；全轨迹dense版本在Cube从32.0%跌到4.0%，说明代价聚合方式极敏感。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:

Online Adaptation to Latent Physical Properties for Learning from Demonstration

世界模型与 WAM

首发 2026-11-04，v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-06 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

作者项目页已核验，提供方法说明和实机、仿真实验演示。论文和项目页未找到可验证的作者代码入口。 （2026-11-06 核查）

贡献=核心方法/模块；路线=WM/WAM相关；层级=低层控制/在线适应；任务=桌面操作（仿真＋真机）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Manipulating visually identical objects with different physical properties requires adapting actions based on information acquired through interaction. We address the problem of learning from demonstrations how to adapt manipulation actions, such as regrasping and changing contact locations, based on physical-property information acquired during interaction. To this end, we propose a learning-from-demonstration method that learns latent representations of physical properties needed to predict object responses and conditions a policy on online estimates of these representations. A dynamics model and object-specific latent representations are jointly learned from demonstrations that include behaviors adapting to the objects' physical properties, and the learned representations are then used to condition an imitation policy. During execution, the dynamics model and policy weights remain fixed, while the latent representation is updated based on the discrepancy between predicted and actual observations, allowing interaction with the object to inform action generation. Real-world and simulation experiments with objects whose centers of mass differ suggest that online adaptation through latent representations of physical properties can improve task success rates. However, in simulation, success rates on center-of-mass locations absent from the demonstrations remained around 30%, indicating limited adaptation to unseen physical properties. Project page: https://isri-aist.github.io/latent-dynamics-project-page/

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 先用示范联合学习动力学与物性表示，再以物性表示为条件训练扩散策略；部署中用预测误差在线更新物性估计。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 从示范中联合学习动力学模型和隐式物性变量，部署时固定策略与模型、仅用预测误差在线更新物性表示，从交互中推断重心并改变重抓/接触位置。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: xArm7真机Pouch Placement成功率66.7%对DP 40.7%；Box Pushing加入自主rollout重训动力学后从约50%升至66.7%。UR5e仿真Horizontal Lifting总成功率从DP 49.0%升至58.6%（状态模型）/58.1%（图像模型）；未见重心位置仅30.0/32.5%。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 真机每配置仅2–3次/种子，统计量小；仅研究一维配重和标量隐变量，未覆盖三维重心、质量变化或复杂接触；未见物性泛化仍弱。

docs.text:

docs.title: Can Astra Solve RoboMME without Breaking the Bank?
docs.text:
Can Astra Solve RoboMME without Breaking the Bank?

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能

首发 2026-11-04，v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-06 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

官方仓库含 RoboMME 评测代码、任务提示与模型引用。论文所报运行使用 Codex，仓库的复现指南提供 Responses API 运行器，需另配模型权重与 API 访问。 （2026-11-06 核查）

贡献=大系统；路线=VLA＋Agent；层级=技能/阶段＋规划/观测/验证；任务=桌面操作（仿真）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Robotic manipulation often requires remembering information that is no longer visible, such as an object's location before occlusion or the order of a demonstrated action sequence. A large vision-language planner can read this history, but calling it before every action chunk is slow and costly. We present a three-tier system for the RoboMME benchmark. GPT-6 Astra (System 2) selects a grounded subtask from stored visual history, a $π_{0.5}$ vision-language-action policy (System 1) executes it, and a fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-4B monitor (System 1.5) checks after each action chunk whether the subtask is finished. The instruction is kept until the monitor reports completion or a task-specific event occurs, while the policy keeps acting on new observations. On RoboMME, the system succeeds in 79.13% of episodes with an average of 3.63 Astra calls and 80.84 seconds per episode. This is 34.62 points above the best published non-oracle baseline and 4.95 points below GroundSG+Oracle, which gives the low-level policy ground-truth subgoals.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: Astra 选择子任务，π0.5 分块执行，小型监控器检查进度并在需要时触发重规划。右侧保留论文图中的 RoboMME 成功率对比。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 把强VLM规划器、π0.5执行器和小型视觉进度监控器分成三种调用频率，只在子任务完成或事件触发时重新规划，降低长历史推理的调用成本。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: RoboMME 16任务上整任务成功率79.13%，平均每回合调用Astra 3.63次、耗时80.84秒；比最佳非oracle基线高34.62个百分点，距提供真值子目标的GroundSG+Oracle仅4.95点。Counting/Permanence/Reference/Imitation分别69.5/94/92/61%。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 纯仿真；167个失败回合中StopCube和InsertPeg占82个，且尚未把失败归因到规划、监控还是执行；用了任务特定事件和经微调监控器，不能直接称为通用免调agent。

docs.text:

docs.title: A³-VLA
docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 05

docs.title: A³-VLA
docs.text:
A³-VLA: Automatic Perception-Guided Attention Alignment for Robot Manipulation

VLA 与策略学习

首发 2026-11-04，v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-06 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

作者在 v1 复现清单中称已给出代码 URL。核查该版本的摘要、HTML 和 PDF，均未找到可核实的作者项目页或实现链接。 （2026-11-06 核查）

贡献=模块/trick；路线=VLA；层级=低层策略学习/感知对齐；任务=桌面操作（仿真＋真机）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs) enable robots to perform manipulation tasks by leveraging Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to process visual observations and language instructions. However, the action prediction objective itself lacks fine-grained task-specific perceptual supervision, making it prone to relying on task-irrelevant visual shortcuts, leading attention away from target objects and key interaction areas, thereby limiting its operational performance and generalization ability. To address this, we propose Automatic Perception-Guided Attention Alignment for Robot Manipulation ($A^3$-VLA), a framework that derives task-specific visual guidance from the manipulation process itself. Specifically, $A^3$-VLA first generates heuristic candidate regions for target objects and the robot from interaction-induced visual changes, and refines them with a visual segmentation model offline. These regions serve as explicit perceptual guidance through two complementary objectives: an attention allocation loss that encourages sufficient focus on task-critical regions when language or robot state tokens query the visual input, and a contrastive learning loss that aligns the representations of candidate target regions with language instructions while separating them from task-irrelevant regions. Extensive experiments on simulated and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that $A^3$-VLA consistently improves multiple VLA backbones, with an average success rate gain of 6.5% - 25.2% across benchmarks.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 从示范前后的视觉变化提议目标和机器人区域，经 SAM2 细化，再用注意力权重分配及区域与语言对比学习引导 VLA 训练。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 从交互前后视觉变化自动产出目标/机器人伪区域，再用注意力分配和区域—语言对比损失逼VLA看对位置，无需人工框标注。

docs.title: 关键实验

docs.title: RoboCasa-Mem
docs.text:
RoboCasa-Mem: Benchmarking Environment and Process Memory in Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能移动操作

首发 2026-11-04，v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-06 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

官方仓库的 0.1.0rc1 提供 RoboCasa-Mem 仿真评测代码与配置。仿真器、资产、模型实现及权重需分别获取。README 明确真机集成已从该版本移除，安装后的验收仍待完成。 （2026-11-06 核查）

贡献=基准/诊断＋大系统；路线=VLA＋Agent；层级=技能/阶段＋规划/记忆；任务=移动操作（仿真＋真机）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

In the real world, mobile manipulation robots must perform complex object interactions and make multi-step decisions, often relying on task-relevant information that is no longer observable. However, existing benchmarks provide limited evaluation of such memory-dependent decision-making in mobile manipulation. To address this gap, we introduce RoboCasa-Mem, a new benchmark comprising nine mobile manipulation tasks that require agents to use interaction history at key decision points. Specifically, the tasks are grouped into two categories of memory: One is environment memory, which captures spatial locations, object attributes, and object relationships. The other is process memory, which captures single-task progress and multi-task scheduling. Particularly, we introduce Behavior-Conditioned Evaluation. For tasks with multiple valid execution paths, instead of fixing a single target or trajectory, the evaluator derives later task constraints from the robot's earlier actions. This allows us to evaluate whether later behavior is consistent with the robot's own interaction history while reducing shortcuts based on fixed target assignments. We provide 1,800 successful demonstrations for policy training. We also develop a baseline on our benchmark, namely Hierarchical Memory-Augmented Policy(HMAP). Its high-level planner uses structured entity and process memories to generate subtasks. Its low-level VLA controller uses subgoal-conditioned queries to incorporate VGGT-Omega geometry into action generation. Together, RoboCasa-Mem and HMAP baseline support systematic evaluation of memory-dependent behavior and the development of memory-aware mobile manipulation policies.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: HMAP 的高层规划器更新实体记忆与过程记忆并选择子目标，低层控制器用子目标检索当前多视角几何特征以生成动作。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 把“长时序”与“必须记住已不可见信息”分开，构造9个环境记忆/过程记忆移动操作任务，并用行为条件化评测防止策略靠固定目标走捷径。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 多任务调度仍很弱：HeatAndInspect虽将SCR从0.32升至0.50，却没有方法完成整任务；真机仅一个任务、每法10次，样本很小。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

A robot action can satisfy shape and range constraints yet carry the wrong semantics: axes may be permuted, signs inverted, rotations rescaled, or gripper polarity reversed. We study learned state-action-effect relations as offline contracts for detecting these mismatches and ranking their likely fields. Clean held-out transitions calibrate alarms; a fixed inverse vocabulary supports closed-set localization. On ten LIBERO Spatial tasks comprising 432 source episodes, a capacity-controlled comparison at 2.5% empirical clean false-positive rate gives 46.1% recall for a ridge forward residual, 61.0% for a four-component joint Gaussian mixture, and 65.7% for the exact conditional of that same mixture. The joint score retains a 14.9 percentage-point advantage over ridge, while conditioning improves recall by a further 4.7 points. Joint scoring instead has higher localization: 95.8% versus 94.6%. These matched-rate comparisons are retrospective diagnostics, not deployment calibration guarantees. Earlier Object/Goal results broaden tasks within the LIBERO convention; DROID, all three HYDRA tasks, short temporal faults, small offsets, exact repair, and simulated mitigation fail their respective gates, while xArm contributes one task only. The evidence supports a bounded offline diagnostic and a detection-localization tradeoff, rather than joint-density superiority or cross-robot safety.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.text: 把状态—动作—效果关系当作离线“接口契约”，检测轴置换、符号翻转、旋转缩放、夹爪极性等形状合法但语义错误的动作接口。

docs.text: LIBERO-Spatial 10任务、432条源回合；在匹配2.5%干净假阳性率下，ridge前向残差召回46.08%，联合GMM 60.96%，条件GMM 65.66%；定位率分别92.70/95.81/94.62%。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 这是回溯式离线诊断而非部署安全保证；DROID、三项HYDRA、短时故障、小偏移、精确修复和模拟缓解均未通过预设门槛，xArm只有一个任务。

docs.title: Compounding Physical RSI
docs.text:
Compounding Physical RSI: Turning Execution Failure into Inherited Capability

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习

首发 2026-11-04，v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-06 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

已核对 arXiv v1 摘要和全文，未发现作者项目页或实现仓库链接。公开检索未找到可核实的作者入口。 （2026-11-06 核查）

贡献=大系统＋核心方法；路线=VLA＋Agent；层级=策略学习＋阶段诊断＋验证/恢复；任务=桌面操作（仿真）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Generalist robot policies are trained on static offline datasets, yet physical manipulation unfolds sequentially across stages. Because a weakness in a downstream stage remains unobservable until the policy passes earlier ones, each resolved bottleneck exposes the next hidden failure mode. This staged structure calls for Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI), in which a policy iteratively executes, diagnoses failures, and updates itself. Moreover, because task completion behaves like a product of stage-level pass rates, recursive gains can multiply across generations. In physical environments, three bottlenecks obstruct compounding: terminal execution feedback rarely localizes the stage that caused a failure, failed trajectories do not supply the corrective action, and updating shared parameters can degrade previously mastered skills. We propose Compounding Physical RSI, a self-evolving policy framework that turns execution failures into heritable capability. First, automated capability-gap assessment traces failed rollouts to the task stage where progression breaks down and formulates a structured improvement objective. Second, conditioned on this objective, our remedy stage curates validated, stage-relevant experience and refines the policy via behavior-regularized offline reinforcement learning, without requiring costly online rollouts at each optimization step. Third, to safeguard existing skills, our retention stage constructs weight-space candidates between the inherited reference policy and the refined policy, evaluates them across the task suite, and promotes the best candidate as the reference state for the next generation. Evaluated across all 42 tasks of the RoboDojo-Sim benchmark, CSU-AI-07 ranks first on the leaderboard with a three-seed mean Overall Score of 26.15 and Success Rate of 20.70%, outperforming the next-best entry by 5.92 points and 5.82 percentage points.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: RoboDojo-Sim 执行轨迹用于诊断阶段能力缺口。结构化目标指导经验整理和离线强化学习，之后评估候选权重并保留通过验证的策略。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 提出“诊断—补救—保留”递归改进闭环：定位最早失败阶段，定向整理经验并做目标条件离线RL，再通过全任务闭环评测选择权重插值候选，避免修一项忘一片。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: RoboDojo-Sim 42任务、3个种子；CSU-AI-07整任务成功率20.70%、阶段型Overall Score 26.15，领先次优GalaxeaVLA的14.88%/20.23；相对π0.5的6.93%成功率接近3倍。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 全部证据来自仿真；作者没有给诊断、经验选择、权重合并各组件的细粒度消融；改进算子本身固定，尚不是“会改进改进算法”的强RSI。

docs.text:

docs.text:
Reinforcement Learning Enables Scaling Generalist Robot Policy Improvement

VLA 与策略学习

首发 2026-11-04，v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-06 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

官方仓库提供 π0.5 在 LIBERO-90 与 MolmoSpaces 上的 FSFT 和 Best-of-N 最小实现。README 标明 OGPO 实现尚待发布。配图取自 v1 原论文 PDF 第 5 页。 （2026-11-06 核查）

贡献=核心方法/系统性研究；路线=VLA；层级=低层策略学习；任务=桌面操作（仿真）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

The introduction of generalist robot policies has enabled a single, large model to learn to perform a variety of tasks from a vast pre-training corpus. While these models often exhibit powerful zero-shot generalization capabilities, they typically require an adaptation phase to achieve sufficient performance in deployment. Iterated self-improvement via reinforcement learning (RL) has demonstrated promise in enabling this adaptation, yet such approaches have been largely explored in single-task settings - where the goal is to simply improve on a narrow deployment task - which lies in stark contrast to the multi-task capabilities of the base policy. In this work we ask whether generalist robot policies are capable of multi-task, generalist improvement in deployment - targeting many diverse tasks simultaneously - and what algorithmic recipe enables this. To answer this question, we first develop a set of structured evaluations to test generalist improvement capabilities, and systematically evaluate algorithmic and practical design choices regarding value estimation, policy extraction and resource allocation. We show that not only can generalist policies be improved online across diverse tasks, but that the right recipe can enable generalization and increase performance on tasks not considered during online training. We characterize when this generalization occurs and show that both the training task distribution and the use of value-based RL are critical. To the best of our knowledge, this is among the first evidence for online generalist improvement for robot foundation models.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 跨训练任务收集轨迹并汇入共享回放缓冲区，分别比较直接策略适配、评论器引导动作选择和策略提取，再在训练与留出任务上评估。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 系统研究VLA部署后多任务在线改进，表明只有足够多样的训练任务配合价值函数引导的动作选择/策略提取，才会从“对已见任务变强”跨到“对未见任务也变强”。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 在MolmoSpaces从1扩至144个抓取任务，并在LIBERO补测；OGPO/Best-of-N等价值引导方法在多任务训练集上比过滤式SFT高43–50/15–21个百分点，在未见场景最高提升58个百分点、未见物体最高39个百分点；16任务联合后训练达到类似单任务专家改进时，梯度步数少2.9倍。最终评测为每任务32回合、3种子和95% bootstrap CI。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 主要是仿真抓取与LIBERO；在LIBERO最多64个训练任务时未观察到未见任务泛化，说明结论强依赖任务族结构与多样性尺度。

docs.text:

docs.title: Spatial-UMI-Dream
docs.text:
Spatial-UMI-Dream: Scaling World Action Models with Metric Geometry for UMI Manipulation

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM

首发 2026-11-04，v1；本期因索引延迟补收  ·  收录于 2026-11-07 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗GitHub ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

作者发布了模型微调、部署和深度生成代码，README 列有预训练及 RoboTwin-UMI 微调权重。配套 RoboTwin-UMI 仓库提供仿真基准与评测入口，并链接训练示范。 （2026-11-07 核查）

大系统＋核心方法＋基准｜WM/WAM＋VLA｜低层策略学习｜双臂桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

The Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) enables scalable demonstration collection independently of a specific robot. However, its moving, close-range gripper cameras entangle camera and object motion without a stable external view, leaving the metric geometry needed for precise manipulation implicit in RGB. We introduce Spatial-UMI-Dream, a 5B spatial World Action Model (WAM) pretrained on 605 hours of RGB-D UMI data through two-stage training -- world-only adaptation followed by joint world-action learning -- to jointly predict future RGB, fisheye-aligned metric depth, and actions. Stereo-derived depth makes scene scale and spatial relationships explicit within a unified dual-gripper RGB-D representation. Furthermore, evaluating UMI policies requires testing whether UMI's robot-independent demonstration collection translates into policy generalization across robot embodiments, alongside robustness to environmental changes. We introduce RoboTwin-UMI, a twenty-task simulation benchmark built on RoboTwin with UMI wrist-mounted fisheye observations, enabling controlled, repeatable evaluation of UMI policies under environment and embodiment changes separately and jointly without additional fine-tuning. On RoboTwin-UMI, Spatial-UMI-Dream achieves 79.10% in-domain success and 72.15% under combined embodiment and environment shifts, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline in each setting by 4.65 and 10.30 percentage points, respectively. It also exhibits the smallest success-rate drop under embodiment transfer among the evaluated policies. In a matched pretraining ablation, RGB-only pretraining leads to a 5.75-percentage-point decrease in in-domain success compared with RGB-D pretraining. Across six real-world tasks, Spatial-UMI-Dream achieves 85.0% average success, exceeding the strongest baseline by 24.2 percentage points. Project page: https://weiduoyuan.com/spatial-umi-dream/

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 两阶段共享同一个世界—动作 Transformer。先用双夹爪 RGB-D 预测未来观测，再加入 UMI 状态及带噪动作，联合预测未来 RGB-D 和动作。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 在 605 小时 RGB-D UMI 数据上两阶段预训练 5B WAM，联合预测 RGB、与鱼眼对齐的 metric depth 和动作，并构建跨 embodiment/环境的 RoboTwin-UMI。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 真实 Dexmate Vega1 六任务、每任务 20 次：整任务成功率 85.0%、阶段进度 93.2%，π0.5 为 60.8%/73.3%；RoboTwin-UMI 20 任务为 79.10%，π0.5 为 74.45%；底盘/环境联合转移为 72.15%，最强基线 61.85%。RGB-D 相比 RGB 的域内增益 5.75 点。

docs.title: 真实新意
docs.text: 把 UMI 的机器人无关采集、显式尺度几何和 world-action pretraining 联到同一个闭环控制评测里，而非只报告视频预测质量。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 每个模拟任务使用 50 条示范，预训练 24 张 RTX PRO 6000、下游 8 GPU；真实“移动机器人”实验未评测导航或移动底座控制，因此本期归为双臂桌面操作而非 mobile manipulation。

docs.title: Concertina
docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 06

docs.title: Concertina
docs.text:
Concertina: Embodying Manipulation and Cognition in One Diffusion Vision-Language Model

VLA 与策略学习

首发 2026-11-05，v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-07 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

官方仓库提供模型、训练配置及 CALVIN 和 LIBERO 评测，作者的 Hugging Face 集合列有公开权重。README 标明清洗后的预训练数据及第一阶段权重未发布。原文 Homepage 当前显示另一篇 TACG 论文，暂未收录该入口。 （2026-11-07 核查）

核心方法｜VLA｜低层策略学习｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Most vision-language-action (VLA) policies decouple manipulation from cognition by bolting an external action mechanism onto a vision-language model (VLM)--either quantizing actions into discrete tokens whose errors bear no stable correspondence to physical displacements, or delegating continuous trajectory generation to a separate action expert whose gradients compete with or are blocked from updating the VLM backbone. We argue that manipulation and cognition should instead be embodied in the same model, shifting from a decoupled VLA to an Embodied Vision-Language Model (eVLM). We introduce Concertina, an eVLM that places continuous trajectory representation, blockwise generation, and physical-coordinate supervision directly on the computation and parameter path of a shared diffusion VLM backbone. Each control timestep is encoded as one continuous latent action token in the backbone hidden space, and the shared Transformer reconstructs temporally ordered action blocks via the same corrupt-and-reconstruct operator used for multimodal pretraining. Active action projections account for only 0.21% of parameters in the 4.46B model with zero separate action-generator layers, compared with 16.5%-35.1% dedicated action-expert capacity in representative continuous VLAs. Using our proposed Action Interface Audit, we confirm that cross-time trajectory coupling emerges in the middle and late layers of the shared backbone rather than at the action interfaces. On standard benchmarks, Concertina achieves 98.15% average success on regular LIBERO, 85.9% on the 10,030-task LIBERO-Plus benchmark, and 4.142 average completed chain length on CALVIN ABC-D. Code: https://github.com/lose4578/Concertina Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/collections/Traly/concertina

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 共享掩码扩散 Transformer 处理多模态上下文和连续动作潜变量，由逐位置动作解码器重建动作。右图展示块内去噪、打包训练注意力和跨块生成。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 在共享 diffusion VLM 内用连续 latent action token 和 blockwise 双向轨迹建模直接生成动作，不外挂 action expert/codec，主动作接口仅占 4.46B 模型的 0.21%。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: LIBERO 2,000 episodes 平均 98.15%，π0.5 为 97.5%；LIBERO-Plus 8,615/10,030＝85.9%，EFFVLA 79.8%；CALVIN ABC→D 的平均完成链长 4.142，SR@1/2 为 98.6%/93.8%。坐标副目标的反事实实验梯度余弦为 −0.891，CALVIN 链长从 2.970 跌到 0.237。

docs.title: 真实新意
docs.text: 不是简单换 action head，而是统一动作表示、监督目标与生成机制，并用内部审计证明跨时轨迹耦合发生在共享骨干中。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 全部为模拟 benchmark，没有真实机器人或 mobile manipulation；LIBERO 已接近饱和，主要应看 LIBERO-Plus 与 CALVIN。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
对“VLA 该外挂 action expert，还是让 VLM 原生生成连续动作”给出了结构上很完整的答案。

docs.title: From Semantics to Contact
docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 03

docs.title: From Semantics to Contact
docs.text:
From Semantics to Contact: Language-Guided Residual Reinforcement Learning for Contact-Rich Manipulation

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能

首发 2026-11-05（v1，NeurIPS 2026）  ·  收录于 2026-11-08 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

arXiv v1 的正式题名为 Semantics-to-Contact: A Stagewise Framework for Robust Contact-Rich Manipulation。v1 复现清单称计划在论文接收后公开代码与数据，核查时作者项目页尚未提供实现代码。 （2026-11-09 核查）

核心方法＋系统｜VLM/Agent＋RL｜技能阶段＋低层接触控制｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Contact-rich manipulation requires precise control under complex contact dynamics while remaining robust to diverse visual conditions. However, real-world reinforcement learning often overfits to the visual appearance of training scenes. We propose Semantics-to-Contact (S2C), a stagewise framework for visually robust contact-rich manipulation. The insight is to decompose the problem into two stages: semantic focusing and contact refinement. In the first stage, a vision-language model localizes task-relevant regions across visually diverse scenes, providing coarse spatial guidance and reducing the burden of exploration. In the second stage, a real-world human-in-the-loop residual reinforcement learning policy learns fine-grained contact behaviors within the localized region using force feedback. To further improve visual robustness, we introduce an object-centric visual augmentation strategy that randomizes background appearance while preserving the robot and task-relevant objects. Experiments on six contact-rich real-world manipulation tasks exhibit that S2C consistently improves success rates over strong baselines and maintains reliable performance under significant visual and positional variations. These results demonstrate that stagewise semantic focusing and contact refinement provide a practical path toward visually robust real-world contact-rich manipulation. Our demos can be seen in https://edem-ai.github.io/S2C/.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: VLM 先做语义定位并经 3D 标定得到接触前目标，随后用人工介入的残差强化学习做局部接触精修。分割引导的颜色与纹理增强用于残差策略训练。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 先用 VLM 做语义定位，再用带力反馈和人工介入的 residual RL 精修接触过程，把“找到操作位置”和“完成精细插接”分成两个可训练阶段。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 6 个真实插接任务、每个设置 20 次测试，平均成功率 94.17%；HIL-ConRFT 91.76%、HIL-SERL 90.83%、ACT 2.5%、Octo-small 5.83%。六项分别为 20/20、20/20、20/20、20/20、17/20、16/20。在视觉与位置联合扰动下为 69.17%，两个人工介入 RL 基线为 0。单任务 learner-side 训练时间约 20–90 分钟。充电器定位上 MolmoPoint-8B 为 10/10、约 2 秒，GPT-5.5 API 同为 10/10、约 15 秒。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 训练明确依赖人工介入和力传感；任务规模只有 6 类，部分补充实验仅 10 次。物体外观变化仍是硬边界：插排内出现 OOD 物体或黑色充电器时可降到 0/10。文中的训练时间主要指学习器更新，不包含完整机器人 rollout 墙钟时间。

docs.title: 为什么值得读／真实新意
docs.text:
比“VLM 直接出动作”更务实：语义视觉只负责粗定位，接触阶段交给专门控制器。新意在阶段分工与 object-centric augmentation 的组合，而不是通用 VLA；真实实验扎实，但需要把人类介入成本算进系统代价。

docs.title: RoboImagine
docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 06

docs.title: RoboImagine
docs.text:
RoboImagine: Improving Autoregressive Robot World Models with Post-Training

世界模型与 WAM

首发 2026-11-05（v1）  ·  收录于 2026-11-08 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

日报题名沿用邮件原文。arXiv v1 原题为“Learning Robotic World Models with Semantic and Visual Feedback”。作者仓库包含训练与评测实验代码及推理入口。作者的 Hugging Face 发布页（https://huggingface.co/easylearning/RoboImagine）列有 RT-1、BridgeV2 和 RoboCasa 的模型文件、编解码器及样例。 （2026-11-09 核查）

核心方法＋训练 trick｜WM/WAM｜世界预测／验证｜桌面操作数据，但仅离线视频生成

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Robot world models predict action-conditioned future visual states to support robotic planning and decision making. However, visual reconstruction does not fully capture task progress, semantic evaluation alone provides limited constraints on fine-grained visual errors, and homogeneous predictions limit comparative feedback. We present RoboImagine, a framework for post-training autoregressive robotic world models through candidate-future comparisons with semantic and visual feedback. Diverse search promotes diversity among candidate trajectories under shared visual observations, action sequences, and task instructions. A frozen multimodal evaluator provides task-relevant semantic preferences through pairwise video comparisons in both presentation orders, complemented by pixel- and perceptual-level visual consistency feedback that constrains local structural and appearance errors. These signals drive policy optimization through group-relative advantages. Fixed initial context and branch-specific rolling histories support long-sequence generation with bounded context and consistent conditioning between candidate generation and policy optimization. Experiments with separately trained models on RT-1, BridgeV2, and RoboCasa cover real-world and simulated manipulation. On RT-1, under matched initialization, update counts, and evaluation protocols, RoboImagine improves PSNR by 1.26 dB and reduces LPIPS by 11.93% relative to continued supervised fine-tuning. Ablations show that diverse search improves prediction quality and that combined semantic and visual feedback yields higher external multimodal evaluation scores than visual feedback alone while maintaining comparable visual fidelity. Rolling histories further improve long-horizon prediction. These results support improving visual fidelity, task relevance, and long-horizon prediction through candidate comparison and complementary feedback.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 先用观测、动作和文本监督自回归世界模型，再搜索多样的候选未来，结合冻结评估器的双向语义比较和视觉反馈更新策略。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 用冻结多模态评估器对候选未来做双向成对偏好比较，并结合像素/感知反馈与 group-relative policy optimization，后训练自回归机器人世界模型。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: RT-1 上取 128 条轨迹、匹配 500 次更新；SFT 初始化为 PSNR 21.37、SSIM 0.7860、LPIPS 0.1734，GDBS 后为 22.57/0.8035/0.1541。相对继续 SFT，PSNR 提升 1.26 dB、LPIPS 下降 11.93%。GDBS 代价约 25.34 GPU-second/trajectory，对比 MCTS 84.29；96 帧长时生成约 75.96–95.14 秒、显存 2.32–2.59 GiB。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 只有离线未来视频质量，没有闭环规划、真实机器人控制或任务成功率证据；评估器偏好和像素指标不等价于物理可执行性。后训练也提高了计算开销。

docs.title: 为什么值得读／真实新意
docs.text:
它给 robot world model 引入了相对偏好式后训练，并显著降低了比 MCTS 更昂贵的候选搜索成本；但现阶段应归类为生成质量改进，不能据此声称操作性能提高。

docs.title: HITCH
docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 01

docs.title: HITCH
docs.text:
HITCH: A Generalist Humanoid Policy via Vision-Language Planning and Whole-Body Tracking

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能移动操作

首发 2026-11-05（v1）  ·  收录于 2026-11-08 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

日报题名沿用邮件原文。arXiv v1 原题为“HITCH: Teaching a Vision-Language Model to Operate a Humanoid through a Whole-Body Harness”。原文列出的项目页在本次访问时返回 Cloudflare 验证页（HTTP 403），尚无法核验其内容；未找到可核验的 HITCH 实现仓库。 （2026-11-09 核查）

大系统＋核心接口｜Agent/VLM｜规划／技能＋低层全身跟踪｜移动操作（含 locomotion；真实机仅搬运与导航）

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Enabling vision-language models (VLMs) to control humanoid robots requires both reliable whole-body interfaces and knowledge of how to use the body that carries over across tasks. We present HITCH (Harness Interfaces To Command Humanoids), a harness in which perception returns the 3D position of any point the VLM selects in its image, and execution turns commands for the pelvis, torso, hands, walking, and gaze into whole-body motion with a learned tracker. We find that both measuring the scene and executing commands accurately raise task success. We then fine-tune a VLM on trajectories in which teacher policies solve five base tasks through HITCH, so that it learns how to operate the humanoid. Without task-specific trajectories, the fine-tuned model completes 51% of SIMPLE episodes and 42.5% of HumanoidArena episodes, and adding five trajectories per SIMPLE task raises its SIMPLE success to 95%. On a real G1, it carries a box and walks to a goal without real training data.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: VLM 通过感知接口获取图像选点的三维坐标，通过执行接口调用全身规划与跟踪。教师策略在同一套接口中生成多轮轨迹，用于微调 VLM。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 把 VLM 规划器、图像点选式 3D 感知接口与全身运动跟踪器组合成通用人形机器人框架，用少量教师轨迹把高层语言决策落到走路、躯干、手和视线协同。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 在 SIMPLE 6 个任务（每任务 30 个 episode）和 HumanoidArena 4 个任务（每任务 20 个 episode）上，仅用 5 个基础任务教师轨迹训练后分别达到 51.1% 与 42.5% 成功率；每任务再加入 5 条 SIMPLE 轨迹后，SIMPLE 达到 95.0%。执行教师本身成功率 97.9%，对比两个跟踪基线 27.9% 和 12.9%；去掉感知后 SIMPLE 仅 2.8%。零真实数据迁移到 Unitree G1，搬运 13/20、导航 6/10，由操作员判定成功。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 真实机只验证两类任务且样本很小；手部没有手指控制；每个动作命令执行完才重新观察，动作期间不能闭环纠错；当前规划器不覆盖坐下和跨障。额外任务轨迹还可能收窄迁移，例如 HumanoidArena 从 42.5% 降到 28.8%。

docs.title: 为什么值得读／真实新意
docs.text:
亮点不是新的低层动作表示，而是把 VLM 可调用接口压缩成少量可验证的全身命令，并展示高层少样本适配与强低层执行器的乘法关系。对“agentic embodied system 如何划分接口”很有参考价值；但“generalist”在真实世界的证据仍有限。

docs.title: La-JEPA
docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 04

docs.title: La-JEPA
docs.text:
La-JEPA: Compact Robot Policies with Latent World Modeling

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM

首发 2026-11-05，v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-07 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

arXiv 链接指向作者的公开 GitHub 仓库，页面显示仓库为空，目前无实现可查。框架图由原文 SVG 渲染为 PNG。 （2026-11-07 核查）

核心方法＋基准诊断｜WM/WAM｜低层策略学习｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

World-action models adapt pretrained video generators, and vision-language-action models build on pretrained vision-language backbones; both tie policy architecture and inference cost to large transformers designed for generation rather than control. It remains unclear how much these generation-oriented choices affect control. In this work, we introduce Latent Action JEPA (La-JEPA), a compact world-action model whose policy transformer is trained from scratch in the feature space of a pretrained V-JEPA 2.1 encoder. Following Fast-WAM, La-JEPA learns to predict future features jointly with actions during training and generates only actions at inference. Among policies without embodied pretraining, La-JEPA achieves state-of-the-art performance in clean and randomized RoboTwin 2.0 scenes and on LIBERO-Plus with correct instructions, while using far fewer parameters than the strongest competing policies. It runs substantially faster than Fast-WAM at comparable performance and outperforms the closest JEPA-based methods, LeapBot-WA and JEPA-WAM, on LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin 2.0 without their pretrained policy backbones. On four real-robot tasks, its average success is comparable to pi0.5 and above non-embodied-pretrained baselines. Through a design study of the choices behind La-JEPA, we show that JEPA features outperform video VAE latents, most clearly out of distribution, and that training-time future prediction choices significantly impact the policy even when future prediction is skipped at inference. We correct the LIBERO-Plus instructions, as the officially released evaluator corrupts them for most variants, and re-evaluate several strong open baselines. Without a generative pretrained policy backbone, La-JEPA is better and faster than far larger policies, suggesting that robot foundation models may benefit from architectures designed for control rather than inherited from generation.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 编码当前和未来视觉特征，世界与动作分支联合训练。右图展示上下文及未来帧的 tube-motion 编码。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 冻结 V-JEPA 2.1 感知编码器，用从头训练的小型策略 Transformer 在训练期联合预测未来特征和动作、部署期只出动作，证明 WAM 不必继承昂贵视频生成骨干。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 修正 LIBERO-Plus 被污染的指令后，L 版 84.1%（10,030 个变体，3 seed 均值），StarVLA 77.6%、JEPA-WAM 77.8%、Fast-WAM 70.8%；联合未来预测相对 action-only 为 76.47% vs 74.35%。真实 Franka 四任务合计 70/80 次成功，平均 17.5/20，π0.5 为 17.25/20；单次策略调用 25.16 ms，Fast-WAM 88.09 ms。

docs.title: 真实新意
docs.text: 方法贡献与评测贡献都成立：一是紧凑 latent WAM，二是指出 LIBERO-Plus 8,493/10,030 个变体的发布指令被附加扰动参数。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 真实机器人只有 4 个任务、每任务多为 20 次；没有 embodied pretraining 的比较很干净，但不代表能全面超过大规模机器人预训练模型。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
对“世界模型必须生成像素、必须大模型化吗”给出了有说服力的反例。

docs.title: RoboARCade
docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 03

docs.title: RoboARCade
docs.text:
RoboARCade: Benchmarking Agentic Robot Control

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能

首发 2026-11-05，v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-07 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

项目页提供排行榜、试验视频和轨迹。第一作者主页链接的公开仓库包含 MuJoCo 任务、仿真及评测核心、控制接口和回放面板。网格与纹理按仓库说明从 Hugging Face 获取。 （2026-11-07 核查）

基准/诊断｜Agent/agentic coding｜规划＋记忆＋验证｜桌面长程操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Improvements in multi-modal capabilities have enabled agents to act directly as robot policies, a setting we refer to as agentic robot control (ARC). We introduce RoboARCade, a benchmark of long-horizon manipulation tasks across three embodiments designed to test in-context adaptation, memory, and reasoning for precise control. The tasks build on existing open-source benchmarks, which we make harder by widening the range of initial conditions. RoboARCade is easy to use and extend: all tasks run on a single simulation backend, MuJoCo, each task is a self-contained data pack, and agents connect through interchangeable interfaces, so new tasks, agents, and interfaces can be added independently. The benchmark separates leading agents: GPT-6 Astra achieves 49.8% compared with 43.6% for Claude Fable 5.1, leaving substantial room for improvement. Comparing two interfaces, we find that a richer visual interface adds only 1.5 to 6.8 points at 1.7 to 2.3 times the cost. Failures stem mostly from choosing a poor manipulation strategy or executing a good one imprecisely, rarely from misunderstanding the scene, and agents incorrectly claim success on 24% to 39% of attempted subtasks. Agents can also improve without human input: one successful demonstration in context raises Astra's score from 53.5% to 73.0% on a five-task subset, and a prompt the agent writes and revises itself reaches 72.0%. Code, videos and full traces are available at roboarcade.org.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 系统概览
docs.text: 对比层级式 VLA、代码即策略与论文评测的智能体直接控制。智能体接收相机与本体感知反馈，并在闭环中直接给出机器人控制器目标。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 以统一 MuJoCo 后端、22 个长程任务和 3 种 embodiment，系统测量多模态 agent 直接调用机器人接口时的推理、记忆、适应和自我验证。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 每任务 5 个 seed；GPT-6 Astra 在 VIA 接口下为 49.8%，Claude Fable 5.1 为 43.6%。这里的“Success”是完成 rubric 子任务比例，不是整条长程任务成功率；agent 对已尝试子任务有 24%–39% 的错误成功声明。5 任务子集加入一次成功示范后 Astra 从 53.5% 升到 73.0%，自写/自修 prompt 达 72.0%。丰富 VIA 相比多视角 RGB-D 只多 1.5–6.8 点，却约贵 1.7–2.3 倍。

docs.title: 真实新意
docs.text: 把 agent 接口信息量、API 成本和“说成功但没成功”的验证失真放在同一实验框架里。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 完全是模拟；核心指标是子任务进度，不能当作整任务成功率；模型/API 成本会随服务版本变化。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
这是本期判断 agentic embodied 系统是否真的在控制机器人、而非只在写合理代码的最佳诊断稿。

基准/诊断｜Agent/agentic coding｜规划＋记忆＋验证｜桌面模拟操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Self-improving embodied agents are increasingly being developed and compared on robot simulation benchmarks. Several recent works expose the benchmark's success criteria to the learning agent, a practice we call Criteria Exposure (CE). These criteria, originally written to verify policies trained by imitation learning, often demand more than the corresponding language instructions, so a score from such a verifier may not faithfully reflect whether the instructed task was completed, especially for robot-control programs written by an agent. As embodied coding agents report ever higher benchmark scores, a natural question arises: when a coding agent is exposed to the benchmark's criteria, does it generate code that better performs the instructed task, or code that simply overfits to the verification criteria? We conduct controlled experiments with a self-improving agent with and without CE, and find that with CE the agent quickly produces code with a higher success rate under the given criteria, but this advantage disappears when the criteria are changed slightly without departing from the original instructions. More importantly, the skills the agent develops under CE transfer poorly across tasks. We further propose instruction-faithful criteria and show that they better reflect the performance of agent-generated programs.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 实验流程
docs.text: Actor 执行机器人原语，Learner 根据执行证据迭代技能与记忆库；判据暴露开关控制可见反馈，评测时冻结库并使用未见布局。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 证明把 benchmark 的成功判据代码暴露给自改进 embodied coding agent，会让它学习 verifier 的未明规则，而不一定学到指令要求的任务。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: RoboDojo 25 任务中，原判据下空库/不暴露/暴露 CE 为 24.6%/47.8%/62.0%；优势全部集中在“判据比指令多要求”的 16 任务（27.8% vs 51.6%）。换成语义仍忠实但略改的判据后优势消失；跨任务复用时不暴露库 80/200，暴露库 71/200，空库 65/200；跨到 LIBERO-PRO 和 RoboCasa365 的收益也很小。

docs.title: 真实新意
docs.text: 直接控制 agent、primitive、轮数和布局，只改变是否能看 verifier，从因果上拆出 benchmark overfitting。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 判据重写只覆盖 RoboDojo，且反馈来自干净模拟器；真实机器人需要 VLM/人类判定，噪声会更大。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
它改变了 agentic embodied 系统该怎么报分：默认应隐藏判据，并同时报告 instruction-faithful 评测。

核心方法＋数据｜WM｜世界预测＋规划｜桌面/接触丰富模拟操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

We introduce GPWM, a Generative Particle World Model that predicts how 3D scenes evolve by generating the motion of particles and rigid bodies over time. Unlike video world models that generate scene appearance, GPWM operates directly in 3D physical space. A single representation and architecture cover rigid, deformable, cloth, and granular materials, in both passive physics and robotic interaction. GPWM is an object-aware multi-resolution transformer that combines flow matching with diffusion forcing to generate coherent physical trajectories far beyond its training horizon. We train and evaluate GPWM on ParticleWorlds, a 25.5-million-frame corpus spanning diverse geometries, materials, interactions, and robot embodiments. GPWM outperforms the best prior learned-dynamics baseline in each of six physical domains, reducing prediction error by 31% on average. Breaking from the domain-specific setting of prior methods, a single Unified GPWM models these heterogeneous regimes with one set of weights, largely outperforming per-domain baselines and even surpassing our own specialist models in two domains. GPWM further generalizes to unseen geometries, physical properties, object counts, and rollout horizons. Beyond prediction, GPWM enables contact-rich planning by learning a generative prior over joint actuator-object motion. Instead of searching over unconstrained actions, planning searches the model's latent noise for interactions that achieve a desired object-space goal. With the same world model, noise-space planning substantially outperforms action-space search on pushing and picking, where complex contact sequences are hard to discover. Executed open-loop in simulation, the resulting plans achieve goal-directed manipulation without reference action trajectories or goal-specific policies.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 带噪粒子 token 经 PointNet++ 多分辨率池化、时空 DiT 与跳连上采样，结合逐帧噪声条件预测未来粒子位移。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 用对象感知、多分辨率 3D 粒子生成模型统一刚体、软体、布料和颗粒动力学，并直接在生成噪声空间而不是逐帧动作空间里规划接触序列。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: ParticleWorlds 含 267,864 个 episode、25.46M 帧、6 个物理域，预测误差较各域最强学习基线平均降低 31%。模拟开环规划中，推动/抓取的噪声空间规划任务进度为 0.48–0.57/0.40–0.56，动作空间规划≤0.01；颗粒堆操作为 0.21–0.23，动作空间最强 0.19。推动/颗粒各 50 个场景，抓取 25 个，预算最高 100/200 秒。

docs.title: 真实新意
docs.text: 规划变量是世界模型的生成先验，能自然提出“先换位再接触/先抓稳再抬起”的候选，而不是靠随机动作搜索撞出来。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 使用完整、持续跟踪的 3D 粒子状态这一特权信息；所有规划在模拟中开环执行，且单次预算达 100–200 秒，不是实时闭环控制。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
展示了世界模型真正参与动作搜索的一条清晰路线，但也把感知和实时性缺口暴露得很充分。

核心方法＋数据增强｜VLA/模仿学习｜低层策略学习｜移动操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Visuomotor policies trained through imitation learning are highly sensitive to changes in camera viewpoint. This is particularly problematic for mobile manipulation (MoMa), where robots rarely execute manipulation from the exact same base pose used during demonstration collection due to navigation uncertainty, localization drift, and environmental constraints. Recent approaches use novel-view synthesis (NVS) to augment demonstrations with unseen viewpoints, but they assume static scenes and therefore fail to re-render the manipulated object during the post-contact interaction phase, leaving the most critical parts of the demonstration unaugmented. We present MOMASPLAT, a novel-view demonstration augmentation framework for mobile manipulation that synthesizes full manipulation trajectories from unseen robot base poses, including dynamic object interactions. Our key insight is that standard MoMa data collection naturally provides the multiview observations needed to reconstruct both the static scene and the manipulated object in 3D. MOMASPLAT combines 3D Gaussian Splatting, feed-forward 3D foundation models, and kinematics-based action retargeting to separately reconstruct the scene and manipulated object, render them from novel viewpoints, and generate geometrically consistent synthetic demonstrations paired with transformed actions. We evaluate MOMASPLAT on five real-world mobile manipulation tasks involving both rigid and articulated objects across three scenes, and validate the fidelity of its synthesized demonstrations against ground truth in simulation. MOMASPLAT substantially improves robustness to unseen base poses, more than doubling the average success rate of the strongest baseline and maintaining non-trivial success at large base displacements where all baselines fail, while reducing the need for largescale real-world data collection.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 分别重建静态场景和动态物体，将观测渲染到新底座位姿并重定向动作，再用原始与合成示范训练策略。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 把静态场景和被操作物体分开做 3D Gaussian Splatting/前馈 3D 重建，再配合运动学动作重定向，从新的移动底座位姿合成包含接触后动态物体运动的完整示范。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 3 个真实场景、5 个任务，源数据每任务 75–90 条、3 个底座位姿和 9 条导航轨迹；测试 12 个未见底座位姿、每位姿 3 次。平均整任务成功率 37%，强基线 One-Thousand Trajectories 为 17%，Source Only 为 6%；在 30–40 cm 大位移处仍有 33%–50%，基线均为 0。

docs.title: 真实新意
docs.text: 不只是“换视角”渲染，而是补齐接触后的动态物体，从而让图像与变换后的动作在完整轨迹上保持几何一致。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 导航后操作阶段底座固定，并非底座—机械臂同步全身控制；主要覆盖静态背景、可见刚体/关节物体，变形物、严重遮挡和弱纹理仍困难。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
本期与真正 mobile manipulation 最直接的一篇，且指标是未见底座位姿上的整任务成功率。

核心方法＋训练数据｜VLA｜低层策略学习｜桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Reliable robotic manipulation requires both semantic understanding and precise control in three-dimensional space. However, vision-language-action (VLA) foundations largely inherit visual representations from 2D vision-language pre-training, while spatial supervision is often introduced only during task-specific adaptation. Developing spatial understanding as a transferable foundation-model capability therefore calls for learning from broader robot experience. We present SLA, a Spatial-Language-Action Model that scales implicit spatial alignment to continual pre-training and maintains it during downstream post-training. Initialized from a pretrained pi05 policy, SLA jointly optimizes action prediction and alignment between intermediate visual embeddings and spatial representations from a frozen 3D perception model. We curate and unify heterogeneous robot datasets to support spatial learning across diverse embodiments, tasks, and scenes. To accommodate this diversity, we introduce feature-dependent gates that adaptively aggregate visual embeddings from multiple VLA layers for spatial supervision. The teacher further exploits partially available depth and camera calibration alongside RGB observations, enabling effective use of heterogeneous geometric annotations. Probabilistic state dropout encourages reliance on visual cues and mitigates overfitting to demonstration trajectories. All auxiliary components are used only during training, allowing direct reuse of pretrained VLA weights and preserving the original inference architecture.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 系统概览
docs.text: SLA 先统一异构机器人数据，再在训练时用冻结三维模型监督 VLA 中间视觉表征。图右展示数据规模对比、基准评测与真实机器人实验。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 在 VLA 持续预训练与后训练阶段，把中间视觉表征对齐到冻结的 3D 基础模型，在推理阶段不增加深度传感器或额外模块，以提升空间泛化。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: LIBERO-Plus 87.4；RoboTwin C2R 72.3，C2C/C2R 平均 79.2；RoboCasa-Panda 在每任务 50 条示范下 68.4；RoboDojo-Real 33.9，对比 π0.5 的 12.8。八组真实条件按 object-level success 统计，平均 83.8%，对比 π0.5 59.8%、Spatial Forcing 68.0%、SpatialVLA 53.5%、OpenVLA-OFT 46.0%。

docs.title: 重要边界
docs.text: 真实评测是 50 个对象实例的对象级成功率，不等同于 50 个完整多对象 episode；部分设置是 10 次 rollout、每次 5 个物体。持续预训练用 48 张 H100、batch 4608、36k steps、约 110 小时。3D 教师在训练时使用深度与标定；相关数据处理还移除了 mobile base motion，因此不是移动操作证据。

docs.title: 为什么值得读／真实新意
docs.text:
它把 3D 先验放在表征蒸馏而非推理接口，结果覆盖多套仿真与真实桌面基准，证据比较完整。值得重点看的是“昂贵空间教师训练、轻量部署”的范式；局限是计算预算很大，且真实指标容易被误读成整任务成功率。

模块/trick｜VLA｜低层推理效率/观测选择｜桌面模拟操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable end-to-end robot control, but inference is increasingly expensive. Each decision processes hundreds of visual tokens, often across multiple cameras, leading to substantial computation while allowing irrelevant background content to distract action prediction under distribution shift. We argue that these issues stem from two complementary forms of redundancy: many visual tokens are spatially irrelevant, while attention over the remaining tokens is often misallocated. Based on this observation, we propose T3R, a Training-Free Two-Stage Token Refinement framework. In the first stage, segmentation-guided token pruning removes irrelevant visual patches to reduce computation and eliminate distracting context. In the second stage, saliency-guided attention biasing reallocates attention toward action-critical visual regions and language instructions within the retained tokens. Together, pruning produces a cleaner candidate set, while attention biasing further emphasizes the most decision-relevant evidence, yielding a better accuracy-efficiency frontier than either stage alone. On LIBERO-Spatial, T3R removes 85% of scene-camera visual tokens while essentially matching the unpruned success rate, and improves success by up to 7 percentage points under out-of-distribution object-placement perturbations. The timing comparison attributes 7.8 ms per inference call to pruning and attention-bias application. As input resolution increases, LLM-forward profiling shows up to a 3.3x speedup over the unpruned baseline. Evaluations across LIBERO, SIMPLER, and RoboTwin with three VLA backbones show the strongest accuracy-efficiency benefits in multi-camera settings. These results demonstrate that training-free token refinement is a practical approach to efficient and robust VLA inference.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 分割引导的第一阶段剪除无关视觉 token，第二阶段以积分梯度识别指令显著词并加入注意力偏置，再解码动作。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 先按分割掩码剪掉背景视觉 token，再用显著性给保留 token 和语言指令加 attention bias，无需训练即可减少 VLA 推理负担。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: OpenVLA-OFT 在 LIBERO-Spatial 剪掉 85% 场景相机 token 后成功率 96%，未剪枝 97%，TeamVLA 94%；同为 85% 削减时 ADP 66%、FastV 14%。每次调用从 107.5 ms 降到 92.5 ms，其中模块本身约 7.8 ms；OOD 放置最多 +7 点，高分辨率 LLM forward 最多 3.3×。还测试 SIMPLER/CogACT 与 RoboTwin/π0.5。

docs.title: 真实新意
docs.text: 把 token 删减与“删完之后把注意力重新放对位置”分成两阶段，优于只剪枝。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 依赖外部分割器，LIBERO-Object 因分割失败只有 82%，低于 TeamVLA 的 86%；端到端加速远小于理论 LLM-forward 加速，且没有真实机器人。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
是很实用的 inference-time trick，但不能把 85% token reduction 等同为 85% 延迟下降。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) enable general-purpose embodied intelligence, but their performance is brittle under distribution shift, where unanticipated failures can damage equipment or endanger people. Deploying VLAs in real-world systems therefore requires a runtime monitor that is timely, calibrated, and informative while being efficient enough to run on the edge. Existing methods fail to fulfill these requirements. We present VLA-Tug, a lightweight probe over the latent layers of a VLA backbone that improves early failure detection and bounds the missed-detection and false-alarm rates, with minimal inference overhead. We show that supervising on the pre-failure segment of a trajectory increases early failure detection at matched false-positive rates by up to 30% over the strongest learned baseline. Under shift to unseen tasks, the bounds on missed-detection and false-alarm rates remain valid in up to 86% of runs, versus at most 21% for baselines. Unlike existing methods, VLA-Tug predicts the failure mode to enable corrective actions, raising top-3 accuracy on unseen tasks by up to 44% over a majority baseline. VLA-Tug enables real-time monitoring where the well-timed and informative probe supports lightweight steering that improves task success. We release a dataset of 3,180 annotated manipulation episodes to support future work on latent failure detection in VLAs at https://vla-tug.github.io.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: VLA 骨干嵌入经循环编码器映射到潜在失败空间，由校准触发器报警并预测失败类型，以支持后续干预。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 在 VLA 隐层上训练轻量时序 probe，并用联合校准同时约束漏检和误报，提前预测失败及其类型。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 发布 3,180 条带失败起点/模式标注的 episode；pre-failure 监督在同等误报率下较最强学习基线最多提升 30% 的提前检测；未见任务上校准界限在最多 86% 运行中有效，基线最多 21%；top-3 失败模式准确率最多高 44 点。GPU 增量约 0.12 ms/步（相对 54 ms 的 GR00T 调用约 0.2%）。

docs.title: 真实新意
docs.text: 把“是否会失败、何时开始失败、为什么失败、统计保证是否仍有效”统一到一个部署监控模块。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: steering 只是按失败类型写的启发式 proof-of-concept，尚无系统性的成功率提升研究；失败标注由 Gemini 辅助生成，真实任务留一测试规模有限。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
这是可插拔 VLA runtime monitor 的强基线，比单看 AUROC 更接近部署需求。

docs.title: VFlash
docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 05

docs.title: VFlash
docs.text:
VFlash: Fast Structured Visual Planning for Robot Manipulation

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM

首发 2026-11-05（v1）  ·  收录于 2026-11-08 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

日报题名沿用邮件原文。arXiv v1 原题为“VFlash: Fast, Accurate Visual Planning via Flash Primitive Decoding”。作者项目页和 NVlabs/Eagle 的 Embodied 实现已核验，包含 VFlash 训练、推理和评测入口。作者说明目标模型与 drafter 检查点将后续发布。 （2026-11-09 核查）

核心方法＋模块/trick｜VLA＋WAM/视觉规划｜规划／观测＋低层条件策略｜仿真桌面操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Models for physical AI tasks, such as robotics and autonomous driving, need not reason solely in language. They can use visual plans--points, bounding boxes, and trajectories--to represent spatial goals and anticipate motion. However, autoregressive vision-language models generate these plans one coordinate token at a time, making richer predictions increasingly costly. We introduce VFlash, a method for fast, accurate visual planning through Flash Primitive Decoding. VFlash exploits the known structure of visual primitives to predict their coordinates jointly, using a lightweight drafter that generates an entire primitive in one forward pass. The layout adapts to the primitive's type, dimensionality, and length, supporting compact boxes and long, variable-length trajectories. Crucially, spatial accuracy need not require reproducing an autoregressive model's exact token sequence. VFlash therefore trains on annotated primitives and directly accepts structurally valid predictions without target-token agreement. Across the evaluated 2D and 3D robot trajectory tasks, VFlash consistently reduces prediction errors relative to autoregressive decoding. Preliminary single-rollout measurements indicate approximately 25x faster generation for 3D point motion forecasting. A world action model conditioned on VFlash plans achieves 70.2% average success across four MolmoSpaces task suites, compared with 62.6% for the baseline.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 视觉 primitive 的起始 token 触发按类型和长度编排的预测块，轻量解码器基于冻结 VLM 上下文并行生成结构化计划。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 把点轨迹等结构化视觉 primitive 从逐坐标自回归，改成一次并行“flash decoding”，让视觉计划生成更快并降低坐标漂移。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 单次初步测试中 3D 点运动生成约 25× 加速，在 Jetson Thor 与 DGX Spark 上延迟降低约 80%。MolmoSpaces 的 plan-conditioned WAM 平均成功率 70.2%，同一 WAM 基线 62.6%；Pick/Pick-and-Place/Open/Close 分别为 83.6/67.3/52.8/77.0，对比 81.1/55.7/49.3/64.2。LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-PRO 分别提升 0.8、1.9、6.8 个点；在 PRO 的 Spatial/Object/Goal 分项提升 11.1/9.4/6.9 个点。

docs.title: 重要局限
docs.text: 25× 是单次 primitive 生成的初步测量，不是端到端机器人吞吐；下游控制结果均为仿真。计划在 action chunk 之前生成，尚未证明长时闭环重规划。MolmoSpaces 对比虽然共享 WAM，但规划器与条件形式仍有变化。

docs.title: 为什么值得读／真实新意
docs.text:
这是少见的“计划表示解码效率”工作，既有推理速度也有下游成功率证据。真正值得借鉴的是结构化并行解码，而不是把它泛化为完整 world model 的能力提升。

docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 04

docs.title: Latent RL Priors for Data-Efficient Dexterous Manipulation
docs.text:
Latent RL Priors for Data-Efficient Dexterous Manipulation

VLA 与策略学习

首发 2026-11-05（v1）  ·  收录于 2026-11-08 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

作者项目页将训练与评测代码及数据标为计划公开，核查时尚未提供下载链接。 （2026-11-09 核查）

核心方法｜VLA/RL prior｜低层策略学习｜仿真桌面灵巧操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Learning dexterous manipulation from limited visual demonstrations is challenging because policies must acquire both perceptual grounding and precise control, while reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation can acquire rich control behaviors from large-scale interaction with privileged information. We introduce \textbf{Latent RL Prior}, a two-stage framework that reuses this control knowledge for data-efficient visual policy learning. During privileged pretraining, we distill large-scale RL rollouts into a flow-matching action decoder conditioned on proprioception and latent task context. During visual adaptation, we freeze the decoder and learn a visual interface that maps images to its latent context using action supervision alone, without privileged labels or latent targets. The same decoder can further be shared across arms by learning coordinated visual contexts for bimanual manipulation. Across three simulated tasks, our method outperforms full-parameter fine-tuning of $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.7 in the low-data regime; on door lifting and bimanual assembly, it surpasses full-data baselines using $10\times$ and $5\times$ fewer demonstrations, respectively. Further analysis shows that direct visual-to-latent conditioning improves adaptation performance and training stability over routing visual predictions through the pretrained state encoder. Robustness to unseen mass variation and greater linear accessibility of contact-force information in decoder representations further provide evidence of retained RL-acquired control knowledge. Project website: https://yixiaowang7.github.io/latent-rl-prior-page/.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 预训练用特权状态和 Q-Former 为动作解码器生成条件。视觉适配阶段冻结动作解码器，从图像学习条件，双臂分别用自身本体状态调用同一解码器。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 先用特权状态 RL 学出动作流形并蒸馏为冻结的 flow action decoder，再只用视觉和动作示范学习 latent interface，从而减少下游模仿数据需求。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: MuJoCo Warp 中使用 KUKA iiwa＋SHARPA 手；上游 RL 产生 100,000 条成功 rollout，随后用 4,000 条 pose-alignment 数据训练 prior。门把手任务用 50 条示范即可超过使用全部 500 条数据的 π0.5/GR00T，双臂任务用 1,000 条超过使用全部 5,000 条数据的同类基线，即分别展示 10× 与 5× 的下游示范效率。实验 3 个随机种子，每个 checkpoint 评估 256 次 rollout。

docs.title: 重要边界
docs.text: 论文选择每次 run 的最佳 checkpoint 汇报，可能偏乐观；全部结果来自仿真，且需要大量特权教师数据与同构机器人。作者明确不宣称总数据或总计算更省；冻结 prior 也会继承教师失败并限制适配。

docs.title: 为什么值得读／真实新意
docs.text:
它把“动作先验”做成可复用生成解码器，并且跨任务、跨两只机械臂共享，方法上比单纯扩充 VLA 数据更有启发。应把它理解为把成本前置到 privileged RL，而不是无成本的数据效率提升。

docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 02

docs.title: OopsieRecover
docs.text:
OopsieRecover: Learning Transferable VLA Corrections from Semantic Interventions

VLA 与策略学习

首发 2026-11-05，v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-07 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

作者项目页提供方法、仿真和真实机器人实验视频。原文与项目页未给出实现链接，当前未找到可核验的作者实现仓库。 （2026-11-07 核查）

核心方法｜VLA｜低层动作筛选＋运行时恢复｜桌面/场景操作

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can perform a wide range of robotic manipulation tasks, but often fail during deployment. Teaching them to recover from these failures requires substantial corrective data: existing approaches learn to recover from failures by directly associating corrective actions with the observations in which they were demonstrated. For instance, DAgger-like fine-tuning can require tens to hundreds of interactions, yet the resulting policy may still fail to generalize the learned corrections beyond the demonstrated scenarios. We hypothesize that semantics can capture the underlying reasons for failures and their corrections, enabling policies to learn from only a handful of corrective demonstrations and generalize those corrections to novel objects, and scene variations. We propose OopsieRecover, a framework that uses abduction to infer the intent behind a small set of corrective demonstrations and encodes the inferred knowledge as dense spatial representations and conditional costs. These costs capture when a behavior is undesirable and steer the policy toward more desirable action regions. We experiment across 6 tasks and variations in object poses, scenes, and related tasks, and find that only a handful of corrective demonstrations can enable a VLA to overcome failures across a broad range of novel situations, without requiring new corrective data for each variation. Please refer to https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/oopsierecover for videos.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 收集带语言描述的人类纠正，在跟踪的语义点集上合成和验证带触发条件的纠正成本，再据此对冻结 VLA 采样的动作排序。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 一句话贡献
docs.text: 把少量人类纠正“溯因”为语义条件成本，作用在落地的 3D 点集上，对冻结 VLA 采样出的动作块做情境化排序，而不是重新微调策略。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: 模拟 CoffeeMug 中 8 次纠正达到 84% 成功率，HG-DAgger* 用约 3 倍纠正仅 28%；单一纠正在 10 个新场景、100 步测试中实现 100% 的目标失败阻止。真实 DROID 上 3 个任务、每设置 20 次 rollout，3–6 条语义纠正/任务，阶段进度相对 HG-DAgger 至少提高 60%，但有一档与原始 π0.5 持平。

docs.title: 真实新意
docs.text: 学习的是可迁移的“失败原因/禁区”，不是把纠正动作硬绑定到观测。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 目前只表达空间点集约束，难覆盖力、摩擦和不可见状态；若候选动作块里没有好动作，排序器无法恢复；部分真实结果报告的是阶段进度而非整任务成功率，样本量也较小。

docs.title: 为什么值得读
docs.text:
给 VLA 失败恢复提供了比再收大量纠正数据更轻量、可解释的接口。

docs.title: On Agentic Manipulation Policies
docs.text:
On Agentic Manipulation Policies

智能体与程序学习

首发 2026-11-06，v1；补收  ·  收录于 2026-11-12 日报

补充原文编号 1

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

作者项目页与 AMP1 公开实现已核验。仓库包含 RoboLab-120、CaP-Gym 的 LIBERO-PRO、robosuite、BEHAVIOR-1K 以及 RoboDojo 的评测入口，外部仿真环境与资产需另行准备。 （2026-11-13 核查）

大系统＋接口｜Agent/agentic coding｜规划、观测、验证与恢复｜桌面操作真机；移动/双臂操作仿真。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Recent work on robot manipulation has focused on specialist policies trained on demonstrations. We show that generalist AI models can control manipulators more reliably than specialist policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs). We systematically analyze agentic manipulation policies (AMPs), in which a generalist AI model commands the manipulator directly, adapting its actions as the task unfolds. We present AMP1, a reference harness that runs unchanged across single-arm, bimanual, and mobile manipulation. AMP1 achieves state-of-the-art results on the RoboLab-120 and CaP-Gym benchmarks, with no demonstrations or task-specific training. On RoboLab-120, AMP1 reaches an 85.6\% success rate zero-shot, compared to 49.2\% and 42.9\% for leading VLA and WAM policies. The agent succeeds zero-shot in 104 of 108 real-world trials spanning twelve tasks and three robot instances, reducing failure rates by 20x and 15x relative to strong VLA and WAM baselines. The basic harness supplies no grasping, pushing, or placing skills; the agent develops its own strategies, such as searching for hidden objects, using objects as tools, and calibrating its cameras. With the addition of a persistent memory store, the agent can also learn from experience: an augmented harness with a memory representation that is carried across episodes lowers the failure rate on RoboDojo bimanual manipulation tasks by 4.6x relative to zero-shot deployment. Our analysis suggests that AMPs are substantially more general and robust than specialist manipulation policies, providing a promising foundation for robot manipulation.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 通用模型在持久 Python 解释器中编写和运行控制代码，通过感知、观测与运动接口操控机器人，可在跨回合记忆中积累经验。图源：作者论文 · Figure 6 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 核心贡献
docs.text: AMP1 让通用模型持续编写、运行和修订 Python 程序，通过感知、场景建模及末端轨迹接口直接控制机器人，而非仅选择预设抓放技能或一次性离线写程序。

docs.title: 关键实验
docs.text: RoboLab-120 零样本成功率85.6%，VLA/WAM基线49.2%/42.9%；CaP-Gym 两项 BEHAVIOR-1K 移动操作为96%（共50回合）。真机为12任务×9次，共104/108；π0.5为30/108，FLUX 3 Action为49/108。RoboDojo任务练习后未见布局成功率26.4%→84.1%；连续记忆单遍为57.6%。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 真实平台为三台同配置 Franka 单臂，不是真机移动或双臂。AMP1可从碰撞控制错误恢复，基线遇此即终止；关闭恢复后 AMP1 为94/108。每任务仅9次；5分钟执行预算不含模型推理时间；真机 π0.5 与其他方法的相机视角也不完全相同。RoboDojo提供任务 recipe 与评分 rubric，应防止将该设置当成无判据泄露的通用评测。

docs.title: 推荐
docs.text:
最值得看 agentic 机器人如何让程序、几何感知与失败恢复构成在线闭环；新意是系统接口与运行时策略，不是新的低层控制器。

docs.text:
ReSkill: Selective Self-Improvement for Robot Manipulation

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能

首发 11月7日 UTC  ·  收录于 2026-11-12 日报

补充原文编号 1 · 11月10日公布批次｜已发7篇，本次新增3篇

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

截至核查，原文未给出作者项目或实现仓库入口，检索亦未找到可确认的作者发布链接。 （2026-11-19 核查）

核心方法＋系统｜Agent/agentic coding｜技能、规划、验证/恢复｜桌面操作，仿真＋真机。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Self-improvement on compositional manipulation tasks requires deciding what to reuse, where to improve, and which changes to retain. We present ReSkill, a selective self-improvement framework that concentrates revision on capability gaps. A coding agent constructs an object-centric task graph from an instruction and a skill library, then uses node-level execution records to locate failures. At the task level, it revises stage organization, hand-off conditions, and recovery routes; at the skill level, it strengthens perception, motion, manipulation, and verification capabilities that repeatedly fail. Candidate revisions undergo full-task evaluation and paired comparisons before adoption, allowing local changes to accumulate into validated skills and an independently executable policy. The agent participates only during development; the deployed policy calls the retained skills without invoking the agent at run time. On the same development set, average success across ten RoboDojo tasks rises from 30.0% for the initial versions to 86.2% for the final adopted programs; retained programs achieve 83.6% in recorded robustness and model-selection evaluations. Across eight real-world tasks, ReSkill succeeds in 72 of 80 rebuilt-simulation trials and 62 of 80 real-robot trials (77.5%). The median revision changes only three functions, approximately 0.5% of a program, while 39% of task-specific functions in later-added tasks directly reuse existing implementations. These results show how locating local deficiencies, validating candidate changes, and accumulating reusable skills can improve execution of compositional manipulation tasks.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

原归档未标版本，摘要采用 v1。

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 从指令和技能库构建任务图，通过节点执行证据定位缺口，分别修订任务图与技能实现。候选版本经过整任务评估和配对比较后保留，形成可独立执行的策略及更新后的技能库。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 贡献
docs.text: 编码 agent 根据节点级失败修订任务图和技能，经过整任务回归评测后保留版本；部署时不再调用大模型。

docs.title: 实验
docs.text: RoboDojo 10任务的开发集平均成功率30.0%→86.2%；已记录的鲁棒性/模型选择评估为83.6%。8个真实任务各10次，Xtrainer真机62/80，重建仿真72/80。论文列出的Agent-as-Policy 36%和π0.5 9.6%采用不同协议，仅供参考。

docs.title: 局限及阅读理由
docs.text:
83.6%并非完全独立未参与模型选择的测试；真机每任务10次且初始状态固定。值得看局部能力缺口定位与整任务回归如何防止自改进破坏原有技能。

docs.text:
Zero-Shot VLA Adaptation with Retrieved Guidance（RAGu）

VLA 与策略学习

首发 2026-11-07 UTC，v1；近7天漏选补收  ·  收录于 2026-11-13 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

核心方法＋推理模块｜VLA/模仿学习｜低层策略、检索与动作引导｜固定臂桌面真机＋仿真。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Pre-training large parametric "Vision-Language-Action" (VLA) models on large demonstration datasets has recently yielded promising results for general-purpose manipulation. However, these models still struggle under even small domain shifts relative to the training data, such as changes in camera viewpoint, background, object identity, or robot morphology. Motivated by the success of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) in language models, we pursue retrieval to boost VLA performance. Specifically, we seek to leverage retrieval from domain-mismatched, "in-the-wild" demonstration datasets like DROID to guide a VLA's behavior in a new target domain. To achieve this, we introduce RAGu, which overcomes robotics-specific challenges for RAG: (1) It incorporates simple geometric calibration to transform source demonstrations into the target setup and reduce cross-domain differences. (2) It uses a coarse-to-fine retrieval strategy that selects, from a large pool of pre-warped candidates, the trajectory most compatible with the base VLA. (3) It guides the VLA's flow-matching inference procedure rather than seeking to retrain the base model or expand its limited context window. We evaluate RAGu across real-world, simulation, sim-to-real transfer, and cross-embodiment humanoid manipulation. We find it improves real-world VLA success rates from 20% to 80% and outperforms the closest-related baselines in sim. Project website: raguvla.github.io

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 按语义筛选示范，通过关键点变换和轨迹检索获得参考轨迹，再用轨迹能量引导冻结 VLA 的动作去噪。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 贡献
docs.text: 将跨域示范按语义关键点变换后检索，以轨迹能量引导冻结VLA的动作去噪，不改模型权重或上下文长度。

docs.title: 实验
docs.text: Franka/DROID 5项真实任务、每项10次，平均任务成功率80%，无引导π0.5为20%，稀疏目标引导Omniguide为40%；RoboLab real-to-sim的三项表格平均为25.33%，π0.5为5.33%、VLS为12%。GR-1人形RoboCasa的五项桌面任务用100条检索轨迹从33.6%升至47.2%，但这是仿真人形而非真实移动操作。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text:

docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 08

docs.title: ForeAct
docs.text:
ForeAct: Geometry-Guided Action Learning from World Representations

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM

首发 2026-11-08，v1，七日窗口补收  ·  收录于 2026-11-12 日报

补充原文编号 8

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

作者仓库已提供模型、训练、部署和基准评测代码，并给出独立托管的检查点入口。 （2026-11-13 核查）

核心方法｜WM/WAM＋策略学习｜低层控制｜单臂桌面，仿真＋真机。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Robotic manipulation requires representations that capture both scene geometry and its evolution during interaction. Existing approaches have largely treated these two aspects separately. World action models capture such dynamics by coupling action prediction with future video generation, but their reliance on iterative diffusion or rectified-flow inference leads to high computational cost, while their representations lack explicit spatial structure. Explicitly modeling scene geometry typically requires auxiliary modules that increase both parameter count and computational cost. Conversely, geometry-centric policies primarily recover observed spatial structure and often lack explicit supervision for anticipating future geometric changes during interaction. To address these limitations, we introduce ForeAct, which repurposes a pretrained video world model as a single-pass representation backbone for low-latency control. ForeAct directly processes the clean latent of the current observation in one forward pass, eliminating future-frame synthesis and iterative denoising while retaining the backbone's pretrained spatiotemporal priors. Rather than introducing a separate geometry backbone, ForeAct uses learnable tokens supervised by next-frame relative depth to shape the shared video representation through bidirectional self-attention. This compact interface turns the spatial knowledge already encoded in the backbone into a future-aware representation for action generation, with little parameter overhead. The lightweight geometry readout is used only during training and removed at deployment, enabling low-latency, geometry-aware control without depth input or an external geometry backbone. Without additional large-scale pretraining, ForeAct achieves 96.6% average success on LIBERO, 63.5% on SimplerEnv-Bridge, and a 74.4% success rate across 90 real-world rollouts.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法架构
docs.text: 当前图像、语言和可学习几何 token 经世界模型单次前向，视觉特征供 Action DiT 预测动作。未来相对深度提供训练监督，推理时移除深度读出分支。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 贡献
docs.text: 把预训练视频世界模型作为单次前向策略骨干，以下一帧相对深度监督少量几何 token；部署时不生成未来视频、不需深度输入。

docs.title: 实验
docs.text: 六项 Franka 真机任务每项15次，成功67/90（74.4%），FastWAM为58/90（64.4%）、π0为52/90（57.8%）。LIBERO平均96.6%；单H20、batch 1从观测编码到动作块生成168 ms。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 每项真实任务仅15次；几何监督依赖训练期深度教师，真实结论仅限所测六项。它不在推理时生成世界，因此不应把结果描述成闭环想象规划的增益。

docs.title: 推荐
docs.text:
与完整生成式WAM形成有价值对照：世界模型先验可用于控制，但推理未必需要生成未来帧。

docs.text:
Streaming Failure Forecasting: VLA Failure Monitors That Keep Learning After Deployment

VLA 与策略学习

首发 2026-11-08 UTC，v1；近7天漏选补收  ·  收录于 2026-11-13 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Failure monitors for vision-language-action (VLA) policies are trained offline and then frozen. After deployment, lighting, objects and cameras drift, and the policy itself is updated or moved to new tasks. On recorded real-robot runs, after a switch of task or policy version, a frozen monitor fit on the old task ranks failures little better than chance. We present Streaming Failure Forecasting (SFF), a monitor that keeps learning from the one label every episode provides: whether it succeeded. SFF keeps the offline monitor's network fixed and refits only its last linear layer after each episode, at 2.18 ms per policy call on a Jetson CPU core. Its alarm threshold moves only after successes, which in simulation kept false alarms near target except when two drifts came at once. With every setting locked before testing, SFF ranks failures better than the same monitor kept frozen on 4 of 5 simulated test suites under unannounced drift, and above resetting on detected drift on every suite. Carried with its locked learner settings to 434 recorded runs of four VLAs on real SO-101 arms, replayed across unannounced switches of task or policy version, it ranks failures better than the frozen monitor for every VLA and, in an exploratory comparison, above a full reset at the true switch. A deployed failure monitor need not stay frozen: refitting its readout from outcomes is cheap and helps after the changes we tested.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 系统概览
docs.text: 监控器使用每回合结果更新线性读出层，以适应策略或任务切换。图中并列展示真实记录回放结果与持续学习闭环。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 贡献
docs.text: 每个回合结束后仅利用成功/失败标签更新监控器线性读出层，阈值只在成功回合更新，以适应任务或策略变更。

docs.title: 实验
docs.text: 四种VLA、真实SO-101采集的434条操作记录，按任务/策略切换顺序离线回放；等权汇总的within-task AUROC由冻结监控器0.536升至0.656，π0.5子项为0.552→0.616；Jetson CPU每策略调用约2.18 ms。五个仿真测试套件有四个优于冻结方案，第五个0.663→0.656。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text:
真实结果是已有轨迹回放，并未证明在线干预让真实机器人任务成功率提高；每回合要有结果标签，联合漂移时误报控制失效；四模型汇总是事后描述统计。为什么读：与静态VLA失败检测相比，它直接研究部署后策略/任务改变时监控器如何低成本持续适应，并报告失败案例。

docs.text:
PAIR: Proprioception-Aligned Image-Ray Representations for Viewpoint-Robust Manipulation

VLA 与策略学习

首发 11月9日 UTC  ·  收录于 2026-11-12 日报

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

While imitation learning has made substantial progress toward generalizable robot manipulation through scaling, viewpoint robustness remains a major bottleneck. Visuomotor policies rely heavily on visual inputs, yet images provide an inherently ambiguous signal under viewpoint change: similar scenes may appear markedly different across viewpoints, while distinct states may share certain visual overlaps. A policy must therefore infer not only the task-relevant state, but also how it is visually projected under a particular camera configuration. This entanglement of viewpoint-dependent appearance and task-relevant state can make learning inefficient and limit generalization to unseen viewpoints. Recent work has begun to address this challenge through camera-ray conditioning and representation learning using geometric cues to induce invariance. However, providing camera information as additional context does not by itself ground visual representations in how the task scene is visually projected, while geometric alignment without camera context can introduce spurious correspondences by ignoring viewpoint-dependent projection. We propose PAIR, a contrastive learning framework that aligns joint image-ray representations using robot proprioception. PAIR encourages observations with similar robot states to remain close in representation space across viewpoints, providing a structured grounding signal for learning viewpoint-robust features. PAIR is a highly adaptable framework: it can be used to train Diffusion Policy (DP) or post-train vision-language-action (VLA) models. In simulated and real-world manipulation benchmarks with camera variation, PAIR consistently outperforms the behavior cloning baseline without ray conditioning by 12.7% and 26.7% points, respectively, demonstrating stronger generalization to unseen viewpoints. Project website: PAIRrobot.github.io.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

原归档未标版本，摘要采用 v1。

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 将末端执行器和机器人基座坐标系中的相机射线编码后注入视觉 token，再根据本体状态相似度对齐图像—射线联合表征，以约束跨视角特征。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 实验

DASH: Latency-Agnostic Scaling of Vision-Language-Action Models for Humanoid Manipulation
