docs.title: InteractVLA
docs.text:
InteractVLA: Turning VLAs into Interactive Tools for Agentic Robotic Manipulation

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能

首发 2026-11-17，v1。  ·  收录于 2026-11-19 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

作者项目与仓库已提供核心运行时、PyTorch/JAX 几何引导、模型适配和评测集成入口；模型、资产与对应基准环境需另行准备，本次未运行复现实验。 （2026-11-19 核查）

核心方法／VLA、Agent／技能规划、动作验证和低层引导／双臂桌面操作。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Existing agentic manipulation systems treat pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies as opaque, language-only primitives: when a policy call fails under unfamiliar instructions or scene perturbations, the agent cannot steer its behavior and is forced into futile retries or costly manual takeover. We present InteractVLA, a framework that turns pretrained flow-based VLAs into geometrically steerable and inspectable tools through a bidirectional geometric interface with vision-language agents. In the forward direction, test-time geometric guidance translates an agent-specified end-effector target into input gradients through the action expert via a differentiable command-to-pose mapping, while soft-time target alignment treats arrival time as a latent execution index to match the target pose without distorting the policy's approach motion. In the reverse direction, action-informed agentic refinement exposes generated action chunks and calibrated camera reprojections back to the agent, allowing it to diagnose spatial discrepancies, revise targets for subsequent VLA calls, or locally adjust motion segments on top of the guided trajectory. Making the VLA controllable not only boosts online agentic tool use, but also unlocks effective recursive self-improvement (RSI), achieving state-of-the-art performance of 99.4\% on LIBERO-Plus, 48.62\% on RoboDojo, and 89.4\% on RoboCasa365. Project page: https://lingwupro.github.io/InteractVLA/.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 测试时按末端目标和时间对齐引导动作生成，并将动作轨迹反馈给 agent 以检查、修正或重新规划。图源：作者论文 · Figure 3 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 贡献
docs.text: 通过测试时可微几何引导让 agent 可指定末端目标，并将动作轨迹和投影反馈给 agent 以修正后续执行；创新是 VLA 与 agent 的双向接口，不是重新训练基础 VLA。

docs.title: 实验
docs.text: Dexmal 真机四任务，每任务每方法 30 次、各任务 50 条示范训练同一 MR-0 骨干；相对语言接口 agent + VLA，桌面整理 task score 65.5→92.5、倒水 38.5→79.2；移动方块任务执行时间 165.2→67.5 秒。另评测 LIBERO-Plus、RoboDojo 和 RoboCasa365。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 真机表格报告的是任务得分，不能直接称整任务成功率；依赖末端几何目标、相机标定和测试时梯度，额外计算与定位误差值得关注；与独立 VLA 相比 agent 工作流并非每个任务都更快。

docs.title: VSpark
docs.text:
VSpark: Speculative Decoding for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models

VLA 与策略学习

首发 2026-11-17，v1。  ·  收录于 2026-11-19 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

作者仓库已提供草稿训练、推理及评测入口，并列出独立托管的草稿检查点；目标模型、动作分词器和仿真数据需另行获取，本次未运行复现实验。 （2026-11-19 核查）

模块／VLA／低层推理加速／仿真桌面操作。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Our aim is to accelerate autoregressive vision-language-action models (VLAs), which generate robot actions one token at a time. Speculative decoding makes this possible: a lightweight draft model proposes several tokens at once, and the VLA verifies them in a single pass, accepting only those that match its own predictions, so decoding remains lossless. The speedup, however, is limited in robot control, where many different tokens encode nearly the same motion and a draft close to the correct action is still rejected. To address this, our approach, VSpark, is built upon three design choices: (i) rollouts collected with calibrated action noise, which expose the draft to a wider range of robot states; (ii) feature alignment, which trains the draft to match the VLA's hidden features rather than its output tokens alone; and (iii) continuation reuse, which keeps the predictions the VLA has already computed along rejected drafts as candidates for the next verification step, instead of discarding them. On four VLAs with different action tokenizers and four manipulation benchmarks, VSpark achieves 1.28x to 2.10x speedup while keeping the VLA's decoding lossless.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 训练时用带动作噪声的 rollout 与特征对齐训练草稿，推理时复用被拒分支的后续候选并严格验证。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 贡献
docs.text: 对自回归 VLA 结合噪声 rollout、特征对齐和被拒绝分支的后续候选复用，同时保持逐 token 精确验证，不以动作近似牺牲输出一致性。

docs.title: 实验
docs.text: 单张 RTX 4090，LIBERO 四套任务上 π0-FAST 平均加速 1.93×，对照 DSpark 1.60×；ActionCodec 2.10×，DSpark 1.93×。还覆盖 LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro 和 SimplerEnv。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 论文的加速为指定贪心解码和精确验证条件下的推理加速，并非机器人整任务速度保证；生成错误 episode 和超 token 上限的块被排除，噪声 rollout 的无仿真真机采集尚待研究。

docs.title: Fly as Instructed
docs.text:
Fly as Instructed: Refining World-Action Policies for UAV Vision-Language Navigation

世界模型与 WAMVLN · 视觉语言导航

首发 2026-11-17，v1。  ·  收录于 2026-11-19 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

未在已核验的 v1 摘要与正文中找到作者项目主页或实现仓库入口。 （2026-11-22 核查）

核心方法／VLN、WM/WAM／低层导航、进度与停止／无人机 VLN 纯导航。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Natural language-guided UAV navigation enables intuitive human-robot interaction and flexible autonomous flight in complex environments. However, reliable navigation requires accurate instruction following, continuous task progress tracking, and safe obstacle avoidance, which remain challenging for existing world-action models that primarily focus on action prediction. To address these limitations, we propose a world-action learning framework that integrates three complementary mechanisms: a language-conditioned action interface with targeted post-training for instruction-responsive motion, recurrent instruction-consumption prediction to track task progress and determine termination, and Gaussian-scene post-training to enhance obstacle avoidance through trajectory imitation and differentiable geometric feedback. Closed-loop evaluations and ablation studies demonstrate improvements in sequential task completion, safe goal reaching, and timely termination. Furthermore, direct one-step denoising reduces inference overhead, and real-world indoor and outdoor flights validate the framework's effectiveness.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 动作专家读取视觉历史、完整指令和载体状态，以进度预测引导指令注意力与停止，并通过 Gaussian 场景进行安全适配。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 贡献
docs.text: 把语言条件动作后训练、指令消耗进度预测与 Gaussian 场景避障适配结合，改进连续飞行中的指令次序与停止。

docs.title: 实验
docs.text: 521 个闭环仿真 episode（一般任务、避障和进度子集），系统到达 SR 83.7%、正确停止 SR 77.0%、nDTW 0.648、无碰撞到达 SFR 76.6%；WorldVLN 分别为 45.3%、31.5%、0.448、30.3%。六项真实飞行任务每项记录一次。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 完整系统同时增加进度与安全模块，基线保留各自接口；真机每任务只有一次演示，不能当统计成功率。到达、正确停止、无碰撞到达是不同指标，SFR 不是单纯无碰撞率。

BiCAT: Bimanual Coordination Action Tokenization

首发 2026-11-17，v1。  ·  收录于 2026-11-20 日报

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) models predict discrete action tokens with the next-token objective of their vision-language backbone, so the action tokenizer defines the interface between the policy and the robot. In bimanual manipulation, the two arms share a repertoire of movements yet coordinate through complementary roles, and an action representation should capture both. However, most existing tokenizers encode both arms as a single concatenated action vector, in which motion patterns common to the two arms are not shared and cross-arm dependencies remain entangled within each token. The policy must therefore learn both aspects implicitly. We propose Bimanual Coordination Action Tokenization (BiCAT), which shares one motion representation across arms while conditioning each arm's tokens on its partner through symmetric cross-arm attention and a joint decoder. The policy then predicts all tokens of each arm in parallel, generating the left arm first and the right arm conditioned on it. Across ten RoboTwin 2.0 tasks and six real-world tasks on three embodiments, BiCAT achieves the highest success among the compared tokenizers. In simulation, it improves mean success by 17.6 percentage points over the strongest of eight baselines, with the largest gains on tasks that require close coordination between the arms, while requiring only 40.5 ms per action chunk. These results suggest that the action tokenizer is a natural place to model bimanual coordination.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.text: 为两臂共享动作词汇，并通过跨臂注意力与联合解码编码协作，再按左臂、右臂两块预测；新意在动作 token 化本身，不是上层规划接口。

RageVLA: Augmentation-Trained Perception and Action for State-of-the-Art Robustness on LIBERO

VLA 与策略学习

首发 2026-11-17，v1。  ·  收录于 2026-11-20 日报

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-language-action (VLA) models look saturated on LIBERO, yet most of them fall apart on LIBERO-PRO as soon as an object moves or the instruction asks for something new. We argue that what is missing is not scale but decoupling. In these policies, what to do is tied to where things were during training, to the scene around them and to the wording of the instruction. We cut these ties in two places. In the data, LIBERO demonstrations are re-arranged by general rules: every object and fixture is moved and rotated, tasks are carried into other environments and onto other surfaces, and every instruction is paraphrased. In the policy, a perception engine on frozen DINOv3 features, trained on this augmented data, hands the action model the scene in decoupled form: a list of objects with their positions, and a compact code of what the gripper is looking at, next to image and instruction embeddings from TinyCLIP. A flow-matching diffusion transformer, trained from scratch, acts on this view. We call this combination of Robust Augmentation and Grounded Encoding RageVLA. With 0.21 billion parameters, RageVLA sets a new state of the art on LIBERO-PRO among VLA policies, scoring 0.72 against 0.53 for the best published model, and a larger variant reaches 0.73. Two further tests on LIBERO-Object show that the policy acts on what it perceives. When the object positions it is given are shuffled while the camera images stay correct, its success falls from 0.965 to 0.215. When the target object is displaced by 28 cm, it still succeeds in 0.865 of the episodes, where $π_{0.5}$, run through the same harness, succeeds in 0.105.

Improve How You Improve: Recursive Policy Self-Improvement for Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Navigation（RPSI-Nav）

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能VLN · 视觉语言导航

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

To advance the development of embodied general navigation, zero-shot open-vocabulary multi-object navigation has attracted increasing attention, aiming to enable robots to efficiently search multiple objects in unseen environments without training. For this task, the key lies in improving navigation policies from earlier searches to locate subsequent goals more efficiently. Recent methods automate this process through trajectory reflection and rule revision, enabling policy self-improvement. However, the mechanisms for diagnosing problems and generating revisions are typically designed by humans and remain fixed across iterations. Consequently, the system's capacity for continued self-improvement remains constrained, even as its navigation policy evolves. To this end, we propose RPSI-Nav, a Recursive Policy Self-Improvement framework for zero-shot multi-object navigation that revises both the navigation program and its revision mechanism. RPSI-Nav diagnoses search behavior, requests diagnostic views when existing observations cannot distinguish competing causes, and generates targeted navigation revisions. Feedback from subsequent goal searches is linked to the rules that produced these revisions, guiding changes to diagnosis, observation acquisition, and revision planning. The updated improver governs subsequent navigation improvements, forming a recursive loop in which RPSI-Nav revises its own improvement process. Across goals, the robot conditionally inherits accepted program updates and spatial memory, enabling search experience to improve both future navigation and adaptation. Benchmark experiments and qualitative real-robot evaluations validate RPSI-Nav's effectiveness.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

CoT-WAM: Collaborative Training of Vision-Language Models and World-Action Models via Plan Latents

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

General robot manipulation requires both semantic competence and physical foresight. World action models (WAMs) acquire an understanding of and predictive capability over the physical world by jointly modeling visual foresight and action distributions. However, existing WAMs still lack semantic competence: they have limited ability to perform open-world scene understanding, semantic reasoning, and long-horizon planning. Although vision-language models (VLMs) provide these capabilities, effectively integrating their semantic priors into WAM prediction and control remains challenging. To address this challenge, we propose CoT-WAM, a jointly trained WAM-VLM framework. CoT-WAM uses a learnable embedding to exchange information between the VLM and the WAM, which is supervised by textual and goal-image signals during training to encode rich intent information. A tailored two-stage training strategy enables joint optimization and more effective collaboration between the VLM and WAM. We evaluate CoT-WAM on six benchmarks covering control performance, zero-shot generalization, and long-horizon planning. CoT-WAM achieves SOTA performance on LIBERO, CALVIN, and RoboCasa-Kitchen, and demonstrates stronger zero-shot generalization on LIBERO-Plus and LIBERO-Pro without fine-tuning. On RoboCasa365, it further improves long-horizon planning over baselines with and without external planners. Real-world experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in practical deployments.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

RePlan-VLA: Progress-Aware Replanning for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Models

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习移动操作

首发 2026-11-18，v1。  ·  收录于 2026-11-20 日报

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet their performance often degrades on long-horizon tasks that require multiple interdependent manipulations. Instead of burdening the VLA policies with long-horizon reasoning, memory, action generation, progress tracking, and error recovery, we argue for leveraging their short-horizon manipulation capabilities within an execution-aware framework. To this end, we introduce \textnormal{\textbf{RePlan-VLA}}, a VLA-agnostic framework that translates a VLA's short-horizon capabilities into reliable long-horizon execution. RePlan-VLA explicitly monitors the robot's motion for progress evaluation, and adaptively revises the future plan based on observed outcomes. We preserve the underlying VLA policy entirely, requiring no additional fine-tuning. Experiments on RoboCasa365 and CALVIN benchmarks show an improvement of 21.9% and 10.4% in success rate over the next strongest baseline. We also validate our approach for real-world deployment on a Franka Research 3 robot.

docs.text:
Towards Pose-Robust Few-Shot Vision-Language-Action Models（WACO）

VLA 与策略学习

首发 2026-11-18，v1。  ·  收录于 2026-11-20 日报

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Fine-tuning a vision-language-action (VLA) model on a few dozen demonstrations is the standard way to put a manipulation policy on a robot, yet the resulting policy silently assumes that the camera and the robot base stay exactly where they were during data collection: a bumped tripod or a base re-docked a few centimetres away makes it reach for the wrong place. We show that both failures are one phenomenon, a change of the camera-to-base extrinsic that the policy has memorised, and that the robot carries everything needed to undo it. We introduce WACO, a world-anchored canonicalization framework for VLA models: the arm, placed by forward kinematics at the measured joint angles, serves as a metric calibration target, and the static scene serves as the world anchor that tells a moved camera from a moved robot. From a single RGB-D frame, WACO estimates both shifts without ground-truth extrinsics or extra data, canonicalises the image to the calibration viewpoint and the state, action and start pose to the calibration base frame, and fine-tunes the unmodified policy under the artefacts of its own estimator. We also introduce LIBERO-PoseShift, the first benchmark for RGB VLAs with graded camera, base and compound shifts. Across LIBERO-PoseShift, the LIBERO-Plus camera track and four real-world tasks on a UR5e robot, WACO consistently outperforms the standard few-shot recipe and prior viewpoint-robust methods, raising shifted success by 13.2 points in simulation and by 36.7 points on the real robot, recovering 90% of the simulation gap to a ground-truth oracle and 87% of the real-robot gap, and establishing a new state of the art among methods that use no perturbed training data, with no test-time calibration. Project page: https://peacelwh.github.io/WACO/.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

We introduce $Z$-sight, a unified robot foundation model that couples vision-language-action (VLA) and generative latent world modeling. Video-based world action models (WAMs) show the value of joint future-and-action generation for control, yet inherit the heavy cost of video generators. Recent latent-space policies avoid pixel generation, yet typically align intermediate features or rely on frozen target encoders, decoupling future prediction from the VLM's native feature space. $Z$-sight instead predicts the future directly in the visual token space in which its VLM perceives the present. Coupling a foresight expert and a continuous action expert with the VLM in a mixture-of-transformers, $Z$-sight jointly denoises future spatial tokens and actions at inference without pixel reconstruction or external encoders. Trained on human video and robot trajectories, $Z$-sight achieves 81.9% success on SIMPLE (+9.6 points over the strongest baseline) and 73.3% across six Unitree G1 tasks (+20.0 points) at 110 ms per chunk, while remaining competitive on tabletop benchmarks.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 在 VLM 的视觉表征空间内，未来预测专家与动作专家共同去噪；训练分为预训练、中训练和目标具身后训练。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 贡献
docs.text: 在 VLM 自身的视觉 token 空间，以 foresight expert 和 action expert 联合去噪未来潜变量及连续动作，不再生成像素视频；相较既有使用外部冻结目标编码器的路线，目标表征随视觉编码器共同演进。

docs.title: 实验
docs.text: Unitree G1 六项真实任务每项 10 次，整任务成功率 73.3%（44/60），Fast-WAM 为 53.3%；81.7% 是阶段进度，不是成功率。SIMPLE 的 12 项遥操作数据任务平均 81.9%，对照 Ψ0 为 72.3%；LIBERO 平均成功率 97.7%，Fast-WAM 为 97.6%。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 真实每任务仅 10 次，平台与场景有限；未来预测不以候选动作为条件，不能直接用它比较不同动作结果做规划；SIMPLE 的 81.9% 不是其全部 17 任务平均。

docs.text:
同时有潜在预测机制消融、真机和多平台比较，适合理解轻量世界模型是否能促进全身操作。

docs.title: MAWAM
docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 02

docs.title: MAWAM
docs.text:
MAWAM: A Multi-Agent World-Action Model for Coordinated Manipulation

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM

首发 2026-11-18，v1；  ·  收录于 2026-11-21 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

原论文给出的 NVIDIA staging 项目地址两次访问均出现 TLS 连接错误；已核验 NVIDIA 正式站的同名项目与作者名单。正式项目页将 Code 标为 soon，尚无可用实现入口。 （2026-11-22 核查）

核心方法；WM/WAM；低层策略学习；双机器人协作操作，不是移动操作。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Every move in a robot team changes the world in which its teammates must act. Coordinated manipulation therefore calls for predicting the team's actions together with the physical future they jointly create. We introduce MAWAM, a multi-agent world-action model that jointly generates each robot's future views and executable action chunks in a single sample. Built from a pretrained single-robot world-action backbone, MAWAM jointly denoises all robots' action and future-view tokens through cross-agent attention, while preserving a separate control interface for each robot. MAWAM achieves the highest success on all three real-robot tasks (laundry-bag collection, bath-towel folding, and umbrella handover), with 67.8% mean success, 18.9 percentage points above MA-VLA trained on the same demonstrations and cameras. In simulation, MAWAM reaches 90.3% mean success on eight tasks with teams of up to four arms. Ablations show that cross-agent attention and team-stage future-video supervision both improve coordinated control: without attention, a four-arm relay falls from 95.0% to 39.0%, and without this supervision, Place Food falls from 78.0% to 47.0%.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 单机器人预热后进行团队训练，以跨机器人注意力联合预测未来视图与动作；联合采样后同步执行前 8 步并重新规划。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 贡献
docs.text: 通过跨 agent 注意力联合生成各机器人未来视图和动作，分别保持控制输出；创新在多机器人预测与动作联合建模，而非上层任务分派。

docs.title: 实验
docs.text: 两台 Galaxea R1 Pro 协作收衣、折毛巾、递伞，每任务 30 次；平均整任务成功率 67.8%，相同示教和相机条件下 MA-VLA 为 48.9%，去掉跨 agent 注意力降至 52.2%。仿真八项任务、最多四臂平均 90.3%。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 机器人团队固定，跨形态和动态增减成员尚未验证；真机只有三个任务；两臂与四臂延迟报告依赖具体相机数、硬件和采样设置。

docs.text:

docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 04

docs.title: GEMS
docs.text:
GEMS: Generation and Experience Memory for Subgoal-Guided Long-Horizon World Model Planning

世界模型与 WAM记忆与技能

首发 2026-11-18，v1；  ·  收录于 2026-11-22 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

本次未在已核验的 arXiv v1 摘要、正文及作者资源检索中找到可确认的项目主页或实现仓库入口。 （2026-11-22 核查）

核心方法／规划模块；WM；技能／子目标规划与经验记忆；桌面操作仿真及抽象导航仿真，非 VLN。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Visual world models enable effective short-horizon goal-conditioned planning, such as reaching nearby targets and pushing objects over short distances, by predicting candidate action outcomes and comparing their representations with a goal representation. However, extending this approach to long-horizon tasks is challenging: prediction errors accumulate over extended rollouts, while latent-space similarity to distant goals provides limited guidance for ranking candidate outcomes. Existing methods address these limitations by introducing intermediate subgoals, either generated by learned models or selected from experience memory. Generated subgoals can contain hallucinations or be inaccurate in aspects such as object positions and timing. Memory-based approaches are constrained by experience coverage and may lack precise guidance for selecting appropriate intermediate states from stored observations. We introduce GEMS, which generates temporally structured subgoals to guide action search and state selection from Latent Experience Memory (LEM). A distance gate determines whether predicted outcomes are evaluated against the generated subgoal or the selected memory state. Experiments across six tasks and task suites spanning manipulation, navigation, and reaching demonstrate the effectiveness of GEMS for long-horizon planning. GEMS outperforms state-of-the-art world-model planning baselines across different manipulation settings, achieving success rates of 92.8% on Cube, 68.4% on Push-T, and 54.1% on Meta-World. It improves over the strongest evaluated baseline on these tasks by 24.0, 7.3, and 22.2 percentage points, respectively. These results demonstrate that generated subgoals and experience memory can jointly strengthen long-horizon planning with a frozen world model.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 生成时间相关子目标，通过距离门控选择生成目标或经验记忆中的真实状态；冻结世界模型与 CEM 规划动作，执行后重新规划。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 贡献
docs.text: 把生成的时序子目标与潜在经验记忆结合，用距离门控选择规划时参照的目标；相较只生成或只检索子目标，尝试兼顾生成灵活性和经验约束。

docs.title: 实验
docs.text: 闭环仿真 Cube 成功率 92.8%、Push-T 68.4%、Meta-World 54.1%，SAGE 分别为 68.8%、61.1%、31.9%；最难 Cube-double 为 17.7%，并非全部任务都接近饱和。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 结果为仿真而非真机，经验库覆盖、目标视角及规划预算影响结果；论文表中 H-JEPA 基线标记使用包含测试轨迹的发布权重，不能忽视该评测边界。

docs.text:

docs.title: Verify2Act
docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 04

docs.title: Verify2Act
docs.text:
Verify2Act: Critic-Guided Latent World Models for Verifying Language-Conditioned Manipulation Plans

世界模型与 WAM智能体与程序学习

首发 2026-11-18，v1；  ·  收录于 2026-11-21 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

本次未在已核验的 arXiv v1 摘要、正文及作者资源检索中找到可确认的项目主页或实现仓库入口。原图带透明背景，页面以白底呈现完整原图。 （2026-11-22 核查）

核心方法／系统；WM、Agent；规划与验证；固定机械臂桌面操作。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can propose multi-step manipulation plans, but they have no grounded model of how a scene will change, and the pixel-level world models that could check those plans are slow and drift over long horizons. We present Verify2Act, a modular verification framework that separates semantic action proposal from latent physical verification. A VLM proposes candidate plans, a latent world model (V2A-WM) imagines each of them in the DINOv2 feature space, and a dual-head critic checks the imagined rollouts for temporal consistency and goal satisfaction before anything is executed. V2A-WM extends recent flow-matching world models with cross-attention action grounding and a causal temporal history window. We deploy the full system on a low-cost robot arm, training the world model and critic only on data generated in a digital twin. Across six language-conditioned tasks, Verify2Act reaches 83.3\% task success, compared with 61.7\% for a latent world model without our architectural changes, 53.3\% for the VLM alone, and 46.7\% for a pixel-diffusion world model. It verified every plan it executed and incurred no planning-induced failures: all of its failed episodes were caused by low-level grasp or placement slips. In simulation, Verify2Act obtains the highest five-task chain success on CALVIN among the compared baselines with 30$\times$ fewer reflective VLM calls than pixel-diffusion verification, and the highest success on cluttered nut assembly.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: VLM 提议候选计划，潜在世界模型预测后续状态；目标满足与时间一致性双头 critic 评分后，选择要执行的计划。图源：作者论文 · Fig. 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 贡献
docs.text: VLM 提议候选计划，潜在世界模型预测动作后的状态，双头 critic 评估时间一致性与目标满足，再挑选要执行的方案。

docs.title: 实验
docs.text: Yahboom DOFBOT 六类积木任务各 10 次，整任务成功 50/60（83.3%），较弱 latent-WM 为 61.7%、VLM 单独为 53.3%；任务由操作者判定。论文报告真实场景前离线数字孪生建模，并对输入执行基于颜色掩码的场景／相机拟合。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 真机任务仅积木及三类预设技能；最多三候选、每计划三样本、最多两次重规划，预算耗尽未验证计划仍可能执行，故不是安全保证；样本小且对齐耗时。

docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 01

docs.title: WEVO
docs.text:
WEVO: World Model-Enabled VLA Optimization for Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM移动操作

首发 2026-11-18，v1；  ·  收录于 2026-11-21 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

作者项目主页已核验；Code 标为 coming soon，当前尚无可核验的实现仓库入口。 （2026-11-22 核查）

核心方法／系统；VLA、WM；低层策略学习；人形移动操作。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Reinforcement learning (RL) can improve vision-language-action (VLA) policies beyond imitation, but humanoid exploration is unsafe and simulator RL can exploit residual sim-to-real gaps. We present WEVO, a teleoperation-free framework for post-training a whole-body humanoid VLA in an action-conditioned video world model (WM). Simulated manipulation and locomotion play data improve contact-dynamics and viewpoint-change prediction. A VLA trained on synthetic demonstrations collects 20 autonomous real robot rollouts per task to align the WM with deployment observations. The VLA, whole-body controller (WBC), and video WM then form a closed-loop RL environment with dense progress rewards. Across three real robot tasks, play data improves every evaluated WM metric and downstream policy success; video WM RL raises mean success from 23.3% to 75.0%, compared with 48.3% for real robot RL. We therefore leverage the complementary strengths of both environments: simulation provides policy initialization and broad coverage, while the video WM offers a deployment-aligned environment for policy improvement. Project website: https://qianzhong-chen.github.io/wevo.github.io/.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 仿真示范与 play 数据支持策略初始化和世界模型训练；自主真机轨迹对齐世界模型后，利用稠密进度奖励优化全身 VLA。图源：作者论文 · Fig. 3 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 贡献
docs.text: 以仿真数据初始化全身 VLA，再用少量自主真机轨迹对齐视频世界模型，在生成轨迹上用稠密进度奖励强化学习；新意是用部署对齐的世界模型作为策略优化环境。

docs.title: 实验

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 不是零真机数据，每任务需 20 条自主轨迹对齐世界模型；每任务单次训练、评测样本有限，训练与生成计算昂贵，G1 专用接口限制跨形态迁移。

docs.text:

docs.title: Cognitive-Horizon Action Chunking
docs.text:
Cognitive-Horizon Action Chunking: Memory-Guided Adaptive Reasoning for Embodied Navigation（CHAC）

VLN · 视觉语言导航

首发 2026-11-19，v1；  ·  收录于 2026-11-21 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

作者仓库已核验，提供 CHAC 执行调度、R2R-CE 与 OVON 单轮评测入口及测试。运行仍需另配 OmniNav、Flow 检查点、Habitat 与场景数据，本次未运行复现实验。 （2026-11-21 核查）

模块／执行调度；VLN；规划、观测与停止验证；纯导航，无机械臂。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Multimodal foundation models are advancing embodied navigation, but frequent inference incurs substantial computational cost. We present Cognitive-Horizon Action Chunking (CHAC), a training-free framework for memory-guided adaptive reasoning with a frozen navigation policy. Retained visual context, completion cues, and controller feedback determine the cognitive horizon, or how many cached waypoints the robot executes before refreshing its prediction. At the policy's stop request, local visitation history guides a bounded correction with at most one extra movement and no additional model calls. CHAC reduces vision-language model calls by 33.4% on HM3D-OVON and 64.7% on R2R-CE, with success-rate decreases of 0.63 and 10.82 percentage points, respectively. Success rate and success weighted by path length improve per model call on both benchmarks. Across four physical navigation tasks with 40 runs per method, CHAC achieves 18 successes versus 14 for native execution, reducing model calls by 54.9% and GPU inference time by 49.7%.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 冻结导航策略预测航点；视觉变化与执行承诺边界决定缓存刷新，原生 STOP 时依据访问历史做有界终止位置修正。图源：作者论文 · Figure 1 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 贡献
docs.text: 冻结导航策略，根据视觉变化、执行反馈和访问历史动态决定缓存航点执行长度，并在 STOP 时做有界位置修正；这是推理调度与终止处理创新，不是重新训练导航模型。

docs.title: 实验
docs.text: R2R-CE 中，相对原始 OmniNav-Fast，VLM 调用减少 64.7%，但 SR 从 57.04% 降至 46.22%，SPL 从 49.30% 降至 34.17%；HM3D-OVON 调用减少 33.4%，SR 下降 0.63 个百分点。四项室内真机导航各 10 次，CHAC 18/40 成功，原策略 14/40。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 节省推理不等于提升导航成功或整体时延，R2R-CE 损失明显；真机采用标定运动估计、样本很小，STOP 修正依赖原策略发出停止请求。

docs.text:

docs.title: A²-VLA
docs.text: PAPER NOTE · 精选 03

docs.title: A²-VLA
docs.text:
A²-VLA: Adapting Vision-Language-Action Policies to New Tools through Agentic Affordance Discovery

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能

首发 2026-11-19，v1；  ·  收录于 2026-11-21 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

本次未在已核验的 arXiv v1 摘要、正文及作者资源检索中找到可确认的项目主页或实现仓库入口。 （2026-11-22 核查）

大系统／核心方法；VLA、Agent；技能发现、规划验证与低层策略；桌面双臂操作。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Tools with different shapes can have similar functions, but transferring manipulation skills across tools requires understanding how tool geometry relates to the specific task and adjusting the manipulation strategy accordingly. The key challenge is to discover the common affordances that contribute to task completion across different tools and verify whether they support new tools in performing similar work. We present A$^2$-VLA, a tool-adaptation framework that combines an embodied agent with a VLA policy. It treats tool affordances as hypotheses the agent can construct, test, and revise. Given teleoperated demonstrations with a few source tools, the agent reconstructs the scenes in simulation and autonomously determines task-relevant affordance features: functional regions and their key geometric properties. It develops affordance-extraction skills and refines both the features and skills through autonomous experiments in the reconstructed scenes. Validated extraction skills accumulate in a reusable skill library for unseen tools. Finally, A$^2$-VLA uses encoded functional-region features as conditioning inputs to a $π_{0.5}$ backbone during training and inference. Evaluation examines affordance reliability in reconstructed scenes and real-robot task success on unseen tools. Our method achieves 86.1% success in simulated cross-tool trajectory retargeting based on affordances. On three real-robot tool-use tasks, A$^2$-VLA improves task success by 30.7 percentage points over $π_{0.5}$.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: Agent 重建源工具场景，通过仿真测试修订可供性提取技能；编码的功能区域特征与图像、语言和机器人状态共同输入 VLA。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 贡献
docs.text: agent 将工具可供性作为可在重建仿真场景中检验和修订的假设，并把功能区域特征输入 π0.5，完成跨工具技能迁移。

docs.title: 实验
docs.text: Dobot Nova 2 双臂执行套环、切沙、摆盘；未见工具的整任务平均成功率 35.3%，普通 π0.5 为 4.7%、无仿真迭代为 22.0%、直接 agent 控制为 25.0%；VLA 每任务 50 次，agent 对照每任务 20 次。仿真重定向 86.1% 不是上述真机任务成功率。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 每个新工具允许运行仿真建模与测试，依赖源工具遥操作示教和 agent 推理预算；总体真机成功率仍不高，方法适用于可重定向的工具迁移。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies must react while visual inference is still running. Overlapping computation and execution reduces waiting, yet leaves perceptual memory stale and successive action chunks disconnected. We present CauSyncVLA, an asynchronous dual-system controller that aligns perceptual-memory prediction and trajectory correction with actual robot execution. Rather than forecasting pixels or physical states, a Causal Latent World Model predicts current perceptual memory from delayed visual anchors and executed state-action history, supervised through action-sensitive distillation to retain the frozen expert's control response. Conditioned on this updated memory, Predictive Flow Warm-Starting (PFWS) aligns the unexecuted action horizon for single-step flow correction without extra training. On LIBERO-10, CauSyncVLA reaches 93.8% success at 5.04$\times$ inference throughput, improving closed-loop robustness and robot motion smoothness.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 根据已执行的状态—动作历史更新延迟的 KV 记忆；对齐未执行动作块后，以冻结专家单步修正，并通过动作敏感蒸馏训练记忆预测器。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.text: 在视觉编码异步运行时，根据已执行状态和动作预测当前感知记忆，再用动作块对齐与单步 flow 修正减少陈旧观测及块边界误差；预测的是控制相关潜在记忆，不是未来视频。

docs.title: 实验
docs.text: LIBERO-10 成功率 93.8%，十步同步基线 91.2%，同 GPU 模型重规划容量提升 5.04 倍；Franka FR3 的叠杯及其他操作汇总成功率由 72.5% 至 87.0%，中位响应由 72 ms 以上降至 13.17 ms。

docs.title: 局限

docs.text:
Mind2Act World: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Mind, Physical Action, and Mind-Action Composition in Robotic Manipulation

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM智能体与程序学习记忆与技能

首发 2026-11-19 UTC · v1  ·  收录于 2026-11-20 手动补录

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

作者项目页和官方仓库已核验；仓库提供任务、评分与评测接口。Isaac Sim、资产快照及 Agent 运行时需按作者说明另行配置，本次未运行复现实验。配图从 v1 原 PDF 第 14 页完整提取，图号按 PDF 的 Figure 6 标注（HTML 对应 Figure 5）。 （2026-11-20 核查）

诊断基准；评测 VLA、WAM 与多模态 Agent；历史记忆、精细执行及二者的闭环组合；固定双臂桌面仿真操作。

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Embodied intelligence aims to let robots perform complex physical tasks with human-like adaptability and reliability, which requires three complementary capabilities: history-based cognitive reasoning, precise and timely physical execution, and the composition of reasoning and execution through environmental feedback. Yet existing benchmarks either evaluate reasoning and execution within the same tasks or assess them separately without their composition, so they reveal little about whether a failure comes from reasoning, execution, or their composition. We introduce Mind2Act World, a diagnostic benchmark of 30 simulated manipulation tasks from five real-world application domains. Each task has three difficulty levels and two scene settings (Clean and Random), yielding 180 configurations. The tasks form three views: Mind tests decisions based on past observations, Act tests precise and timely execution, and Mind2Act combines both in closed-loop tasks where action outcomes guide later decisions. Comparing the three views shows whether a system lacks a capability or fails to compose capabilities it already has. A diagnosis harness further attributes the failed episodes of three representative systems to Mind, Act, or their composition and summarizes each system in a profile card. Our evaluation of multimodal agents, vision-language-action models (VLAs), and world-action models (WAMs) shows that competence in a single view does not carry over to Mind2Act tasks. Even the strongest agent succeeds in 52.7% of Mind and 39.0% of Act episodes but in only 12.0% of Mind2Act episodes. The strongest agent retains task state but struggles with sustained contact, whereas end-to-end policies execute practiced motions but retain little task state. These findings point to composing reasoning and execution through environmental feedback as the main open problem.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.text: 原论文的训练、评测与失败诊断流程；模型画像卡为示例，虚线表示下一阶段的改进闭环。图源：作者论文 · Figure 6 · PDF 第 14 页 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

PGX: Physically Grounded Execution for Long-Horizon Humanoid Loco-Manipulation

首发 2026-11-19，v1；  ·  收录于 2026-11-22 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Robotic vision-language-action (VLA) models can execute diverse individual manipulation skills, yet they still struggle with long-horizon loco-manipulation tasks, where temporal structure, skills, and precision are tightly coupled within a monolithic model. We propose Physically Grounded Execution (PGX), a framework that offloads temporal and precision control to two classical training-free components, allowing the VLA to focus on stage-specific skill dynamics. PGX decomposes long-horizon loco-manipulation into three layers: (i) a predicate-based state machine governs task progression, using physical predicates to gate phase transitions, trigger recovery, and coordinate navigation and waiting. Shared predicate semantics connect offline demonstration segmentation, online execution, and stage-wise evaluation; (ii) VLA skills operate within active manipulation phases, with flat or stage-trained models concentrating on task-relevant actions; and (iii) world-coordinate locking (WCL) maintains spatial consistency through base station keeping, object-relative positioning, and world-anchored contact targets. We demonstrate the effectiveness of PGX with extensive experiments conducted on three simulated tasks and one real-world task using a Unitree G1 humanoid robot for long-horizon loco-manipulation, showing improvements in stage progression and task success rates. Project page is available at: https://kl-research.github.io/pgx

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control

智能体与程序学习

首发 2026-11-19，v1；  ·  收录于 2026-11-22 日报

论文原文 ↗PDF ↗项目主页 ↗GitHub ↗中文翻译 ↗返回本期目录

docs.title: Abstract · 摘要原文
docs.text:
复制原文

Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives. However, existing benchmarks report only episode-level success rates, which show neither how these agents succeed nor where they fail. In this paper, we present a systematic action-level analysis of frontier agents on direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks. We introduce AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework in which the policy agent states a local intent alongside each action, and a critic evaluates the action's outcome and failure mode against this intent. Our action-level analysis demonstrates the promising capabilities of frontier agents on direct robot control, including closed-loop recovery from local execution failures, reliable semantic grounding across diverse scenes, and strong zero-shot manipulation without task-specific adaptation. It also identifies their current limitations, including task-relevant physical execution bottlenecks such as grasping and alignment, and uneven recovery across failure modes. Finally, we validate our critic on a 400-action human-annotated benchmark and release a dataset of 12,844 annotated actions alongside a fine-tuned open-source critic, Muse-Glimmer-30B, whose failure-mode accuracy rises from 32.58% to 74.24%, enabling low-cost action-level analysis.

来源：arXiv · v1 ↗展开全文 ↓

docs.title: 方法框架
docs.text: 策略在动作调用中声明局部意图，critic 依据目标、意图及执行前后观测评估结果和失败类别，人工标注验证评判可靠性。图源：作者论文 · Figure 2 ↗ · 查看大图 ↗

docs.title: 贡献
docs.text: 让策略在每次动作时显式给出局部意图，再依据执行前后观测诊断动作结果与失败类别；重点是可解释评估和训练 critic，不是新操作策略。

docs.title: 实验
docs.text: 覆盖 12 个操作基准；用 12,844 个训练动作微调 Muse-Glimmer-30B，在含 400 个人工标注动作的测试集上，264 个失败动作的失败类别准确率从 32.58% 升至 74.24%；整体动作评价正确率从 34.75% 升至 67.75%。这些数字是诊断准确率，不是机器人任务成功率。

docs.title: 局限
docs.text: 评判依赖策略提供的局部意图、画面可见性和失败标签体系；人工测试仅 400 个动作，训练数据与基准覆盖限制跨平台结论；诊断准确不等于恢复成功。

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 06 · MuSTMM2026-10-15 首发 · 近7天补收 MuSTMM: Learning Sound-Triggered Mobile Manipulation across Multiple Scenes

本期唯一直接评测移动底座＋机械臂整链执行的工作；真正贡献偏基准与多模态任务设定，而非通用VLA。

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 10 · PAM2026-10-15 首发 · 近7天补收 An Agentic Framework for Proactive Robots with Procedural Assistance Memory

这是典型的agentic具身系统：外部可编辑记忆负责时机与任务选择，VLA只做原子执行；价值在系统分工而非新低层策略。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · CarryOn2026-10-15 首发 · 近7天补收 CarryOn: A Dual-Loop Harness for Personalized and Reliable Robot Assistance

新意主要在外层系统闭环，而非低层动作表示。值得看失败检测、技能修订与复用如何接到现有VLA上。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · Cracking Mobile Manipulation2026-10-14 首发 · 周报收录 Cracking Mobile Manipulation: From Failure Diagnosis to Agentic Robot System

高度重合：固定技能＋记忆＋reposition已经成立。可保留的是比距离规则更可靠的、经过校准的状态条件技能成功概率。最优先读：它是RP必须明确超越的直接基线。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 02 · AIDA-OWMM2026-10-11 首发 · 周报收录 Look Before You Move: Agent-Interface-Aligned Supervision for Open-World Mobile Manipulation

“先观察/靠近到能操作”及readiness文字推理已重合，但不是经过实测校准的成功概率。阅读理由：检验你的方法收益是否仅来自更合适的主动视觉示范。

智能体与程序学习移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 13 · ChunkAct2026-10-13 首发 · 周报收录 ChunkAct: Action Chunking for Agentic Robotics

语义阶段、缓存与验证组合已有强例。阅读理由：以相同token/时间预算比较你的动态readiness与编译程序＋异常恢复。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 14 · SEAR2026-10-13 首发 · 周报收录 SEAR: Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics

直接约束“结果验证刷新证据”的可信性，验证器也会失准且传播错误。阅读理由：你的实验应加入独立审计、同预算重跑和错误记忆累积测试。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习阅读笔记 → 精选 18 · MultINav2026-10-12 首发 · 周报收录 Interactive Navigation Beyond Reachability: Benchmark and Agentic Framework

“验证后更新状态并解锁下一步”已有直接先例。阅读理由：区分提升信息可见性和改变物理可达性两类act/observe决策。

智能体与程序学习阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · MobiAgent2026-10-02 首发 · 周报收录 MobiAgent: Dual-Loop Recursive Policy Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation

技能选择、结果验证、重规划已明显重合；可保留的候选问题是固定技能下前瞻readiness校准与主动观测成本。阅读价值：最直接的家庭移动系统基线。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 02 · ProactiveVLA2026-10-04 首发 · 周报收录 ProactiveVLA: Augmenting Embodied Memory through Proactive Environment Exploration

固定技能、证据记忆、探索及验证直接重合；重点区分跨任务预探索与当前状态下的readiness判断。阅读价值：最接近你的上层闭环，必须逐项对照。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 10 · Long-WAM2026-10-07 首发 · 周报收录 Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models

长历史收益是阶段记忆的重要替代解释；应比较长上下文与结构化belief在相同时间/算力预算下的效果。阅读价值：强history-only及WAM基线。

世界模型与 WAM智能体与程序学习阅读笔记 → 精选 11 · SpatialHarness2026-10-08 首发 · 周报收录 SpatialHarness: Test-Time Spatial Scaffolding for Fine Robotic Manipulation

接口/观测增强与动作表示创新不同；与移动获取视角形成有价值的成本比较。阅读价值：验证observe收益是否仅来自更好的输入。

智能体与程序学习阅读笔记 → 精选 12 · ROMA2026-10-03 首发 · 周报收录 ROMA: LLM System for Real-World Object-Centric Multi-Sensory Active Perception

证据不足→主动交互→足够后停止已重合；“知道对象属性”与“技能可成功执行”是可保留的区分。阅读价值：主动感知的具体强基线。

智能体与程序学习阅读笔记 → 精选 13 · Robo-COP2026-10-06 首发 · 周报收录 Co-Evolving Robot Orchestrators and Policies through Deployment

结果验证与闭环改进重合，固定技能则是清楚的研究约束。阅读价值：比较编排、代码与策略更新各自贡献，避免将集成当表示novelty。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习阅读笔记 → 精选 14 · RMMBench2026-10-04 首发 · 周报收录 RMMBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Robotic Mobile Manipulation

grid＋技能＋历史/观察接口已有直接先例；适合作评估载体，不能单凭接口组合主张novelty。阅读价值：本期最贴近你的基准候选。

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 16 · Never Look Back2026-10-07 首发 · 周报收录 Never Look Back

持续对象记忆本身已重合；在线证据老化、阶段转移及可执行性判断是不同问题。阅读价值：检验memory-first是否已足够。

适合研究阶段记忆、接触执行与结果验证如何相互影响，尤其值得看阶段失败记录和诊断流程。它提供诊断任务与证据，不是新的检索刷新算法。

为移动底座与机械臂的多机器人协作提供有任务次序和碰撞约束的对照。

比“VLM 直接出动作”更务实：语义视觉只负责粗定位，接触阶段交给专门控制器。新意在阶段分工与 object-centric augmentation 的组合，而不是通用 VLA；真实实验扎实，但需要把人类介入成本算进系统代价。

它回答了 agentic 系统常被忽略的部署成本问题，并给出了可审计的回合量和计算对比。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 03 · PRIME W02026-10-29 首发 · 日报收录 PRIME W0: Physical Priors from World Models for Embodied Manipulation

不是单纯“WM 辅助 VLA”的口号，而是把 WM 子目标作为推理期异步条件直接注入 action expert；但分数异常接近饱和，阅读时应把架构启发与证据可信度分开。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 05 · METATRON2026-10-27 首发 · 日报收录 METATRON: A Promptable Whole-Body Execution Layer for Humanoids

它最有启发性的不是“又一个人形控制器”，而是把技能开发明确变成可检查、可由 coding agent 修改的程序层，而底层统一负责平衡和协调。

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 07 · ScheduleGen2026-10-29 首发 · 日报收录 ScheduleGen: Demonstration Generation via Skill Scheduling for Multi-Arm Imitation Learning

把多臂数据扩展从简单时空变换提升到“接触技能＋连接规划＋并发调度”的完整管线，适合关注大系统与数据引擎的人。

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · ELEVATE2026-10-28 首发 · 日报收录 ELEVATE: Agentic Controller Acquisition from Task Failure for Quadrupedal Manipulation

少见地把 agentic coding 从代码修补推进到真实移动机械臂控制能力的生成，并有明确 sim-to-real 结果。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 02 · LLM-guided Planar Loco-Manipulation for Quadruped Robots2026-10-29 首发 · 日报收录 LLM-guided Planar Loco-Manipulation for Quadruped Robots

把“高层组合正确率”和“整任务成功率”分开报告，清楚暴露 planner–controller 接口失配。

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 08 · RoboAtom2026-10-29 首发 · 日报收录 RoboAtom: Large-scale Atomic-Action Supervision for Robot Learning

对“原子技能标签究竟只是数据整理，还是能改善长程控制”给出了同预算对照。

VLA 与策略学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 10 · SwapBot2026-10-29 首发 · 日报收录 SwapBot: Tool-Centric Robot Manipulation via Interchangeable End-Effectors and Tactile Sensing

提醒家庭操作的大系统能力可能首先受工具接口和接触可观测性限制，而不只是基础模型规模。

记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · RoboAuto2026-10-27 首发 · 近7天补收 RoboAuto: Autonomous Robot Program Search through Multi-Level Physical Understanding

本期最完整的 agentic manipulation 系统，尤其适合看“代码规划—物理假设—实验验证—恢复”如何真正闭环。

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 04 · ThinkWorld2026-10-27 首发 · 近7天补收 ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning

是“人类视频如何真正监督机器人动作”这一问题上较清晰的 action-grounding 方案。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 09 · Pushing Dexterity and Safety for In-Hand Object Pose Reaching That Works Remarkably Well2026-10-27 首发 · 近7天补收 Pushing Dexterity and Safety for In-Hand Object Pose Reaching That Works Remarkably Well

罕见地给出数千目标的实机 denominator，并把“安全”作为可量化对象。

记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 03 · Learning Multi-Phase Robot Loco-Manipulation via Phase-Conditioned Policy Optimization2026-10-26 首发 · 近7天补收 Learning Multi-Phase Robot Loco-Manipulation via Phase-Conditioned Policy Optimization

展示了无需人类动作先验、跨 G1/Spot 的阶段化长程 loco-manipulation 学习配方。

记忆与技能移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · ThinkLocoManip2026-10-25 首发 · 近7天补收 ThinkLocoManip: A Whole-Body Control Agentic Harness for Legged Loco-Manipulation

今天最直接的 agentic mobile-manipulation 工作，实验口径是整任务成功率而非阶段完成度。

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 07 · RoboDuo2026-10-25 首发 · 近7天补收 RoboDuo: Attempt, Check and Atomic Recovery through Code for Vision-Language-Action Models

今天与“验证—恢复—技能编排”最直接的一篇，且诚实展示了监控器在真实部署中的作用。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 10 · MOTIO2026-10-24 首发 · 近7天补收 MOTIO: Agentic Skill Engineering for Reality-Grounded Humanoid Loco-Manipulation

系统野心很大、任务跨度也大，但证据边界需谨慎，因此排在本期末位而非按宣传规模抬高。

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 03 · FORCA2026-10-22 首发 · 日报收录 FORCA: A Force-Aware Coding Agent for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation

这是少见的“代码不只写轨迹，还重写力反馈逻辑”的 agentic manipulation，真实新意在物理反馈进入程序修订闭环。

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 05 · LogLook2026-10-23 首发 · 日报收录 LogLook: Execution-Grounded Memory for Frontier-Model Robot Planners

它最清楚地把“记住什么”和“何时再看一眼”同时做成可控接口，也诚实展示了高层 memory 改好后会被低层 VLA 失败掩盖。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · AW-02026-10-21 首发 · 日报收录 Agentic World Action Models（AW-0）

今天最完整地把 WAM、agentic code 与技能复用接成一个执行闭环；真实新意不是“外接 VLM 规划器”，而是联合生成并让代码参与 action expert 的去噪。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 05 · FlowVLA2026-10-21 首发 · 日报收录 FlowVLA: Learning Flow-Aware Physical Completion for Quantitative Robotic Pouring

展示了 VLA 之外显式“任务完成观测器”何时比端到端动作头更合适，是很干净的系统分解案例。

VLA 与策略学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 06 · PAL2026-10-21 首发 · 日报收录 Plan First, Act Later: Streaming Reasoning for Executable Memory in Robot Control（PAL）

它把 memory 从“检索过去”改成“提前写未来可执行计划”，接口和训练信号都比一般 RAG 式记忆更明确。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 07 · SERA2026-10-21 首发 · 日报收录 From VLM Planners to Robotic Agents: Self-Evolving Harnesses for History-Dependent Manipulation（SERA）

这是“agentic coding”作为上层可验证配置搜索的清晰样例，适合与端到端 VLA/WAM 对照阅读。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · UniWALM2026-10-20 首发 · 日报收录 UniWALM: Unified World Action Language Model for Embodied Robot Control

在单一 mixture-of-transformers 中同步扩散生成动作、语言和视频表征；语言同时表示下一子任务与文本记忆，并在下一控制步重新输入，不依赖外部规划器或记忆库。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 05 · AgenticRoboRL2026-10-20 首发 · 日报收录 AgenticRoboRL: Bringing Coding-Agent Post-Training to Agentic Robotics

将 coding-agent 的 SFT+多轮 RL 后训练移植到机器人 planner，并用 harness adapter 兼容“调用 VLA 技能”和“生成控制代码”两种执行接口。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 06 · EventSync2026-10-20 首发 · 日报收录 EventSync: Event-Driven Memory Updates for History-Dependent Manipulation

用轻量 Event Monitor 融合视觉和末端轨迹，只在获得子任务完成证据后更新 completed-subgoal memory 并触发下一次高层推理。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 07 · Tactile-ETA2026-10-20 首发 · 日报收录 Tactile-ETA: Embodied Task Agents Can Perform Fine Manipulation through Tactile In-Context Learning

将专家动作与视觉、双侧触觉序列对齐，作为 in-context demonstration 交给冻结的 embodied task agent，通过通用机器人工具完成精细操作，无需任务专属参数更新。

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · RAX2026-10-15 首发 · 近7天补收 RAX — Scaling Online Exploration for Robot Agents

目前最值得仔细拆解的代码型机器人系统之一；优先读 §5.2.5、附录 §14.6 和 §15，理解性能、人工协助与成本如何共同决定实际可用性。

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 03 · TacitVLA2026-10-13 首发 · 近7天补收 TacitVLA — Reasoning Vision-Language-Action Models Without Reasoning Latency

把“推理监督有用”和“必须先输出推理再行动”分开验证，方法清楚，对实时 VLA 设计有直接启发。

VLA 与策略学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 04 · IMEP2026-10-16 首发 · 近7天补收 IMEP — Beyond Success Rate: Interventional Evaluation of Memory in Vision-Language-Action Systems

适合建立评估检查表：今后看到 memory-on/off 的成功率差异，还应追问究竟用了哪条历史事实。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · LAW2026-10-16 首发 · 近7天补收 LAW: Unifying Language, Action, and World Modeling for Agentic Physical Intelligence

目前最完整地展示“VLM负责语义阶段、WAM负责连续动作、验证器负责切换”的系统边界。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 02 · AWAM2026-10-16 首发 · 近7天补收 AWAM: Active Trajectory-Conditioned View Imagination for Robust Robot Manipulation

它把世界模型的价值从“生成未来视频”变成“主动选择缺失证据”，实验因果对照较完整。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM主动感知记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 03 · HexaShell2026-10-16 首发 · 近7天补收 HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents

它罕见地把agentic coding的收益与接触控制瓶颈拆开量化，适合判断“代码代理能替代多少学习策略”。

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 08 · NestedVLA2026-10-16 首发 · 近7天补收 NestedVLA: Learning to Consolidate and Generate Skills for Vision-Language-Action Models

真实揭示VLA模型合并的失败位置：VLM残差与动作专家不能同样处理，技能扩展成本被明确量化。

VLA 与策略学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 10 · FOUND-IT++2026-10-16 首发 · 近7天补收 Foundation-Model-Driven 3D Scene Graphs for Mobile Manipulation

本期唯一完整mobile manipulation系统，而且坦诚显示上层语义记忆成熟后，最终瓶颈仍在靠近与抓取。

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · Mem4Act2026-10-15 首发 · 近7天补收 Mem4Act: Learning Effective Latent Memory for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation

相比简单保存历史帧，真正控制了记忆容量并验证策略会使用记忆；消融显示时间结构比单纯增加token数量更重要。

VLA 与策略学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 03 · VaM2026-10-15 首发 · 近7天补收 Value as Memory: Online Value-Guided Post-training for General Robot Policies

新意不是普通critic，而是将在线价值估计显式反馈给动作策略作为部分可观测下的短期进度状态。

VLA 与策略学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 06 · MuSTMM2026-10-15 首发 · 近7天补收 MuSTMM: Learning Sound-Triggered Mobile Manipulation across Multiple Scenes

本期唯一直接评测移动底座＋机械臂整链执行的工作；真正贡献偏基准与多模态任务设定，而非通用VLA。

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 10 · PAM2026-10-15 首发 · 近7天补收 An Agentic Framework for Proactive Robots with Procedural Assistance Memory

这是典型的agentic具身系统：外部可编辑记忆负责时机与任务选择，VLA只做原子执行；价值在系统分工而非新低层策略。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · CarryOn2026-10-15 首发 · 近7天补收 CarryOn: A Dual-Loop Harness for Personalized and Reliable Robot Assistance

新意主要在外层系统闭环，而非低层动作表示。值得看失败检测、技能修订与复用如何接到现有VLA上。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 02 · REKI2026-10-15 首发 · 近7天补收 REKI: Registering Knowledge in VLAs

真实新意是低成本历史信息进入动作专家的方式。匹配权重的记忆消融，比单看模型排行榜更有解释力。

VLA 与策略学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 05 · Fast-VLA2026-10-15 首发 · 近7天补收 Fast-VLA: You Only Think Once for Robot Manipulation

新意在将任务语义计算移到启动阶段，区别于逐步剪tokens。固定任务记忆对中途指令变化的适应性，是尚待验证的边界（推断）。

VLA 与策略学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 13 · ChunkAct2026-10-13 首发 · 周报收录 ChunkAct: Action Chunking for Agentic Robotics

语义阶段、缓存与验证组合已有强例。阅读理由：以相同token/时间预算比较你的动态readiness与编译程序＋异常恢复。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · MobiAgent2026-10-02 首发 · 周报收录 MobiAgent: Dual-Loop Recursive Policy Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation

技能选择、结果验证、重规划已明显重合；可保留的候选问题是固定技能下前瞻readiness校准与主动观测成本。阅读价值：最直接的家庭移动系统基线。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 02 · ProactiveVLA2026-10-04 首发 · 周报收录 ProactiveVLA: Augmenting Embodied Memory through Proactive Environment Exploration

固定技能、证据记忆、探索及验证直接重合；重点区分跨任务预探索与当前状态下的readiness判断。阅读价值：最接近你的上层闭环，必须逐项对照。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 03 · EvoMem-VLA2026-10-04 首发 · 周报收录 EvoMem-VLA: State-Evolution Memory for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation

“保存变化和结果证据”本身重合；在线因果阶段belief、证据失效与概率校准仍需独立验证。阅读价值：建立memory-only强基线。

VLA 与策略学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 14 · RMMBench2026-10-04 首发 · 周报收录 RMMBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Robotic Mobile Manipulation

grid＋技能＋历史/观察接口已有直接先例；适合作评估载体，不能单凭接口组合主张novelty。阅读价值：本期最贴近你的基准候选。

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 16 · Never Look Back2026-10-07 首发 · 周报收录 Never Look Back

持续对象记忆本身已重合；在线证据老化、阶段转移及可执行性判断是不同问题。阅读价值：检验memory-first是否已足够。

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 →

docs.title: 移动操作
docs.text:
47 篇阅读笔记 · 按收录日期与日报排序浏览

精选 01 · PGX2026-11-19 首发 · 近7天补收 PGX: Physically Grounded Execution for Long-Horizon Humanoid Loco-Manipulation

能够区分执行时结构、分阶段训练和精确控制的作用，对长任务闭环系统有启发。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · WEVO2026-11-18 首发 · 近7天补收 WEVO: World Model-Enabled VLA Optimization for Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation

同时比较仿真 RL、真机 RL、稠密奖励和离线轨迹，展示世界模型在策略改进而非只做预测中的作用。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · Z-sight2026-11-18 首发 · 近7天补收 Z-sight: Unifying Vision-Language-Action and Latent World Modeling

同时有潜在预测机制消融、真机和多平台比较，适合理解轻量世界模型是否能促进全身操作。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 03 · CoT-WAM2026-11-18 首发 · 近7天补收 CoT-WAM: Collaborative Training of Vision-Language Models and World-Action Models via Plan Latents

把语义计划如何注入世界—动作模型讲清楚，也展示特权调度对照。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM记忆与技能移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 04 · RePlan-VLA2026-11-18 首发 · 近7天补收 RePlan-VLA: Progress-Aware Replanning for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Models

进度估计和失败反馈的闭环值得借鉴，但计算开销和公平比较必须一并考察。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 05 · Cooperative Mobile Manipulation using Learned Dynamical Systems2026-11-16 首发 · 近7天补收 Cooperative Mobile Manipulation using Learned Dynamical Systems

为移动底座与机械臂的多机器人协作提供有任务次序和碰撞约束的对照。

记忆与技能移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · HALO2026-11-12 首发 · 近7天补收 HALO: Human-Aligned Data Collection for WhoLe-body MObile Manipulation

操作端到端数据中的人体示范与部署偏差，是移动操作数据工程的具体实例。

VLA 与策略学习移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · EgoX2026-11-12 首发 · 近7天补收 EgoX: Egocentric Cross-Embodiment Manipulation with Embodiment Dreaming

真移动操作和桌面操作共用一套分析，能具体观察跨具身数据与辅助预测各自作用。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 02 · CAFE2026-11-08 首发 · 近7天补收 CAFE: Closed-Loop Autonomous Task Formulation and Execution without Instance-Specific Instructions

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 02 · WAM is capable in BEHAVIOR-1K2026-11-10 首发 · 补充收录 WAM is capable in BEHAVIOR-1K: the 2nd-place solution to the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge

docs.text:
9 篇阅读笔记 · 按收录日期与日报排序浏览

精选 04 · TaF-Foundation2026-11-16 首发 · 近7天补收 TaF-Foundation: Wrench-Grounded Cross-Sensor Tactile Representations

为多硬件触觉迁移给出实测数据和明确的适配边界。

其他具身方向阅读笔记 → 精选 05 · MOSS2026-10-15 首发 · 近7天补收 MOSS — Mode-Oriented Source Shaping for Robot Flow Matching Policies

其他具身方向阅读笔记 → 精选 08 · TDV2026-10-15 首发 · 近7天补收 Trajectory-based Diffusion from One-shot Human Video for Generalizable Manipulation

其他具身方向阅读笔记 → 精选 03 · HiRe-MoMa2026-10-14 首发 · 周报收录 Hierarchical Residual Policy Learning for Real-World Mobile Manipulation with Sparse Human Guidance

直接补充底座—臂结构化输出的强基线，但它改变了执行器，与你固定技能的上层问题不同。阅读理由：区分“动作因子分解”与“何时执行/移位”。

其他具身方向阅读笔记 → 精选 05 · RAIN2026-10-14 首发 · 周报收录 Refine Actions If Needed: Adaptive Action Chunk Refinement for Robot Manipulation

其他具身方向阅读笔记 → 精选 06 · ReEnvision2026-10-13 首发 · 周报收录 ReEnvision: Future-Guided Selective Action Repair for Long-Horizon Manipulation

其他具身方向阅读笔记 → 精选 08 · I3L2026-10-13 首发 · 周报收录 I3L: Iterative Interactive Imitation Learning for Whole-Body Mobile Manipulation

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM阅读笔记 → 精选 10 · PAM2026-10-15 首发 · 近7天补收 An Agentic Framework for Proactive Robots with Procedural Assistance Memory

这是典型的agentic具身系统：外部可编辑记忆负责时机与任务选择，VLA只做原子执行；价值在系统分工而非新低层策略。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · CarryOn2026-10-15 首发 · 近7天补收 CarryOn: A Dual-Loop Harness for Personalized and Reliable Robot Assistance

新意主要在外层系统闭环，而非低层动作表示。值得看失败检测、技能修订与复用如何接到现有VLA上。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 02 · REKI2026-10-15 首发 · 近7天补收 REKI: Registering Knowledge in VLAs

真实新意是低成本历史信息进入动作专家的方式。匹配权重的记忆消融，比单看模型排行榜更有解释力。

VLA 与策略学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 03 · Spark-02026-10-15 首发 · 近7天补收 Spark-0: Scaling Spatially Aligned Tactile Pretraining for Robot Dexterous Manipulation

核心价值是区分‘触觉作为训练监督’与‘触觉作为在线输入’，并提供匹配数据、计算预算的对照。

VLA 与策略学习阅读笔记 → 精选 04 · 因果分析与效率2026-10-14 首发 · 近7天补收 Causal Analysis of Robot Foundation Models Enables Efficiency Gains

从因果干预走到结构改造，比用注意力热图直接解释重要性更扎实；但关键层位置能否跨任务复用仍需验证。

VLA 与策略学习阅读笔记 → 精选 05 · Fast-VLA2026-10-15 首发 · 近7天补收 Fast-VLA: You Only Think Once for Robot Manipulation

新意在将任务语义计算移到启动阶段，区别于逐步剪tokens。固定任务记忆对中途指令变化的适应性，是尚待验证的边界（推断）。

VLA 与策略学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 06 · VLA-Δ2026-10-15 首发 · 近7天补收 VLA-Δ: Learning Physical State Transition for Vision-Language-Action Models

值得看未来信息如何用于训练而不增加部署时预测步骤。真实贡献是多层次转移监督的组合，而非首次使用未来状态辅助策略学习。

VLA 与策略学习阅读笔记 → 精选 07 · FastVLA2026-10-15 首发 · 近7天补收 FastVLA: Task-Conditioned and Temporally Adaptive Visual Token Compression for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models

这是易接入现有策略的效率模块，适合与缓存、架构裁剪分开比较；应同时看实际延迟和任务损失。与第5篇Fast-VLA是不同工作。

VLA 与策略学习阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · Cracking Mobile Manipulation2026-10-14 首发 · 周报收录 Cracking Mobile Manipulation: From Failure Diagnosis to Agentic Robot System

高度重合：固定技能＋记忆＋reposition已经成立。可保留的是比距离规则更可靠的、经过校准的状态条件技能成功概率。最优先读：它是RP必须明确超越的直接基线。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 04 · 离散动作对比2026-10-14 首发 · 周报收录 When Do Discrete Actions Make Good Continuous Controllers?

直接反驳“加入metric邻接结构必然更好”的默认前提。阅读理由：若保留grid主线，应证明跨底座/臂的一致性或决策收益，而不只是量化精度。

VLA 与策略学习阅读笔记 → 精选 07 · AFCE2026-10-09 首发 · 周报收录 Beyond Actions: Learning Future Operation Targets for Vision-Language-Action Models

比“换坐标单位”更实质地改变预测目标，但不解决当前历史下技能是否应启动。阅读理由：理解VLA/WAM动作抽象真正改变了哪一层。

VLA 与策略学习阅读笔记 → 精选 13 · ChunkAct2026-10-13 首发 · 周报收录 ChunkAct: Action Chunking for Agentic Robotics

语义阶段、缓存与验证组合已有强例。阅读理由：以相同token/时间预算比较你的动态readiness与编译程序＋异常恢复。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 14 · SEAR2026-10-13 首发 · 周报收录 SEAR: Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics

直接约束“结果验证刷新证据”的可信性，验证器也会失准且传播错误。阅读理由：你的实验应加入独立审计、同预算重跑和错误记忆累积测试。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习阅读笔记 → 精选 16 · NSL2026-10-09 首发 · 周报收录 Noise Space Learning for VLA Adaptation

提醒RP明确固定的是权重、输入接口还是完整技能分布。阅读理由：有价值的低成本适配对照，不应误称readiness方法。

VLA 与策略学习阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · MobiAgent2026-10-02 首发 · 周报收录 MobiAgent: Dual-Loop Recursive Policy Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation

技能选择、结果验证、重规划已明显重合；可保留的候选问题是固定技能下前瞻readiness校准与主动观测成本。阅读价值：最直接的家庭移动系统基线。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 02 · ProactiveVLA2026-10-04 首发 · 周报收录 ProactiveVLA: Augmenting Embodied Memory through Proactive Environment Exploration

固定技能、证据记忆、探索及验证直接重合；重点区分跨任务预探索与当前状态下的readiness判断。阅读价值：最接近你的上层闭环，必须逐项对照。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 03 · EvoMem-VLA2026-10-04 首发 · 周报收录 EvoMem-VLA: State-Evolution Memory for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation

“保存变化和结果证据”本身重合；在线因果阶段belief、证据失效与概率校准仍需独立验证。阅读价值：建立memory-only强基线。

VLA 与策略学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 05 · 冻结 VLA 纠错诊断2026-10-02 首发 · 周报收录 Does a Learned Corrector Beat a Simple Retreat? Evidence from a Frozen VLA

对readiness触发机制提出关键证据要求：必须胜过定时observe/retreat、重跑及几何规则。阅读价值：防止RP收益实际来自多一次尝试。

VLA 与策略学习阅读笔记 → 精选 06 · SimVLA2026-10-08 首发 · 周报收录 SimVLA: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real VLA Learning for Mobile Manipulation

补充低层动作与空间泛化基线，提醒readiness收益需与训练覆盖率区分。阅读价值：本期最强的直接移动sim-to-real证据之一。

VLA 与策略学习移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 07 · MobileVISTA2026-10-05 首发 · 周报收录 MobileVISTA: Generative Data Augmentation for Pose Generalization in Mobile Manipulation

不是统一底座＋臂动作表示创新；与reposition互补，需比较“改变站位”与“策略本身增强”。阅读价值：设计停车误差与站位测试。

VLA 与策略学习阅读笔记 → 精选 08 · VOMMI2026-10-06 首发 · 周报收录 VOMMI: Collecting and Leveraging Portable Demonstrations for Mobile Manipulation

互补于坐标系、ego-motion和动作分组；readiness应避免把定位漂移误判为阶段变化。阅读价值：直接检查底座动作信息从哪里来。

VLA 与策略学习移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 13 · Robo-COP2026-10-06 首发 · 周报收录 Co-Evolving Robot Orchestrators and Policies through Deployment

结果验证与闭环改进重合，固定技能则是清楚的研究约束。阅读价值：比较编排、代码与策略更新各自贡献，避免将集成当表示novelty。

VLA 与策略学习智能体与程序学习阅读笔记 →

docs.text:
9 篇阅读笔记 · 按收录日期与日报排序浏览

精选 05 · Cognitive-Horizon Action Chunking2026-11-19 首发 · 近7天补收 Cognitive-Horizon Action Chunking: Memory-Guided Adaptive Reasoning for Embodied Navigation（CHAC）

将推理成本与成功率、路径效率一同报告，便于研究实际部署中的取舍。

VLN · 视觉语言导航阅读笔记 → 精选 06 · Improve How You Improve2026-11-18 首发 · 近7天补收 Improve How You Improve: Recursive Policy Self-Improvement for Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Navigation（RPSI-Nav）

可具体观察自我修订、地图记忆和目标序列如何协作，不应将其宣传为已验证的通用真实世界自进化。

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能VLN · 视觉语言导航阅读笔记 → 精选 02 · Fly as Instructed2026-11-17 首发 · 近7天补收 Fly as Instructed: Refining World-Action Policies for UAV Vision-Language Navigation

可直接研究多条指令的进度跟踪、停止和避障如何相互作用。

世界模型与 WAMVLN · 视觉语言导航阅读笔记 → 精选 06 · VLAN2026-11-13 首发 · 近7天补收 VLAN: Vision-Language Accessible Navigation

补充通常只看“到达目标”时容易遗漏的用户能力与无障碍安全约束。

VLN · 视觉语言导航阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · Racing the Clock2026-11-12 首发 · 近7天补收 Racing the Clock: Teaching VLNs Budget-Conditioned Object Search

直接比较“更强特权专家”与“更易模仿的专家”，并检验导航预算、记忆与探索的关系。

VLA 与策略学习VLN · 视觉语言导航阅读笔记 → 精选 03 · X-Nav Technical Report2026-11-12 首发 · 近7天补收 X-Nav Technical Report: Real-World Long-Horizon Indoor-to-Outdoor Navigation on a Humanoid Robot

把真机长路线、停止能力与数字孪生适配分开，适合观察人形 VLN 的部署链条。

智能体与程序学习记忆与技能VLN · 视觉语言导航阅读笔记 → 精选 03 · EMS-Nav2026-11-11 首发 · 近7天补收 EMS-Nav: Embodied Multi-Scale Navigation

对地图层次、语言查询及资源开销给出可对照的系统实现，并揭示导航论文“真实场景”和“真机执行”必须分开。

智能体与程序学习VLN · 视觉语言导航阅读笔记 → 精选 04 · ProtoVis-Nav2026-11-12 首发 · 近7天补收 ProtoVis-Nav: Prototypical Visual Imagination for Visual-Spatial Aligned UAV Navigation

把未来感知预测与导航航点学习连接起来，并同时报告成功、路径效率和碰撞。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAMVLN · 视觉语言导航阅读笔记 → 精选 03 · What Can a VLA Learn from the Agent That Calls It? Task-Level Experience Distillation for Embodied Navigation2026-11-12 首发 · 近7天补收 What Can a VLA Learn from the Agent That Calls It? Task-Level Experience Distillation for Embodied Navigation

同时研究导航策略、停止判断与 agent 经验复用，且把测试时是否继续调用 LLM 说清楚。

docs.text:
93 篇阅读笔记 · 按收录日期与日报排序浏览

精选 02 · CauSyncVLA2026-11-19 首发 · 近7天补收 CauSyncVLA: Causal Latent World Modeling for Asynchronous Robot Control

对照同步／异步执行和任务成功率，帮助把推理吞吐、响应延迟与动作平滑度区分开。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM阅读笔记 → 精选 04 · GEMS2026-11-18 首发 · 近7天补收 GEMS: Generation and Experience Memory for Subgoal-Guided Long-Horizon World Model Planning

生成子目标和经验状态选择有明确对照消融，适合研究长时域世界模型规划。

世界模型与 WAM记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · WEVO2026-11-18 首发 · 近7天补收 WEVO: World Model-Enabled VLA Optimization for Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation

同时比较仿真 RL、真机 RL、稠密奖励和离线轨迹，展示世界模型在策略改进而非只做预测中的作用。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 02 · MAWAM2026-11-18 首发 · 近7天补收 MAWAM: A Multi-Agent World-Action Model for Coordinated Manipulation

适合比较预测未来和显式协作注意力是否真的改善闭环控制。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM阅读笔记 → 精选 04 · Verify2Act2026-11-18 首发 · 近7天补收 Verify2Act: Critic-Guided Latent World Models for Verifying Language-Conditioned Manipulation Plans

明确区分整任务成功、计划正确和动作执行失败，便于判断预测验证的实际价值。

世界模型与 WAM智能体与程序学习阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · Z-sight2026-11-18 首发 · 近7天补收 Z-sight: Unifying Vision-Language-Action and Latent World Modeling

同时有潜在预测机制消融、真机和多平台比较，适合理解轻量世界模型是否能促进全身操作。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 03 · CoT-WAM2026-11-18 首发 · 近7天补收 CoT-WAM: Collaborative Training of Vision-Language Models and World-Action Models via Plan Latents

把语义计划如何注入世界—动作模型讲清楚，也展示特权调度对照。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM记忆与技能移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · Mind2Act World2026-11-19 首发 · 用户指定补录 Mind2Act World: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Mind, Physical Action, and Mind-Action Composition in Robotic Manipulation

适合研究阶段记忆、接触执行与结果验证如何相互影响，尤其值得看阶段失败记录和诊断流程。它提供诊断任务与证据，不是新的检索刷新算法。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM智能体与程序学习记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 02 · Fly as Instructed2026-11-17 首发 · 近7天补收 Fly as Instructed: Refining World-Action Policies for UAV Vision-Language Navigation

可直接研究多条指令的进度跟踪、停止和避障如何相互作用。

世界模型与 WAMVLN · 视觉语言导航阅读笔记 → 精选 04 · Joint World Action Models through Differentiable Trajectory Optimization2026-11-13 首发 · 近7天补收 Joint World Action Models through Differentiable Trajectory Optimization

较清楚地区分把优化摊销进模型与部署时反复搜索，并有共享世界模型的对照。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM阅读笔记 → 精选 03 · Video-Action Models for Data-Efficient Industrial Manipulation2026-11-11 首发 · 近7天补收 Video-Action Models for Data-Efficient Industrial Manipulation

为“视频先验是否有助于少示范接触操作”提供真机对照，也显示不同硬件上未必一致领先。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM阅读笔记 → 精选 04 · ProtoVis-Nav2026-11-12 首发 · 近7天补收 ProtoVis-Nav: Prototypical Visual Imagination for Visual-Spatial Aligned UAV Navigation

把未来感知预测与导航航点学习连接起来，并同时报告成功、路径效率和碰撞。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAMVLN · 视觉语言导航阅读笔记 → 精选 01 · EgoX2026-11-12 首发 · 近7天补收 EgoX: Egocentric Cross-Embodiment Manipulation with Embodiment Dreaming

真移动操作和桌面操作共用一套分析，能具体观察跨具身数据与辅助预测各自作用。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 02 · WAM is capable in BEHAVIOR-1K2026-11-10 首发 · 补充收录 WAM is capable in BEHAVIOR-1K: the 2nd-place solution to the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge

最贴近移动底座＋操作的部署栈案例，值得看任务阶段识别、专用 LoRA 切换与推理吞吐之间如何折中。

世界模型与 WAM记忆与技能移动操作阅读笔记 → 精选 03 · LaST0.52026-11-10 首发 · 补充收录 LaST0.5: A Generalist World Action Model with Interaction-Centric Latent Reasoning

把局部交互建模和执行期进度门控连接起来，并同时给出消融与真实双臂数据；值得重点比较“预测未来”和“何时重新预测”。

世界模型与 WAM阅读笔记 → 精选 05 · Library of Hands2026-11-09 首发 · 补充收录 Library of Hands: Fix the Hands, Not the World Model

它把“世界模型不准”和“动作接口变了”区分开，适合研究无需重新训练的世界模型部署适应。

世界模型与 WAM记忆与技能阅读笔记 → 精选 07 · SWAM2026-11-09 首发 · 补充收录 SWAM: Scaling World Action Models with Cross-Modal Alignment

看WAM数据配比与语言对齐，而不是只看模型结构；真实整任务和阶段进度分开报告。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM阅读笔记 → 精选 08 · ForeAct2026-11-08 首发 · 补充收录 ForeAct: Geometry-Guided Action Learning from World Representations

与完整生成式WAM形成有价值对照：世界模型先验可用于控制，但推理未必需要生成未来帧。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM阅读笔记 → 精选 15 · Elastic-WAM2026-11-10 首发 · 补充收录 Elastic-WAM: Adaptive Spatiotemporal Imagination for Efficient Robot Control

世界模型与 WAM阅读笔记 → 精选 05 · VFlash2026-11-05 首发 · 近7天补收 VFlash: Fast Structured Visual Planning for Robot Manipulation

这是少见的“计划表示解码效率”工作，既有推理速度也有下游成功率证据。真正值得借鉴的是结构化并行解码，而不是把它泛化为完整 world model 的能力提升。

VLA 与策略学习世界模型与 WAM阅读笔记 → 精选 06 · RoboImagine2026-11-05 首发 · 近7天补收 RoboImagine: Improving Autoregressive Robot World Models with Post-Training

它给 robot world model 引入了相对偏好式后训练，并显著降低了比 MCTS 更昂贵的候选搜索成本；但现阶段应归类为生成质量改进，不能据此声称操作性能提高。

世界模型与 WAM阅读笔记 → 精选 04 · La-JEPA2026-11-05 首发 · 日报收录 La-JEPA: Compact Robot Policies with Latent World Modeling

压缩“统一结构化动作空间”的宽泛novelty，但不直接覆盖概率readiness。阅读理由：把关节语义对齐与工作空间metric/grid严格分开。

世界模型与 WAM阅读笔记 → 精选 11 · AoE2026-10-12 首发 · 周报收录 What Limits Cross-Task Generalization in World Action Models?

可见性与动作表示耦合，未来“合理”不等于动作可执行。阅读理由：为observe价值及WM可信度建立有控制的诊断实验。

世界模型与 WAM阅读笔记 → 精选 15 · LoopWAM2026-10-13 首发 · 周报收录 LoopWAM: Closed-Loop Generalist Policy Improvement from Deployment Rollouts

互补于负经验利用，但“world学失败、action不模仿失败”已是明确机制。阅读理由：隔离证据利用、策略更新和额外数据带来的收益。

世界模型与 WAM阅读笔记 → 精选 17 · WATCH2026-10-09 首发 · 周报收录 Learning Transferable World-Action Models from Task-Paired Human Videos

互补于阶段/交互抽象如何从人类数据获得，但不证明当前状态可执行性。阅读理由：区分共享任务表示与部署readiness。

世界模型与 WAM阅读笔记 → 精选 19 · G²WAM2026-10-12 首发 · 周报收录 G²WAM: World Action Models for Efficient and Geometry Grounded Image-Goal Navigation

互补于底座移动后证据与几何坐标一致性。阅读理由：readiness误差应与定位误差解耦，不能都归因于动作表示。

世界模型与 WAM阅读笔记 → 精选 20 · 1Step-WAM2026-10-11 首发 · 周报收录 1Step-WAM: Your World Action Model but Faster using 1-Step Action Generation

不覆盖readiness，但决定WAM对照是否能满足你的控制预算。阅读理由：把计算延迟纳入act/observe/reposition的公平比较。

世界模型与 WAM阅读笔记 → 精选 04 · Unitas2026-10-08 首发 · 周报收录 Unitas: A 3D-Native World Action Model for Embodied Manipulation

对“统一metric action representation”这一宽泛novelty构成直接挑战；可转向表示如何支持技能可执行性和观测决策。阅读价值：本期最重要的表示边界论文。

世界模型与 WAM阅读笔记 → 精选 09 · 事件对齐 WAM2026-10-07 首发 · 周报收录 Event-Aligned Visual Action Reasoning for World Action Models

阶段抽象和执行截断重合；可研究事件证据不足时是否主动观察，而非只缩短chunk。阅读价值：事件如何真正影响执行。

世界模型与 WAM阅读笔记 → 精选 10 · Long-WAM2026-10-07 首发 · 周报收录 Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models

长历史收益是阶段记忆的重要替代解释；应比较长上下文与结构化belief在相同时间/算力预算下的效果。阅读价值：强history-only及WAM基线。

世界模型与 WAM智能体与程序学习阅读笔记 → 精选 17 · LeWAM2026-10-08 首发 · 周报收录 LeWAM: A JEPA World Action Model with Diffusion-Steering-Based MPC

动作抽象的价值也可能是限制预测器可被利用的范围，而非换成grid。阅读价值：提醒readiness不能把WM预测当真实成功标签。

世界模型与 WAM阅读笔记 → 精选 18 · DreamTrue2026-10-08 首发 · 周报收录 DreamTrue: Action-Faithful Robot World Model with Counterfactual Post-Training

与readiness的counterfactual预测互补，也直接提出误校准风险。阅读价值：区分“看起来合理”与“动作改变结果”。

世界模型与 WAM阅读笔记 → 精选 19 · ΔWAM2026-10-07 首发 · 周报收录 ΔWAM: Distilling Action Tangent Fields into World Action Models

可提供动作敏感的进度/证据特征，不是底座＋臂metric/grid方案。阅读价值：低成本预测接口与其几何泛化局限。

世界模型与 WAM阅读笔记 → 精选 20 · MiniWAM2026-10-08 首发 · 周报收录 MiniWAM: Learning Compact Future Targets for Efficient World-Action Modeling

互补于低算力未来预测，但训练目标创新与上层readiness创新需拆开。阅读价值：选可负担的WAM对照，而非默认生成完整视频。

世界模型与 WAM阅读笔记 →
